It's a shame I didn't take a close-up photo of the benches facing the sea || Nice place at the end. || Excellent sports facilities, cold water station next door. In front of the sea. Fun to train there! || A large, elegant place, full of luxurious and high-quality equipment for productions of all kinds, a great place to visit. || An open amphitheater on Herods Beach. Suitable for holding events, especially chuppahs. || One of the most beautiful and clean beaches in Eilat! Usually not many people.. || Please rename it "Amphitheater." It looks so ridiculous.

A genuine look back in time. At first it looks like a dodgy theater, based in the basement floor of a everything but abandoned shopping center. Upon further inspection, you notice its charm. A theater built probably in the 70s/80s, it's small, has only three halls and the seats are a few decades outdated.  The movie we went to was a 22:30 showing, there were about 10 people total in the theater, it somehow made the movie much better. You feel free to whisper, laugh out loud and talk about the movie, and although everyone can hear you, it disturbs no one. The comfort you feel just make it a more genuine movie viewing experience, as opposed to the very institutionalised movie experience of today.  Also, the was an INTERLUDE! Who does that anymore?? || I've been to a lot of run-down movie theatres, and this is easily the worst.  FIRST, they don't have a website, so I found movie listings on seret.co.il, but when we made a trip to this theatre - the only one in town - the listings turned out to have been all wrong, like the movie didn't even exist. Cashier shrugged and was like, "It's not our site." Like - surely there's a way to fix that; this is 2022 and people plan moviegoing online.  SECOND, it's in a charmless bunker in the basement and the seats, floor, etc., are grungy from years of wear and tear. A group of older teens came in late and shouted through the entire movie. One guy even took a call - he was like, "I'm at the theatre," and proceeded to talk about the movie. I guess it's a plus that a staff person asked us if we wanted the air conditioning on; otherwise, we might have suffocated. Yuck. Surely with all the tourists in town, a decent theatre could attract some business?  Giving it 2 stars because we were actually able to see a movie, even if we couldn't hear a lot of it because of the shouting hoodlums in the back row. Oh, and the bathrooms were actually really good. Lots of soap, paper, and very clean. If only the theatres were as good as the toilets. || This theater is really fun to see a blockbuster - the big theater is grand enough to make it feel like a special occasion! The staff is very nice and the ladies rooms are clean and classy looking. If you are new to Israeli movie theaters, heads up - if there is a brief pause in the middle of the film, it's not broken.. it is intermission! Take a moment to laugh at the awkward spot they stopped the film, and then take a tinkle (or whatever). Have fun, enjoy the movie! || Very old place, but it has its own rarity. || If I could give a negative score for this place as a movie theater, I would. Lets just say the highlight of the evening was when one of the staff threatened to call the police on people who were being rude. The sound system is decent but the screen is warped and there is serious light bleed in the hall. People use their phones all the time AND the audience basically randomly walks around. Do not go to a movie here unless you have no other option. || Now it's the only game in town if you want to see a movie. Good theater nice staff old style so the screen isn't like the new theaters but it does the job but they have all the hit movies. The only thing they still have an intermission so it's kind of annoying that they stopped in the middle of the movie and then start again || Worst cinema I have ever been in Israel. 3 halls, we were at num 3 which is the largest The seats and the floor was filthy The screen is very small The audio is terrible The seats themselves are very veryyyyy old Just don't go, better to watch Netflix at home || Although recently recarpeted you can still see the place is in need of renovation. But taking in account that cinemas are dwindling all over the world good it's still open - last cinema and Theatre in Eilat. 3D screening available for selected movies and if you are looking for kids movies most of the time screenings are with and without Hebrew sincronisation || Looks like movies is not a good business in Eilat. Large popcorn is small everywhere else. Chairs were cramped with mo legroom like a seat in economy flight! No place to rest head. Sound average. Exit sign so brught it lot the whole room up. No ushers to shoosh the crowd who were all talking during the movie........felt like a lecture hall. And its all down in a cellar and the waitung area looked like a cafeteria! || This is an old-school movie theater, with an intermission in the middle of the movie. We were a little late to the movie and saw a huge line before the  box office. Luckily they started playing about half an hour after the published time, so we got to see everything.

Definitely a must, beautiful,  colorful, sometimes funny, Vegas/ cirque du soleil quality show, and I've seen a bunch. Family friendly, tickets are very reasonably priced considering the quality of the show. ( paid about $40?) || I remember the time When the show was a part of the things to do in a hotel. I guess they made it a show of it's own.. So if you come with normal expectations it's. A great show . I had fun the others seem to have fun A small theater I was in the first row like I like it ...I'd recommended it. Not expensive and a nice way to pass the evening || Love the WOW show. I go every year, and I get the WOW effect each time. Highly recommended. || We was in the "Wow" show it was crazy and very beautiful, a lot of acrobatics and crazy dancers also The decor is perfect, as are all the clothes the dancers wore... A fascinating show, highly recommended even for small children, great entertainment. || The show is just WOW! Great for everyone! Lots of acrobatic stunts. Always a full house. Highly recommend it for some amazing family fun and great vibes! || Its a great show. It is really amazing. After each scene weshouted wow. Best to sit row 5 in the middle. Highly recommended. || WOW is so amazing that everybody is stunt by the performance. Is mainly composed of acrobatic parts and comedy and is highly recommended. || The wow splash 2 show was excellent and well worth the price. The theater itself was basic but comfortable for the 90 min show. || A great show in Eilat ! A must see in family || Fantastic show, so entertaining. Fun for all the family and nice discount for Isrotel hotel guests.

We came in the morning to have a morning coffee and came out with a smile on our faces, the service is amazing, the barista explained to us what options we have, gave us suggestions, gave a back story on the coffee beans and  different flavors. I can say this was the best cup of coffee I've had in a long time. || Tasteful breakfast, excellent coffee, super service 👍🏻 || Woow! The best coffee in Eilat! || Tasty coffee , great service ! || Best service ..  my friends.. tasty coffee and tea and everything yiu must try !! || The only place in the city with European level drinks and service! Would come again definitely! || Excellent place! New, modern, fancy! Great choice for coffee lovers. || Great place nothing like that in Eilat. I will definitely come back || Amazing spot! Highly recommend! || Thank you very much...

Excellent coffee, excellent price and Maor, the owner, is the manliest man in the country. Highly recommended! || A perfect place to pause for a moment from the noise outside and deliciously delicious || Delicious and fresh place, good service, highly recommended || Maor is a cute guy, great coffee. || Thank you, thank you, thank you.

Love the Cream express! Delicious fresh breakfast and sandwiches. Interesting mix of customers, including locals, tourists, pensioners, hippies and bus drivers. Very accommodating. What a local cafe should be. Open from morning to early afternoon. || Attractive prices (9 ILS for espresso macchiato), good service, coffee is just okay. Atmosphere leaves a little to be desired -- only few tables in the air conditioned area. || Our breakfast was delicious and the guys here were very friendly || I came to eilat after a long bus trip ,looking for a great place to eat , 5 min from the bus station  i found it . a cozy  small restaurant with a huge terrace , great food , even for vegan, all handmade with love , great chill out  and not exspensive. Crema Express is the place for me , great food , friendly owner , all made with love , very friendly to tourists. || Fresh and tasty food. Super-friendly service. One of the best coffees ever! I recommend the croissant with  egg, salmon, and cheese -- a super generous serving that was really delicious. || Amazing service and amazing food! The staff was very personable and friendly. Food was plentiful and really good! There is outdoor and indoor seating. If youre visiting Eilat I highly recommend going to crema express! || Friendly service. Tasty food. || Amazing food, amazing prices, amazing vibes, perfect place. Amazing service too!! || Coffee quality was very good. Croissant was fresh. Staff spoke English. || Great food for a great price. Lovely staff with awesome vibes. Will definately go again. || Thank you very much .

Only good thing about it is they are open fri night and Saturday. || A great little coffee place and bakery! A pleasure to go by, sit and enjoy! || Fantastic place, pastry and coffee first class. Highly recommended. || The cakes and actually all pastry look really really great. Really special. Coffee is good. The almond croissant is big like half a kilo, haha, looks really good. I guess it supposed to be warmed before eating, but I haven't, so the taste was ok, but not great. Maybe my fault. || Great variety of tasty  pastries cakes and sandwiches. Great coffee !  Quick service.  A very good place for a nice break or take away. || Minimarket and bakery. Good solution for coffee in late hours and early morning. According to manager opens at 4:30 || A nice place for a short coffee break before or after your daily shopping, doing in the same place. Personally: it was too strong airconditioning. || Awesome service and really quality, all sweets is made by Alimi and are awesome, coffee one of the best in Eilat also they have store and some basics with normal prices, deserve 5 of 5 || Great street cafe, also a local market so can pick up basic supplies. Barekas fresh and tasty. || Great pastries and very friendly staff. Open on Saturday morning. Good coffee.

This is one of the most amazing Cafes in Eilat and it's in the best hotel! The coffee is delicious ☕️ (better than Aroma!) and the breakfast was first-class! All the juices are fresh and wonderful. The waitress and serve was perfect and fast. We can't wait to enjoy our next breakfast again 🎉 … || We were very happy with their coffee (both espresso and ice coffee) and nice strawberry tart. The atmosphere is very nice, especially at the tables outside. The service has some room for improvement. || The beetroot and orange juice is excellent. I had fish and chips. Everyone enjoyed their dish. The bread sticks with cheese and spinach is also really good. || High-quality food at a relatively high gastronomic level. However, the service not adequate to  enjoy the place. The dishing arrived not in a good synchronization, moreover, the waiters are not sympathetic. We wait a long time to put the order, and then my dish comes first, after half an hour when we were asked what happens with my wife's plate, they bring it! || Very friendly staff, has table service so feels very relaxed. Full menu for food, as well as baked goods. The cappuccino I had was delicious. Multiple staff members spoke both English and Hebrew || Delicious, divine friendly service, beautiful place, very nice atmosphere. || Service wad bad The waiter didn’t take care of us and took much time to service us || Excellent atmosphere ! || A restaurant that we visit often, partly due to the quality and service that were part of the experience. Unfortunately, this is the second time in a row that we have encountered service that is below all criticism. It seems that the waiters are not adequately trained, and a new manager who repeatedly repeats answers of “I don’t have it” and “I’m not allowed”, without any real attempt to provide an answer or solution. When you add to this a price that does not justify the overall experience, the disappointment is great. Very unfortunate and very disappointing

Lovely, clean, and a service with a smile.  It's definitely worth a visit and also a variety of cookies, cakes, and sweets . But I came for the coffee and it's well made . Good coffee !! || I came to Eilat to celebrate my partners 70th birthday with his 4 children and grandchildren. I ordered quite a few cakes and cream puffs. Each and every cake was delicious especially the cream puffs that were drowning in cream😋 || Best place in town. 🎂☕️🥐🥪 My family and I are regular guests for almost eight years, tried many...there's  no comparison. Great choice of sweets also for people who have particular dietary restrictions. The pâtisserie is very delicate and well presented and doesn't feel heavy or too sugary on the palate. The Israeli breakfast options are nice, everything is fresh and tasty and a great choice for a late breakfast. Also the quiche...soooo good! Coffee...absolutely the best ❤️ The staff is lovely, they are always very nice, helpful and kind...by now for us it's like family. The cleanest place around too! Recommended 100% 🔥🔥🔥🔥 || Russian speaking waiter declined to take order in russian. Okay, it's not a big deal. After that we switched to english but she messed with the order 3 times in a raw. Awful. Food tastes good, but I visit such places not only for food but for good service too. So, if you looking for good service it's wrong place. || Great coffee and pastry. Cool vibe, friendly and delicious. The Israeli breakfast was fresh , rich and very tasty. Highly recommended || Tasty coffee! Have a variety of milk substitutes.... In my option the place lack of  vegan food choices. Other than that, lovely experience. Along the side the road with intimate vibe. || Good coffee! A variety of cakes and cookies to eat there or to take home. Even vegan and non sugar (for diabetics). And the most important for me... No loud music. One can talk there with the people he's sitting with. || Very professional! Fulfilled my every wish! Thank you one more time! As I heard, the cake was very tasty! See you when I come to Israel!!! 💙 … || Unfortunately I'm talking about my favorite coffee shop. ... Over the past few months something has  changed and the bad service or lack of it made us think twice before going there.. Yesterday we decided to go and have coffee there, at our favorite place .. We ordered our usual cold coffee . Ten minutes later the waitress came and said : " I'M SORRY BUT WE DON'T HAVE GLASSES FOR THE COFFEE. WOULD YOU LIKE ME TO PUT IT IN A TAKE AWAY --  DISPOSABLE  CUP" ???     DA-AAAA????? She was quite serious ..though we were in shock ... REALLY???  You don't have glasses for the drinks ??? Is it a proper business or not ?? Are they jocking ?? Go and wash a glass ... Or go and buy a glass ...  steal one if need be 😉 They were in shock when we got up and left..... Maybe we were too demanding.. Difficult customers... Conclusion ; mustn't forget to bring my own cold coffee glass from home next time Disaster. !!! || Very busy, good cakes

Came here with the family after reading the reviews. It totally lives up to the hype. The raapberry sorbet was simply sublime as were the alvis and apple pie. Amazing. Worth the trip. Uri is a great host and his love and attention to detail show through. || Thank you very much 😊 … || Oh what a charming and surprising spot in Eilat. Uri, the owner, prepares fresh boutique ice cream everyday and offers you a nice veriety of premium ice cream with no added b/s. Uri will let you taste the different flavours and will elaborate on the process of making ice cream and how he became an ice cream chef. Almost forgot, the taste is just great || Thank you very much😊 … || Super special experience!! Outstanding flavours. Don't be confused, its inside a price houses neighborhood :) || Thank you very much 😊 … || Forget all the touristic attractions in Eilat, Serenity Ice Cream is the one thing you absolutely must try.  Uri, runs in his small home workshop the best hand made ultra quality ice cream you can taste in Israel. You’ll have hard time to choose between the different options and then very hard time to select the specials products.  Uri goes above and beyond explaining every detail in the manufacturing, generously provide tasting bites and will suggest the perfect match of types when you’ll find yourself stuck without being able to make a decision.  First time you’ll absolutely want to give a visit to Uri’s workshop. Then after you can simple order by phone. || Thank you very much 😊🙏 … || Uri really likes what he does! I really like ice cream and this ice cream is one of the BEST I had.  He is also very attentive to families with kids and is very friendly in general.  It is a great feeling supporting a small business owner AND having a delicious ice cream experience!  The place is in the yard of a private house so do not be surprised to find yourself is the suburbs when navigation to the location :) || Thank you very much 😊 … || Omg this has to be a contender for the best ice cream in the world. The product is hand crafted on location. This place should no longer be any secret. If you are visiting Eilat, you will be thankful forever for searching out this hidden gem. This isn't just ice cream, this is Art. || Thank you very much 😊 … || If you arrive at this ice cream shop and start wondering if your navigation led you to the wrong place – just take a few more steps. You’ll see the tables, the sign with the shop’s name, and realize you’re exactly where you should be.  The ice cream is absolutely amazing – both the dairy and the sorbet. Each flavor is precise, refreshing, and clearly made with high-quality ingredients and lots of love.  But what truly makes the visit special is the owner – a kind, funny, and genuinely interesting person to talk to. Without even realizing it, you’ll find yourself finishing your delicious ice cream while enjoying a lighthearted and engaging conversation, with a smile on your face and a warm feeling in your heart. He spread positivity, and love in every interaction.  When I return to Eilat, this will definitely be one of the first places I visit again. || Thank you very much 😊 … || This is the best ice cream i’ve ever had in my entire life! The man selling it is so polite and sweet. The prices are very reasonable for homemade ice cream of such good quality. You can see attention to every tiny detail. It’s made with love to the business and the customers. I’m so glad i randomly found this cafe on google maps. I highly recommend everyone to taste this at least once. Thank you, Serenity Ice Cream! || Thank you very much 😊 … || Wow, amazing ice cream, the owner loves his work and his passion is felt in every bite || Thank you very much 😊 … || When walking down the street, I didn’t think there was going to be an ice cream shop. It was out of a guys house in a pretty residential area. After eating it I can honestly say it’s the best pistachio ice cream I’ve had since living in Sardinia Italy. Just pure quality ingredients and love going into it || Thank you very much 😊 …

Oh this is a hidden gem! Great variety of ice cream tastes and each one is very special and delicious. The staff is super friendly, explaining and offering to taste. Be sure to order your ice cream served in a home-made waffle! || Since 1958 and still operating, one of the oldest and first ice cream places in Israel. With the 3rd generation this ice cream is superb, with a warm and friendly service enjoy the flavors with your palette. Enjoy :) || Home made ice cream. The place MUST renew the tables, charis, entrance. Besides.. the flavours are great, i took milk pictaccio it was very tasty. I also add a whipped cream and hot chocolate , honestly its too much flavours in a cup. Its defently a high level of raw material. The serving is in a home made cone in plastic cup ( very uniq) very tasty. Free and a lot of parking. Great service. || Best ice cream in Israel, same great taste since I was a child. || Very unique and tasty homemade waffles, filled with scoops of joy. Highly recommended, worth the detour from the touristic area. || One of the best ice cream we eaten in israel || Very god ice cream store, reasonable price, home made, highly recommended,🏅 … || The older the place, the better the flavors.  Great price for delicious special ice cream.  Most recommended! || Probably one of the oldest running ice cream shops in Israel.  It is located rather far away from the madding crowds- not in the touristic center- so it is more known for the locals. Have been enjoying their ice cream since the 80's and like magic, the place hasn't changed, the ice cream the same. || Some of the best ice cream I've ever tasted for the lowest price I've ever payed for one. Great service and old styled decoration. Would absolutely recommend to try if you're ever in Eilat.

We had delicious ice cream tonight at Golda’s. Anna gave us the best service! The place is nice and clean sure will come back || Amazing vegan ice cream options! 🍨 The banana and date and coconut flavours are both delicious. … || The service was great 😊👍 Really sweet staff, the ice cream was designed really cool but way to sweet for me, however everyone else seemed to like it. The only thing that shocked me were the topping prices. I could honestly care less myself however when you have a family with kids it could get a bit expensive. However for anyone who loves high quality, fresh made ice cream this is the place. (I recommend the pretzels sauce 😁) || Loved the place, best one in Eilat! Everything was delicious, Anna gave us the best service, she was trully patient and so polite! || I loved this place! Everything was delicious, and I was very well taken care of by Anna she was so patient and polite! || Great atmosphere and excellent ice cream!. Anna was amazing, super attentive and friendly! || The best ice cream! Anna's customer service is impeccable || We had delicious ice cream tonight at Golda’s. Mia and Inbar gave us the best service! They are the best!! || Golda is great as always... Just take the loacker, the rest is just a bonus || I’ve literally been to 10+ branches all over Israel.  The ice cream was the same as everywhere else but the size we got served was tiny (half the normal size at least) When my girlfriend said something, they replied by saying this is what you get here, if you want more you can pay for it. Worst value for your money in Eilat.

5* flavours and portions! || A lot of fresh juice and shakes...3 size glasses, and yogurt ice cream..pizza, fried potatoes || Small and dirty. You can find more comfortable beach near far. || Very very good ice cream! Great service Higley recommended || Best yogurt and ice cream in Eilat! Really recommended. || Best milkshakes and soft ice cream || Very good frozen yogurt

My daughter had a simple scoop of ice cream with chocolate and I had yogurt with toppings. What I liked about the place was mostly the sense of attention from the seller, he gave my daughter colorful candies and for me he prepared the yogurt in layers in a way that made every bite perfect, a super cute, simple and delicious place. || We arrived as a family of 7 adults and a girl, residents of Eilat. We heard really good comments about the place, the service is really disappointing. There were two young friends, one shorter, who was very pleasant and helpful, worked with gloves, very neat and clean. The other was a taller guy, not helpful, not pleasant, worked without gloves, the fruits that fell on the table, he put back into the glass with his hands. When we asked if we could put the girl in the bathroom, he said yes, when in fact the bathroom is not working properly and the situation there is terrible. Very sad, very disappointing, we will not be back again. || Crazy service, the best I've ever seen, will go back there many more times, very tasty || Always clean and shiny Always with good service, a smile and giving Regular customers in the business And we have never been disappointed Even when we ordered deliveries! Recommend with warmth and love Because it really deserves it! || Amazing place, perfect service, Nathan the owner was smiling and generous, and most importantly, everything was delicious at the highest level🍦💜Highly recommended🥳 … || I recommend to anyone who wants a delicious and refreshing dessert to come to Tsofapi. Amazing service and an amazing business owner deserve every compliment you can give and great prices. || High praise, Amala, service 300 from 100, I enjoyed it very much, the children and I will come back again, very tasty || An ice cream parlor with an amazing service experience provided by an employee named Elian! She was patient, pleasant, and made sure everything was good and nothing was missing. || I was at the ice cream parlor and received amazing service from Aliane! She was patient, smiling, and made me a perfect crepe that enhanced the experience ❤️ || Great place, good atmosphere, music, nice vendors, relatively good prices, and most importantly, everything is insanely delicious.

Best ice cream and perfect costumer support Recommend for Elat || I have to compliment Mor from Golda Eilat – kind, patient and smiling service. He helped us choose, explained things pleasantly and gave the feeling that it really mattered to him that we were satisfied. A service experience that really makes you want to come back. Well done! 🍦� … || I have to share a shocking experience of lack of service I went into the branch to buy ice cream while I was sitting I asked the saleswoman if I could put my cell phone on the charger for a few moments until I finished the ice cream The saleswoman told me no even though there were 4 free chargers behind her and I told her it was literally for a few moments until I finished even after I asked three times In short, shocking service at the level of not going anywhere near! There is no shortage of good people to support || Clean and tidy branch, excellent location with space to sit outside. Professional and courteous service of a high standard, excellent coffee. Well done, keep it up. || There is a sign at the entrance asking if we have tried their coffee. The answer is yes now and it was not successful to say the least. I did not drink. 2 stars because the girls did a good job after all. It is recommended to take down the sign and focus on the excellent ice cream. || We went in to buy a Dubai dessert We were served by the lovely Malin and Nicole who served other people and it was nice to hear her service Also the place is clean and the owners Roni and Moshe who were present there were helpful to everyone Recommended!! || I have to share a great experience from my last visit to Golda! The store was exceptionally clean, tidy and pleasant – you can really see that someone here takes care of the little details. And I can't help but mention Uri Zikry – the highest level of service I've ever encountered. Always with a smile, patience and good energy, he makes the place what it is. Uri is simply a professional – you can see that he invests, cares about the customers and the general atmosphere. Well done for the amazing service, I will definitely be back again – thanks to him! || We had an amazing experience. Mor and Moshe spoiled us and it was really delicious! || The Golda is open on Shabbat and therefore not kosher. It sucks that there are two Goldas within half a kilometer of each other and both are not kosher || Shai Uri and Daniel, the sweet salespeople at the branch, were amazing! Despite the stress, the rush, and the customers' nerves, they were polite with a smile and tried to calm the atmosphere. Worth it!

place_name: Yummy Yummy, a world of tastes
reviews_content: One of the best dessert places in town. They offer some fresh yogurt and fruits or ice cream. From French crepe to Thai ice cream it lives up to its "yummy" name.  However the prices are very high, so if you have more than one child, it will be an expensive treat. The sitting area is outdoors, the ice cream will melt fast. || Great flavours, very clean and organized They offer rolled ice cream, shakes, waffles and several other deserts. The rolled ice cream was very good and satisfying, The staff is kind, constantly cleans the place and keep it well organized. || Good taste, nice and clean. Helpful staffs. Great customer service. Although not wide variety of collections of ice-creams. Cheap price. || Absolutely fabulous! The service was wonderful, the pancakes were delicious and the ice cream - simply divine. One of the best places in Eilat. We will definitely come back || Very nice ice cream store, multiple varieties of iced cream, the staff are nice , place is clean, not to much place for seating inside,is impossible for hot days.. recommend for the Thailand ice cream varieties, very tasty.. in overall very recommend place..🍨🧁 … || Ice cream labels are only in Hebrew. The pistachio ice cream was average at best, but the bubblegum flavor was nice! || Excellent Icecreame!!!, the place is a bit small but people are very nice, not cheap || Like the name this place is all YUMMY! Everything from the Thai Ice Cream to their waffle on a stick is just mouth watering good. If your out with the kids looking for something sweet or just feeling like a big kid yourself you will love this place! They got ice cream, waffle on a stick, mini pancakes and so much more sweets. || Very nice and helpful staff! Ate the tai ice cream, it's a big serving so consider sharing or come hungry :) || The type of place you say - I am too hungry to go anywhere else - it doesn't look fantastic but the taste is just perfect! We choose it because it was serving local cousin and everywhere else was something touristic... Irish pub (which I love while I visit Ireland) and pizza ( which is perfect during trip to Italy) . So glad to find it!

Rami makes and sells his wonderful gelato from his home. Super light and creamy, we were delighted by the chocolate flavour which was almost mousse like, and the anona-passionfruit which was perfectly balanced. Call ahead to make sure Rami is home. || Hi, my name is Joy. I'm a Filipino foreign worker here in Israel. I just want to say thank you and appreciate the great customer service in Gelato Vivo the best Ice cream in Eilat, of Sir Rami and his wife in helping me surprise my best friend with their delicious and mouth watering gelato ice cream. They've done an extra mile. It was superb!!! || best icecream in town ..   try the blue bubblegum, apple or cheese cake and its amazing.   also their icecream doesnt have alot of sugar which is very nice || We were at a gelato workshop at his home. His hospitality is commendable, he invited every child to participate, explained everything about the process of making ice cream with various ingredients, and gave us a few tastes that we wanted - and the kids wanted a lot. The ice cream is high quality and delicious, with a subtle sweetness. || With love and joy, to give quality and taste || Rami is a wonderful person! We attended a workshop with him and he treated all the children wonderfully, and of course the ice cream is excellent, and surprisingly cheap! || Real homemade ice cream in a variety of flavors. You can get a taste and then take it home, recommended! || We liked the flavors of lemonade, strawberry and half chocolate, half hazelnut the most. The price was great. It was delicious and homemade and not too sweet like we like. Highly recommend. || We were looking for a kosher ice cream parlor in Eilat and came across Rami. His gelato is high quality, delicious and affordable. He happily hosted us for a tasting and we really enjoyed the gelato. Highly recommended!! || Thank you and with love, and hoping for a day of workshop with friends and family. || We had the pistachio-flavored ice cream - one of the best we've ever had. Excellent service, highly recommended! || Like this in Eilat on the south coast, suddenly a nice man arrives with real Italian ice cream, even coconut flavored. A real treat. Recommended || Happy for your response, have fun and enjoy, maybe we'll see you again next week.

This well lies on the outskirts of the Great Arab Revolt Square, near the Aqaba port dock. It was dug in 1918 by order of one of Jordan's most prominent figures during the nation's founding, Mr. Muhammad bin Ahmad al-Asad, father of the scholar Nasir al-Din al-Asad. Mr. al-Asad was the governor of Aqaba (administrative ruler) and director of customs at that time. Therefore, it is called the Lion's Well after its builder. It is also called the Lady's Well after Sayyida Zaynab, the Mother of the Believers (may God be pleased with her), as Mr. Muhammad al-Asad dedicated this well as a waqf (endowment) in her memory. || A nice historical landmark that is over 100 years old, located near the Sidr tree.

Eilat Bazar is a simple, small market located not far from the central hotel area of Eilat. It offers a basic shopping experience with a few stalls selling clothing, souvenirs, beach gear, and everyday items. The place is convenient if you happen to pass by, but it doesn't stand out compared to other shopping options in the city.  The variety of shops is limited, and many of the products feel repetitive. Prices are generally fair, but some items seemed overpriced for the quality. If you enjoy bargaining, you might be able to get a slightly better deal, but don’t expect huge discounts.  The atmosphere is calm, and the open space with its covered sections provides some shade, which is appreciated in Eilat’s hot weather. Still, it can feel quite empty at times, especially in the middle of the day when the heat is strongest.  Overall, Eilat Bazar is fine for a quick visit if you're nearby, but it’s not a "must-see" attraction. If you're looking for a wider range of shops and activities, other malls like Ice Mall or Mall Hayam offer a much better experience. I would rate it three stars – a decent but unremarkable stop during your stay in Eilat. || Lots of different stuff, different prices. The Eilat promenade is one of those places you go to when you want a mix of calm and energy at the same time. It’s clean, long, and full of life. You walk next to the water, feel the breeze, and you just get this quiet moment even when there are people around. At night it looks even better all the lights, the music from the shops, the vibe. It feels alive.  The food stands and stores are nice, but some of them feel a bit too touristy. Prices are high, and not everything feels worth it. Still, you can always find something good to eat or grab a drink and just chill near the water.  The best part is the view. The mountains on one side, the Red Sea on the other you feel like you’re in a different place for a moment. It’s the kind of spot where you sit, look around, and just breathe a little slower.  Overall, the promenade is a great place to walk, relax, and enjoy the city. It’s not perfect, but it gives you a moment you don’t get in most places. || The place is crowded with lots of people. There are many restaurants and shops along the promenade. There are also girls who do braids with extensions, which is very unique and nice. While the price is a bit high compared to free nearby spots, the underwater experience is spectacular- vibrant corals, colorful marine life, and plenty to see. Most seating areas are shaded with white canopies, which helps, though it can still get extremely hot in July and August.  Some downsides include ongoing renovations, which limit access to newer sections and make planning a snorkeling route a bit challenging. The designated swimming areas are small and enclosed, but beyond the bridge, there are vast open spaces where you can really explore and see a lot of beautiful marine life.  Overall, it’s more comfortable and enjoyable to snorkel in a well-supervised, maintained area than in unofficial sites, and the beautiful coral and abundant sea creatures make it well worth a visit.  * Pros: Clean and organized, lifeguards on duty, beautiful corals and marine life, showers and restrooms, accessible. * Cons: Entry fee is high compared to free alternatives, renovations limit some areas, enclosed swimming zones can feel small, it can get very hot in summer. || Snorkelling is ok. Free beach and they offer lounge chairs and snacks! || Very cool beach, only with rocks and perfect for snorkeling and diving. Location well equipped with bar, umbrellas and deckchairs. || Great beach for snorkeling. Gear rental on site. Picnic tables, shade and food. || Heaven for snorkelling, especially for nervous snorkellers: they have designed a snorkelling 'route' around the reef with a rope you can use for guidance and feeling a bit more secure. The marine life is amazing with huge colourful fish. They rope of the main reef to protect it from damage from selfish tourists, but you can still see it from the edge. Beach has plenty of shade and chairs. All equipment and lockers available. Take your own food  as all you can get here are french fries or frozen pizza they heat up. You can get here by a 5 minute bus from the main area of Eilat. || Very well organized for snorkeling but maybe too much... in the water you can’t really get close to the corals and there are many people at the same place so not so wild as you could expect. || Great experience. Lots of space to sit. The snorkelling was great fun and there were lots and lots of fish. || Good facilities with snorkel hire, locker hire, shower, toilets etc. However, you have to view the coral in a guided lane, which is very restrictive. The coral is better in other places along the coast, but there was a decent variety of fish to see. || It's a place with shower, toilets, diving equipment to rent, shops and more. There public bus lines getting you from any point of Eilat to this Nature Reserve Beach. In Hebrew: חוף האלמוג Hof Halmog. The beach is huge and very clean. Wonderful for sea nature lovers because there you can see all the sea life just getting in the sea. The Red Sea waters are an spectacle for the clear swimming, good temperature and the lack of waves that allow you to see all the amazing under water life. The entrance is not free. You may need to call to know opening hours and entry ticket prices.

My favorite place in Eilat. || Very interesting place, with very interesting creatures. Please just look and don't touch or take creatures out of the water, it might kill them. Ohhh and watch where you are stepping. :) || Good place to see hand made coral reef. Be aware of stone fish! || I think this place is out of service..at least it looked like it. || We were there in the evening for work. The place is nice but they played music at a deafening volume and it was really unpleasant. Other than that, it was a very nice place. You can splash around in the water while sitting on the rocks. || A lovely place to see the variety of animals in the Karit. This is a unique area where the tides dictate special adaptations to the creatures. Mollusks, crabs, fish, chitons and what not. It's all there. Highly recommended for nature lovers who understand the subject. || An amazing stretch of coast - allows for urban nature, an innovative concept that exists in several places in the country that maintains a nature reserve within the urban life of the city of Eilat. Definitely a gem worth a visit, I was there as a guide for the Society for the Protection of Nature and she presented a broad picture and explanations of the marine animals || Beautiful and interesting especially when the sea is low. You can see various marine animals. Recommended! || Nice place.... Quiet and comfortable atmosphere. Anyone who wants to clear their head and relax this is the right place!!!!

Amazing place: great vibes, great beach, excellent music and DJ!  Come on Friday for the shabbat eve dance party and you won't regret it. Food and drinks are also nice. Staff is busy, but courteous. There is something for everyone.  I've been to Eilat several times and I've never been there. I will ALWAYS stop by there every time I'm there from now on. || Hi Ryan, Thank you very, very much for the kind and detailed feedback, and thank you as well for the positive rating. On behalf of the entire Dekel Beach team, I sincerely thank you. See you again soon. 🌴🌴🌴 || Good clean beach. Chairs are 10 shekels/chair, sunbathing chair 20. Nice food at the restaurant on the beach. Make sure to grab slippers or wet shoes to enter the sea. It's either really hot to walk on the send or really painful to walk on little sharp stones. And bring water:) || Hey Nina  Thanks for your rating and comment  We're very happy to hear that you had a great time at the beach  🌴🌴🍸🌴🌴 … || 2022: Well structured for the beach lover. Clean bathrooms. Good bar service. The site is split into two different styles: - north side has a large wooden deck, suited for those who want to sit by the tables, close to the bar and restaurant; - south side is rustically styled, with straw shades (and also a large canvas tent during summertime). There is chair, table and sunbed rental service available at official prices on both sides. During summertime they also place a floating deck with sunbathing sofas and cushions for rent.  Entry to water is made through carpets on definite corridors in order to prevent visitors from revolving the stones and corals, which is a nice idea. Updated 10/23: entry to the water had been improved by them having removed the larger stones from under those carpets as it was quite impossible not to stumble on them, once we were never able to know where they were. Updated 3/25: The place is clean, beach service has improved. The floating deck isn't there as summer hasn't begun, the beach bar is run by a nice team, and Anna is always serving with her sweet smile and kindness. The only negative points are the lack of trash pots really close to the waterline, as the typical Israeli is spoiled and used to litter and then have someone around to clean and collect after them. Also dog owners are requested to have them leashed at the entrance and then leave them to circulate freely among the bathers, peeing on or even pooing at chairs, sunbeds and even on people's bags, towels and clothes, something unacceptable.  Updated 25/4/2025: The entrance to the water is downgraded as the carpets have been relocated over the rolling stones. I could not find the previous southern path which was comfortable and ready to walk in as the stones had been removed before the setting of the carpet. It's now very hard to walk on it, as the stones under the carpet make it uncomfortable and unbalancing for those to walk in the path. The beach also still lacks trashcans close to the waterline, as the existing ones are located about 8-10 meters from it; I've seen many pieces of paper, plastic cups and popsicle wrap on the sand. Anyway it's still the best beach in Eilat. || HHEY MOSHE  VEY MOSHE THANK YOU SO MUCH FOR YOUR COMMENT LOOKING FORWARD TO SEE YOU SOON AT THE BEACH || Decent beach with a nice relaxed atmosphere. Free entrance, public washrooms are clean. The restaurant has average prices but not too high for beach side. Food is delicious, we had the fried cauliflower and salmon wrap, Turkish coffee and an orange-carrot drink, all for 132NIS with tip included. There is plenty of parking and you can rent a lounge chair or regular chair. Swimming isn’t recommended here because there is no lifeguard but some people went in anyways. Sand is a bit rocky but water looks nice and clear. Some sand flies here and there, wheel chair accessible entrance. || I gave a low score because of my expectations. Maybe they were too high. Not sure.  I come from Haifa. In Haifa the beaches have sand when you enter the water, here there are rocks, so you better bring footware to enter the water. The area of the beach is also very small and no free shade on the sand. There are no changing rooms, so we had to change in the toilets which is very strange for a beach. Showers were only outdoor ones - also very strange IMO.  So if you expect to have a changing room, indoor showers where you can get naked, free shade and easily to enter the water without shoes - this place sucks.  Otherwise the water is nice,  and I had fun swimming here nontheless. || Hi Arthur Thank you very much for your detailed response During the winter we take down all the shades because they are not resistant to the strong winds Even the natural beach in the Red Sea is not as sandy as in the Mediterranean and we make efforts to keep the beach as natural as possible At the end of winter we add access roads from designated and special carpets on the waterfront to allow for easy and safe access We hope you will come again in the future and enjoy the beach Best regards The Palm Beach Team || The best beach in Eilat! Quiet and relaxed  (at least during mid March), great bar and sea view, lots of shade and trees. Enjoy a good Shakshuka in the morning :) || Thank you very much Guy What a happy response Happy Purim (: || Beautiful beach, calm and cozy. There is shade, restaurant, clean bathroom. Rent a chair or bed. Friendly staff. We had lots of fun there with the kids! Food was ok. || Very nice beach with clean water and easy way to the Red Sea. Excelente atmosphere and good services. The chairs cost us small and you can stay all day. Very much recommend. || Very nice beach with nice restaurant, good prices. Nice to spend some time. Small reef 20m from shore. || Nice and clean beach. The entry, the bathroom and the shower is free. During the day was not so crowded, maybe because the water is still a bit cold. 😬😄 The beach is a bit rocky but there is a path to the water. || Dear Bence Thank you for your positive comment and rating  Hope to see you soon at the beach again  🌴🌴🌴 …

Opposite from Princess hotel is perfect place to snorkel. Two piers allow to go to the water in the right place to see colourful fishes and corals. This place was recommended by local divers also. Amazing experience in sunny day. Unfortunately no photos but you have to see it yourself - no any picture don’t give the feeling. || Awesome experience,  I would definitely go there again || Simply superb. Very clean beach and water, sun shades (of course more of them would be even better, especially on summer days), and high fines for leaving garbage, which ensures the beach will stay clean. || Great beach, you need to be careful with how you enter to not damage the corals, lots of fish and Coral to see. || WOW WOW & WOW i have been diving in Eilat for many years and it looks that conservation efforts are working. the abundance of fish of all colors & sizes is astonishing || The best you can do in Eilat, ask for assistance in Manta Ray diving center. || Very dirty and narrow beach. However  corals are 2 meters far from the beach. || Truth l like it how wonderfuly things you   have than, please thank you. || Nice snorkeling, visibility always good

We came 5 mins after 12pm (and tickets are valid also tomorrow from the morning only! - as explained on the cash desk); spent some half day here late March; sea temperature fresh but still acceptable; not so crowded today; beach service collect beach chairs regularly; easy to find place and take chairs, we enjoy hot and cold sweets with coffee and fresh Mint lemonade. Really tasty; recommended; next time I repeat. || Amazing ! Such an incredible experience ! Staff are also amazing ! Estelle was great called me told me best times to come ! Mayaan was so welcoming and beautiful and IRa was amazing guide ! She was brilliant and supported me on my first dive ! Dolphins are everywhere ❤️❤️ || For the standard entrance fee you can swim at the beach and spend some time on the pier to film and shoot the dolphins (pier closes at 5 pm). Then you have a bar restaurant upstairs in a wonderful place (forbidden under 18 years old). From this place you still can see the dolphins, enjoy the sun and even stay until 11 pm! || Great place. We did snorkeling with the dolphins, it was great to see them in their natural habitat. Our instructor was a very nice and professional lady that took care of everyone’s comfort and made sure everyone is safe and have an amazing time. I was really scared of the depth but thanks to her I could overcome my fear and enjoy the moment. I can’t thank her enough. It’s a place one of a kind and people there are very welcoming. I highly recommend, worth every penny. || I had a great expirience to dive with dolphins..its something amazing..also the place its like heaven..its diferent than other places that i saw in Israel. The relaxing pools inside its something special too. I recommand everyone to visit. || Wonderful location, really worth the detour even though it's located on the other side of Eilat. There's also a bar inside where you can order drinks and bites. Service was great and the food was delicious. A big 5! || Very clean beach and not too crowded. Dolphins seem happy and free. Very good diving guides, and great service. They even offered us a refund for  for one who couldn't make it on time, because they had another person who was interested to dive instead. || Very beautiful dolphin reef. Tourist attraction. We saw 3 dolphins. The food here was delicious, totally recommend! There are also student fares for entry. || Dolphin Reef in Eilat is a natural habitat of Dolphins. We can observe the dolphins 🐬 from the floating bridge provided. The dolphins are very playful and you are allowed to touch them if you wish to.  The security staff watches over the dolphins as well as feeds them.Some snorkeling facility is also there. We visited long back. The Dolphin Reef is open from Monday to Saturday.  Timings: 9 am to 5 pm. We spent some time observing the dolphins.  There is an entry fee. || The most wonderful beach in Eilat. It’s like a completely different world everything beautiful and clean and pleasant. The food at the beach restaurant is great. And to watch the dolphins is certainly a bonus 🐬 …

Nice place for the families with children, and for those who want sandy beach. || Very quiet, considering we got to there on a Friday by 7am thru 11am, then the noisemakers began to arrive and, curiously, pigeons landed at the same time and began walking on the sand and pick up food remains. Differently from most beaches in what, this one is mostly sand and quite no gravel. Clear water, a few car-sized beautiful corals at about 6 meters deep. || Nice facilities and less crowded. The place is popular with jet ski and SAPS. No lifeguard. Reasonable prices for coffee and food. Fine selection of Israeli music, not too load. || Simple Free parking No lifeguard || Peaceful and quiet place to stay! || Public beach between the Navy and commercial ports. Free entrance, free parking and free standing umbrellas. Just park your car and dive in the cool waters of the Red Sea. || We took a banana ride and it was great! The milkshake was excellent. The beach was quiet despite peak season (Sukkoth). || Very quiet not crowded and has a great entry to the water with no stones but lacks food services so it's really for quiet picnic or beer at the beach || 26 degrees on December || Nice environment, good music, various water sport activities and cold beer ... Should I ask for more?...

We went snorkeling here and it was an amazing experience! The water is crystal clear, the atmosphere is calm and beautiful, and the staff was absolutely outstanding — friendly, helpful and very professional. A wonderful place to connect with nature and relax. Highly recommended! || Absolutely loved it! The dolphins were so cute and the entrance was gorgeous! Defenitatly recommend if you are coming to Eilat. I would recommend to come early in the morning if you want to choose a good spot to spend the rest of the day. It gets crowded but there are still a lot of places under the trees to hide from the sun. The water was super clear and security was okay. || Absolutely stunning and trippy place. Beautiful views and amazing to see real dolphins so close! || Excellent spot to come in the morning and spend all day here. Really enjoyed it!  The dolphins can be a quest to see but with some patience and luck- you will! || Very beautiful tourist attraction! We saw 3 dolphins here! It’s about a luck to see them comming from the open sea! Student discount on the entry. Very delicious food in restaurant! || Suchhh a beautifull place to watch dolphinsss, the dolphins are free to wander in the ocean which beautifully symbolized how free they are and just how they love their care takers enough to come back all the time to hang around us! Beuaitufl resort right next to a very aesthethic looking wooden structure with a sight and a bar and places to sit every where on, on the wooden water floating structure u also get great and beautiful ocean views and can see the dolphins in the big circle! Before the wooden structures there's of course a beach u can chill in and just wander around shops and soveniers 💕✨ || I have very mixed feelings about this place. We do end up here every time we come to Eilat and I like that the dolphins are free to come and go as they please BUT it’s very expensive and crowded. You just catch short glimpses of the dolphins (true it’s because they aren’t penned in which is a good thing). All of the activities cost extra and the prices are extremely high. I dunno, it’s only a so/so experience. We’ve had a much better time at some of the free beaches. The food is typical beach food with typical beach prices although I will say the Greek salad I had for lunch was quite tasty. I guess I would say, this doesn’t need to go on your Must Do list but if you’re out of activities and you need a few hours to kill, this isn’t terrible. || Very nice beach that combines everything. The price a bit high for family but its worth it if you didn't visit there. The food in the restaurant is great and the service is good. The relaxing place inside requires extra price and very expensive I should mention.. The dolphins are amazing and there is explanation in Hebrew and English. Most of the place is shaded and even if it full there's enough chairs and place for everyone:) || Great place, similar to an oasis. I would recommend to come early in the morning if you want to choose a good spot to spend the rest of the day. It gets crowded but there are still a lot of places under the trees to hide from the sun. || It’s very crowded but we had a blast swimming with the dolphins. It’s ideal for a family with kids. If coming with no kids, the reef restaurant is 18+ and a quiet, gorgeous place to relax without the mayhem of all the children running around.

This beach strip west of Dolphin Reef is a great place for a relaxed family day by the sea. The coastline is beautiful and the water is extremely clear, perfect for snorkeling if you bring your own mask. We even saw a variety of fish close to the shore.  There are several shaded seating areas, big enough for multiple families to sit comfortably. The beach is clean, and some parts are accessible with strollers or wheelchairs. Parking is paid, but reasonably priced. It was around 25 NIS for 4 hours, so roughly 6–7 NIS per hour, which is a very good deal for Eilat.  Keep in mind, there are breakwaters with ships on the right side, so it is not the most romantic view, although some people were jumping from there into the water for fun. The area is windy at times, which can actually be refreshing in warmer seasons.  We visited at the end of October, and it was not crowded at all. I can imagine it gets much busier during high season, but overall, a very enjoyable and convenient beach experience for families. || A very good place for free diving, even for beginners. Not so much for snorkeling, as things are starting to be interesting at about 2 meter deep up to 30. No bathrooms, shore-side showers, enough shade for ~100 people, I'd say, paid parking depending on the time. || If your lucky, you just might see a dolphin.  Clean, free, quiet. Plenty of shade. No life guard! No shops, or food near by. || A big beach with no amenities at all. You might see Dolphins there as they get out of the reef. There is no shade at all so coming in the middle of the day is not advised. The beach is about to change-you can see the works and with that more people will come... || Katza beach is my favorite in Eilat , with the editions of water and shaded area this beach has become very welcoming for young people , best for freediving and snorkeling and scuba diving, the old peer columns are amazing healthy artificial reefs and house many interesting marine species such as colorful fish and even an accessional dolphin from the near by dolphin reef || One of the best beaches in Eilat, perfect for snorkeling or scuba diving, but you need to bring your own equipment. Many fishes and coral reefs. Be careful, sharp stones!  Btw: there is a shower!! || Pure, unspoiled beach. Where desert meets the sea. Awesome view. Take note, its a naturecreserve so swim only where permitted to protect0 the marine tresure. Nice shaded areas and a cute  bus/kiosk || Great beach, but no showers or toilets. Many times you can see dolphins plays in the area which is amazing. || Some nice attributes like fresh water showers. 3 shade tents. Nice reefs at a variety of depths. You don’t have to go far but two great reefs further out and the wharf piles have a lot of new coral anemones etc || There are nice colorful fish and some spots of live coral, but that doesn't negate the lack of basic amenities like toilets, proper shading, and a kiosk or some other food vending capacity. Probably more locals here than tourists (for the above reasons), definitely not crowded at peak season. We came across some roudy behavior, but overall pretty chill. Bring plenty of water and food or you're risking dehydration.

בטח 😊  > Mosh Beach is a perfect spot for a relaxed, laid-back vibe 😌. Seating on cozy mats and cushions makes it even more comfortable 🧺🛋️. The inviting blue sea sets the tone for a peaceful day by the water 💙🌊. Don’t miss the signature dish — the Desert Plate 🍽️ — a must-try that completes the experience beautifully ⭐ || Amazing place, gets the best of Sinai bedouine camps and Israeli luxury. You can easily spend the entire day at this place or leave and watch your place gets taken in a blink of an eye by visitors preying on free location. Their dishes seem pricey at first but impressively well done and filling. The staff and visitors are all in a good mood, our dog was a big hit with everyone and got so many pets. Not much coral in the water, but large schools of fish gather nearby sometimes. Highly recommend the Sabich, the Jahnun at saturday and the Ice Coconut with espresso. || Mosh is a nice hippie beach restaurant in Eilat. The prices for food are reasonable. Reggae music and lots of flies. The beach itself is, like anywhere in this town, not so great. It's small, with fences and pebbles. I have been to much better beaches around the world. But I like the hippie vibes and the unfiltered draft beer. Cheers. || Nice place to hang by the sea, weekend too crowdy. Could not find a place to drink beer, they don't serve anything unless you sit in the bar || Well, I finally got to Mosh's beach. The truth is that now I'm back in the East for a year and I really felt like I was in the East, but also in Israel, an amazing beach, fun to get in the water, a great atmosphere, highly recommended to everyone who hasn't been to the East, a great place for delicious food. || Definitely the greatest and coolest restaurant/bar in Eilat - 420 friendly :) Amazing ambiance, outdoor tables under trees and on the beach with great views on the see and Eilat golf.  The waiters are very friendly, food is very tasty.  On Friday and Saturday morning i strongly recommend the Shekshuka (crushed tomatos cooked with oignons, garlic and eggs). It is served with salad and a whole "Hala" (traditional Shabat bred)/  Price are very very fair, which for this kind of place, is very surprising. || This was one of the best beaches I've ever been on. The atmosphere is so calm and comfortable, the service is excellent and friendly. Everything is made to make you feel happy) We've met many great people there. If you visit this place once, you will return again and again ❤❤❤ || What can you say... it's the closest thing to Sinai we have in Israel, nice staff, good food. Great atmosphere!! || Very relaxing place with great vibes and beautiful scenery. The waitering staff is super friendly and efficient. This is by far the best beach in Israel :) it has a vegetarian restaurant and a shop. The food is great though a tad expensive, but so are other beach restaurants while serving food not half as good. || Very relaxing, nice designs and a fun atmosphere. But there are many rocks in the water. You may want to buy special shoes for entering the water as being barefoot in them is difficult and not very pleasant, you could get a scratch or two.

place_name: קפה מלכה אילת - Coffee Malka Eilat
reviews_content: Crazy place! Service ten! Food twenty! And atmosphere thirty! My wife and I came to celebrate our tenth wedding anniversary, we did not regret it. We still feel the taste on our tongues. We will definitely be back!!!! || Great cafe for breakfast Everything is fresh and delicious If you serve wholeheartedly, you always look around, you don't have to raise your hand when they come to you twice during the meal, they ask if everything tastes good, everything is fine It's amazing that there is such service at the edge of Eilat In connection, if the food is simply delicious The picture after the liquidation || Amazing place! The service experience was exceptional!!! The employees were charming and pleasant to talk to. The food was excellent and the atmosphere of the place was rustic and homely. I will definitely come back and recommend it to my acquaintances. Thank you for a once in a lifetime experience🩷🩷 || We arrived in Eilat for a family vacation in one of the apartment complexes. Downstairs in the lobby is Malka Cafe, a nice cafe, with pleasant music, high-quality food at a reasonable price. Service was good, it was not busy at all in the morning. We ordered a double breakfast, toast and a sandwich for the kids and enjoyed every bite. The condiments were varied and delicious! Plenty of parking outside. And dessert??? Wow! Highly recommended! || My experience was as follows. It took a long time for the coffee and the dinner we ordered to arrive. Clearly unprofessional service. The food came with really hard bread. The salads are fresh. The omelet is really small. The place is air-conditioned, it's right in the lobby of the building. I wouldn't go back in the next year. Maybe in the next few months they'll start to realize that they need really good management. After all, they're new. See you maybe in a year. || I came to have breakfast and waited 40 minutes – shameful service! And in the end I still had to pay. And the worst part – there were no people in the place at all! I really do not recommend this place || The waitress Rachel is charming and kind, the food is good and the atmosphere is very pleasant. The place is air-conditioned and spacious and cozy. || The experience was very disappointing. Considering the high prices, there is no justification for such a poor experience. We do not intend to return there. || We had a delicious and luxurious breakfast!! Everything is fresh! Excellent service and a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere ❤️ We will be back || Fresh, delicious, fast and excellent service. Special dishes and everything is served aesthetically.

Busy popular place.  Manager very gracious and quick to find us a comfortable spot.  Great music playing and open space to see the water view no matter where  you’re seated.  Our server could have been a bit more attentive but he looked quite young and I will just assume it’s a lack of experience.  But he was always kind and polite and ready to help when we got his attention.  Highly recommend this place. Fun, great food, even kid friendly || If anyone tells you that there are no good places to eat out in Israel, just come to the Ninth Beach in Eilat. The food is delicious, the service exceeds expectations, and the atmosphere has its own vibe. Am here every time when visiting Eilat. || A bar on the beach next to the mall in Eilat. They have a vegan menu, which is impressive in Eilat (unfortunately). The view and the shade are wonderful to sit with friends and family. The alcohol is pretty expensive, but it makes sense to the position of the restaurant. || Evening review: nice atmosphere. Calm and relaxing music. Menu is good (simple food but sometimes it's exactly what you need). What we didn't like: waiter (name starts with D) had 2 mistakes in bill (total mistake value of about 25 USD). We told him and he canceled just one of them. Refused the other was a mistake. Shame because otherwise nice place. Prices are decent though. || Summery: good place for a group who want different kinds of dishes. Food is good, prices are reasonable.  There is only one way to describe the food- OK. Its not bad in any way, tasty to eat even, but not exceptional in any way. I can say this after tasting everyone's dishes, and after asking them. This place is really a jack of all trades but master of none, which is great if you have a big family that wants different things (like us).  Service is great: fast, professional, kind. Cant ask for more.  Atmosphere is great, lighting, music, the option to sit by the sea (we didn't) is all very attractive || Honestly we didn’t expect much and were looking for a spot by the water. But the food is just great!! Really amazing experience, was really full when we arrived but fortunately we got a table. Prices are average for Eilat. || Nice place for breakfast and dinner! Restaurant and seats just few feets from the sea. Prices are good. Breakfast for one was very good and cost about 15€. Burger was ok, price about 16€. Breakfast for two adults and a three year old child cost us 150 NIS. That was about 35€. Well recommended! || The food and service were perfect, I would reccomend coming at a decent hour (19:00-21:00) before rush hour to actually test the waters, Our waitress (Ziv) was spectacular, she was super welcoming and fast with eyecontact service, she came with all of our food at once. Very calming music, super cute I would recommend this place for a date, dinner with friends, familly outing and even meetings. || Recommended! When you are on the beach, go and have some drink! We picked mango cosmopolitan - good one, and Nine beach speciality, i dont really remember the name of the drink, but it was mojito with watermelon and kiwi twist - best one! It really tastes great 😍 and the cakes, oh, no words needed. Staff was nice, attentive, also when i asked if they have gluten free cakes, the waiter recommended me some, and went to double check with the chef, without my request - which I found really nice! In Israel is food more expensive, so don't be surprised if your bill is higher lol. || So the location and overall vibe are simply stellar! Music is good and a normal volume (which is rare for these kinda beach bars). But the service is simply horrible! I took a seat and they were quick to give me a menu and a drink but they never returned after that. I even asked them to take my order and the waitress said; "one minute" and never returned. To make it even worse; the waitress was constantly chatting with what appeared to be her personal friends a table next to me for nearly an hour!

Exceptional food served with a smile- I had burger and fries which was 1/2 pound but I would recommend medium well since medium was a little rare. My wife had a feta salad which was huge and fantastic. We both started with stuffed grape  leaves on bed of tzatziki which was the best I’ve ever had || The portion size is filling, the salmon was well done and the mashed potatoes (dairy) was soft and tasty. The atmosphere is inviting and fun (especially if you sit outside). Great for any craving! || There sure is a reservation-communication problem, however we got sorted out quickly. The atmosphere is relax and feels like home. The food is just great. Tasty and well served. We ordered salads, pasta and a chicken dish. Excellent food!! || The pastas are excellent.  When we came without reservations we were allotted an hour and fifteen minutes even though there were plenty of free tables.  Cordial service.  Happy hour 17-18 Sunday to Thursday. || Best breakfast that money can buy. Clean place which is important when buying food. The owner is sweet and takes care of uncomfortable situations with love. Makes you keep coming back for more. Food is really good and not super expensive. Enjoyed every minute || It was my first time in Branja restaurant and I really enjoyed my visit. I had green shakshuka for lunch, which was really good. The staff is very friendly, they made me feel welcomed. They have an english menu, prices are reasonable. Toilets are very clean. Interior and art on the walls are cool. It's a hip place and I'd go there again. || Love this place! It was our favorite in Eilat and we ate here several times during our short stay. Breakfast all day if you want it. Brunch (on Sundays?) till 5. Really great food at reasonable prices. Happy hours from 5-6 on off nights (Monday-Thurs?) with 2 for one cocktails. The cocktails here are really excellent as well. The Branja Butty sandwich is delicious as was the sweet potato ravioli.  They are very welcoming with a relaxed beachy/artsy vibe. || Food quality great. Nice snd intersting dishes. Culm atmosphere.  Good price. First time their, we will come again || You coming through a lot you must eat here all of the best test the food you can find we enjoy everything we order on the menu do you have English menu and Hebrew really five star service to || Love the place, the vibes in this place. The service was warm and attentive, making us feel welcome right from the start. The food and drinks were exceptional—thoughtfully prepared, with incredible attention to detail and flavors that really stood out. Great place for a breakfast meal. Staff are very friendly and the food is freshly prepared and reasonably priced. Aroma, a good value as always, and such is this one, a typical Aroma coffee shop but with a splendid view on the Red Sea. Still I like their ice coffee and the promptness of their service. But the best part is probably that you can take a restful break there during your shopping in this mall, and since this restaurant is located indoor, you can enjoy the air conditioning which is priceless during the so hot temperatures of the summers in Eilat. || Am a regular costumer in aroma. I ordered cold coffee it was grouse. The barista burned the coffee and it tasted like nothing good.  I feel like I wasted my money there || The workers there are very nice, but not all are vegan aware. Can be improved. The suite was roomy and mostly clean, a really disgusting stain was on the sofa. While they do allow you to smoke in the balcany, they didn't put ash-tray. Overall, if you come with low expectations and the price is low, it should suffice. || I had an amazing stay at Central Park Residence in Eilat! The location is excellent, close to the city center and within walking distance to many shops, restaurants, and the beach. The hotel itself is modern, clean, and very well maintained. So we complain and had to wait 30mins for them to bring us soap so we can finally wash our hands.  As for the internet, the manager did not believe us and kept insisting that the wifi is fine and that there was something wrong with our devices (laptop and two phones). When we complained to her she said that we are blaming her and are being "sarcastic". She then tried connecting it on her phone and after several unsuccessful attempts decided to move us to another room. This third room was fine and the manager offered us free dinner at their dining hall for the night but by that time we had had enough of their bad service and attitude to even care. there were also mosquitoes all over the room, even with the windows closed (there were no nettings) || They promise free parking on site, a pleasant stay for you and your family, the reality is a rude staff, asking me to get my car elsewhere, when asked where in the hotel i could park they said there isnt enough space for everyone, the room was filthy, stained coffe cups and uncomfortable bed. || Choose another hotel. The walls are thin and you can hear all night your neighbour's T.V and music from outside. You won't be able to sleep. The food is o.k || In some areas this hotel smells like garbage — and whatever smells like garbage probably is garbage || I recently stayed at this hotel and I must say, it was a wonderful experience. We came to Eilat for a family vacation, had ordered two apartments and scheduled to meet with the contact lady (Aliza) upon arrival. When exiting the car and standing right at the gate with the app, the first gate opened, so we moved forward with the car. While waiting for the second gate to open, the first gate started closing on our car- my husband tried to stop the progression of the gate (and hopefully to activate the safety sensor that we believed existed), and it continued closing on his hand and broke off part of our car. We then spoke to the apartment owner, who said that we can get the insurance policy of the complex, but then proceeded to send us to someone who sent us to someone who sent us to someone, etc etc, it was obvious that they were just trying to avoid taking responsibility. Regarding the apartments themselves, they were overall comfortable, though there was minimal, diluted hand soap. reviews_content: Love the place great pizza and service vibe is good too and its Glat Kosher They have pizza, Ziva, ice cream, frozen yogurt and many more items || I’m pregnant and I had crazy craving for chorus I ordered and 15 minutes later the delivery was on the way!! Thanks guys really good service. And the taste of course number one in Eilat || I ordered delivery at 10:30 PM, the food only arrived at 12:00 AM. In addition to the extreme lateness, the dish arrived in a shocking condition – smeared, crushed and inedible (there are photos).  When I contacted the restaurant, instead of taking responsibility, I received a complete disclaimer and the blame was placed on the delivery person. From the customer's perspective, this is irrelevant. The responsibility for the quality and packaging of the delivery lies with the restaurant.  Disappointing service, irresponsibility and disrespect for the customer. I do not recommend ordering deliveries from this place. || Sharing an unpleasant experience. And this is after we have been regular Eilat customers once a week since they opened. We ordered 2 pasta dishes, one with cream We waited over half an hour for the dishes when the place was empty, all of this was still bearable. The dishes that arrived: an embarrassing amount of half a dish, (I attached a picture, long press on it and you will see the size of the dish, without eating, one bite was enough to realize that it was inedible) The creamed dish arrived without the cream, without mushrooms, with a taste and texture of vomit. I turned to the girl at the counter and told her: The dish arrived by mistake without the cream, and she answered me: Yes, it is creamed, the cheese is mixed in, I told her okay, but it is not creamed, and there is no cheese inside either. Her answer: "We are not a restaurant." The cream got mixed in. I continued to wait with the dish with the utmost patience, and this time I approached the owner in a very pleasant and quiet manner and told him that I really like them and am a regular customer, but I can't eat the pasta, and there are no mushrooms and no cream. The owner replied: There are mushrooms in the dish, I asked him to show me, and what did he do in response?? He shamefully threw my dish that I had placed on the counter into the trash, and went to the warehouse to prove me wrong by bringing me the prepared vomit sauce from the warehouse so that I would believe him that there were mushrooms in the package. I told him, are you serious? Are you showing me a package? Have you tasted it? He told me yes, deadly. A delusional answer. And he added: We are Pizza Shemesh, that's the concept here. He told my son: Go to Italika (an Italian restaurant in Eilat) and pay 60 shekels for a dish... What is this attitude? And these answers? Is this how they provide service? So it actually turned out that we waited half an hour for a dish that tasted and looked disgusting. We came to Hear with good intentions, we were humiliated, and I just got up and left with 3 children from a place that has zero service in my opinion. My son came up and asked for a credit for the dish. He received it. And in addition, the owner of the house told my son: Go to the chain (to the Shemesh Pizza chain). So, thank you very much for a terrible, tasteless experience. Eilat is a really small city, and yes, we will also go to the chain with a complaint about this service. We could have refrained from mushrooms and a little cheese, but there is a limit, we came to eat, not to fight. || Just fun! Are you wondering whether to eat pizza or maybe ice cream? Really closing the corner and generously. Well done || If I could give it a 0, I would. Slow service at the level of Amala. You can't accommodate something in time. Don't respond to prepayment! This time, I'll spare you pictures and videos. || Top quality ice cream, prices accordingly There is also pizza, this closes the event for those who want, you can start with pizza and continue with ice cream, you can order dessert platters of all kinds I took off a star because of the prices || Especially good service. Super friendly stuff, with products from all over the world you can't really find anywhere in Eilat || Very friendly staff 🙂. Nice variety of frozen fruits at great prices. … || Thank you very much!! || Has a lot of snack from the states and Europe || Must visit best sweetsop || I needed a kosher Badatz box and the owner of the place made every effort to help me make it perfect and I would be satisfied. I will definitely continue to purchase from there! It turned out to be a perfect gift!!! || Wow, they are stunning and they have a stunning girl there with a wonderful attitude towards people, and in general, the basket was stunning and sweet, literally, thank you very much, may God bless you, champions 😘❤️💕 … || Stunning service, courteous and professional attitude.
