They made me an order from the same day and the prices are really reasonable. || I live in the north and I treated my friend and her son who were staying at the hotel to a birthday cake Service even remotely via WhatsApp, above expectations, fast and courteous service Sent pictures of the cakes according to the diameter I want, they have them in stock in the store, and also the balloons they have in stock in the store, affordable price

Best espresso in Eilat. I come here every day. Probably the only place to get a legit flat white, good pastries too || Great coffee! You can buy here also their beans - which is the best souvenir (for myself) to bring home 🥰 … || Awesome. The best espresso and cappuccino I had for a long while. A wide variety of teas, coffee beans and equipment. Quiet, clean, beautiful and inviting. If you like coffee, you got to check this place out. || Thank you very much, we are glad you enjoyed. || Very good place Good prices for coffee beans Big menu of coffee drinks possible to buy some coffee equipment || Despite the large number of cafes and restaurants in Eilat, it is very difficult to find some special coffee you are used to, but in Desert&Sea you can find a place to have a good time and your favorite coffee! || The best coffee place in Eilat with great service. If you are a fan of real taste of coffee - it’s the only one place to visit . Beautiful terrace, wonderful music and perfect service♥️♥️♥️ || Best coffee in town, great pastries and lovely service 💖 || owner was very kind and polite i only bought cold chocolate milk and it was delicious and authentic i would highly recommend || Thank you very much, we're glad you enjoyed it. || A passionate-about-coffee place. Very nice, good coffee, lovely owner. || Thank you very much, we are glad you enjoyed. || good coffee, delicious snacks, cheap. highly recommend!!?

place_name: Go Pri | Frozen yogurt and ice cream
reviews_content: Closed.  Does not exist. || The frozen one is very tasty and the smoothies are also very nice. Great place to stop and refresh yourself. || Liar, there is no name, frozen, fed. || The most delicious fresh shake and excellent service || We searched and searched and didn't find it. || Because your mom sucks.

Lovely, clean, and a service with a smile.  It's definitely worth a visit and also a variety of cookies, cakes, and sweets . But I came for the coffee and it's well made . Good coffee !! || I came to Eilat to celebrate my partners 70th birthday with his 4 children and grandchildren. I ordered quite a few cakes and cream puffs. Each and every cake was delicious especially the cream puffs that were drowning in cream😋 || Best place in town. 🎂☕️🥐🥪 My family and I are regular guests for almost eight years, tried many...there's  no comparison. Great choice of sweets also for people who have particular dietary restrictions. The pâtisserie is very delicate and well presented and doesn't feel heavy or too sugary on the palate. The Israeli breakfast options are nice, everything is fresh and tasty and a great choice for a late breakfast. Also the quiche...soooo good! Coffee...absolutely the best ❤️ The staff is lovely, they are always very nice, helpful and kind...by now for us it's like family. The cleanest place around too! Recommended 100% 🔥🔥🔥🔥 || Russian speaking waiter declined to take order in russian. Okay, it's not a big deal. After that we switched to english but she messed with the order 3 times in a raw. Awful. Food tastes good, but I visit such places not only for food but for good service too. So, if you looking for good service it's wrong place. || Great coffee and pastry. Cool vibe, friendly and delicious. The Israeli breakfast was fresh , rich and very tasty. Highly recommended || Tasty coffee! Have a variety of milk substitutes.... In my option the place lack of  vegan food choices. Other than that, lovely experience. Along the side the road with intimate vibe. || Good coffee! A variety of cakes and cookies to eat there or to take home. Even vegan and non sugar (for diabetics). And the most important for me... No loud music. One can talk there with the people he's sitting with. || Very professional! Fulfilled my every wish! Thank you one more time! As I heard, the cake was very tasty! See you when I come to Israel!!! 💙 … || Unfortunately I'm talking about my favorite coffee shop. ... Over the past few months something has  changed and the bad service or lack of it made us think twice before going there.. Yesterday we decided to go and have coffee there, at our favorite place .. We ordered our usual cold coffee . Ten minutes later the waitress came and said : " I'M SORRY BUT WE DON'T HAVE GLASSES FOR THE COFFEE. WOULD YOU LIKE ME TO PUT IT IN A TAKE AWAY --  DISPOSABLE  CUP" ???     DA-AAAA????? She was quite serious ..though we were in shock ... REALLY???  You don't have glasses for the drinks ??? Is it a proper business or not ?? Are they jocking ?? Go and wash a glass ... Or go and buy a glass ...  steal one if need be 😉 They were in shock when we got up and left..... Maybe we were too demanding.. Difficult customers... Conclusion ; mustn't forget to bring my own cold coffee glass from home next time Disaster. !!! || Very busy, good cakes

Absolutely horrible place. Dirty, inside and outside. Kids who have no idea how to run a business are put in charge how it looks. Totally messy place. Food is dry. Buns are falling apart. || I made an order to take home, I didn't receive any fries, no phone, no one to talk to, all the fuss about the app, the food has already gotten cold. This is not service!! On the face of it || A branch that disrespects the chain, disrespectful service, a dirty and unhygienic branch, and dishes that come out late. || It took an hour for the order to arrive even though the branch was 10 minutes away from me. They forgot a lot of products and didn't respond to support. In the end, they said they would bring the products and it would take over an hour or receive coins in the app. || Every month I've been in Eilat and I go in with the girls to eat there and they always close the restrooms and say there's a problem and a malfunction and I'm sure it's a malfunction of employees who don't want to clean the restrooms and ask us to go to Aroma or look for another Mac branch that has restrooms... No service, no respect, no cleanliness!!! Not clean || We made a reservation on the app, not only did it show us 50 minutes to the hotel, which is 500 meters away, but also due to "technical glitches" they extended the arrival time by an hour and a half **fifteen minutes after the order was supposed to arrive!!**. If there are technical glitches, it's time to close the branch. Shame on McDonald's || 1. The place took 10 minutes to prepare a small order 2. They forgot to put 2 items I ordered 3. Instead of putting grapes in my order, they put Coke in my order, which ruined my diet of not drinking soda 4. I placed an order that was canceled and they charged me for everything || Don't come any closer! They canceled my order, wrote that it was ready, forgot about it, and even argued with me that I had to wait fifteen minutes for ice cream in a cup! || A branch of the chain, relatively okay, the tables are not clean, reasonable waiting time for an order, the chips were different from what you are used to getting at McDonald's (not crispy) according to them, these are their chips..... || We received half a portion of what appeared in the picture. The workers were confused about their backs. It looked simply horrible.

Only good thing about it is they are open fri night and Saturday. || A great little coffee place and bakery! A pleasure to go by, sit and enjoy! || Fantastic place, pastry and coffee first class. Highly recommended. || The cakes and actually all pastry look really really great. Really special. Coffee is good. The almond croissant is big like half a kilo, haha, looks really good. I guess it supposed to be warmed before eating, but I haven't, so the taste was ok, but not great. Maybe my fault. || Great variety of tasty  pastries cakes and sandwiches. Great coffee !  Quick service.  A very good place for a nice break or take away. || Minimarket and bakery. Good solution for coffee in late hours and early morning. According to manager opens at 4:30 || A nice place for a short coffee break before or after your daily shopping, doing in the same place. Personally: it was too strong airconditioning. || Awesome service and really quality, all sweets is made by Alimi and are awesome, coffee one of the best in Eilat also they have store and some basics with normal prices, deserve 5 of 5 || Great street cafe, also a local market so can pick up basic supplies. Barekas fresh and tasty. || Great pastries and very friendly staff. Open on Saturday morning. Good coffee.

My favorite mom and pop grocery store in Eilat. Fresh baked (on premises) bread and pastries. Surprisingly good fresh produce. || Typical Israeli bakery, making everything fresh daily, opened 24/7 : Rugelach (chocolate rolled croissant), Bourekas (Bulgarian puff pastry with cheese) in various forms and fillings, Baguettes, Buns, Shabbat Challoth, doughnuts (Dunkin' Donuts style), Chanukah doughnuts, (great) Butter Croissants and much more. || Nice place, Great staff...  A lot of variety. Bakery at the place, Sometimes you can find vegan baked goods. || Best bakery in Eilat. Fair prices and great products. Tourist pays the same prices as Locals - which is very rare in Israel! || Really nice and helpful employees! Fresh pastries, bagels, bread and Challa ✨ 24/7 supermarket and kiosk. || A small place, but relatively great selection of fresh pastry and fruits, even on Sat. || I only come here for the bakery which I love. All the pastries and breads taste great. || Perfect pastries and excellent service. Most are family and it feels like it. || Cool market after all they have a bakery also and thier bread is npt bad at all || Great bakery. Open on Shabbat with fresh bread and baked goods

Pastory in Eilat is easily one of the best dining experiences the city has to offer. From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere feels warm, lively, and welcoming, with a classic Italian touch that immediately sets the mood for a great meal. The staff are incredibly attentive and friendly, making sure you’re comfortable without ever being intrusive.  The food is the real highlight. Every dish feels thoughtfully prepared and full of flavor. The fresh pasta stands out — perfectly cooked, rich sauces, and generous portions that still feel balanced. The seafood dishes are especially impressive, with ingredients that taste fresh and well-seasoned. The pizzas are also excellent, with a thin, crispy crust and high-quality toppings.  Service is surprisingly fast considering how busy the restaurant often is, and everything arrives hot and beautifully plated. The menu has great variety, so both picky eaters and adventurous diners will find something they love.  Prices are on the higher side, but absolutely justified for the quality and overall experience. Pastory is the kind of place you look forward to returning to — a reliable, flavorful, and memorable spot in Eilat. Highly recommended for couples, families, and anyone who appreciates great Italian food. || The place itself was pleasant, and I was glad we were seated outside. Inside there was a very strong smell of fish and meat, which made the outdoor seating a much better choice. The staff was very kind and welcoming throughout the meal.  The food was a mixed experience. The salad was fresh, lemony, and very tasty. We also ordered an aglio olio pasta and asked for it to be made vegan. It arrived a bit dry and had a lot of greens, so it was not the best dish. On the other hand, the focaccia was amazing and definitely a highlight.  The restaurant was full, most likely because of its high rating, but based on this visit I feel there are better pasta options in Eilat || The best Italian restaurant in Israel.  Even in Italy not so often you can get such delicious food.  Everything is just excellent there.  Going there for 15 years at least. And every time it's very enjoyable.  Need to book in advance!!! || Great Italian dishes, not one of those overly oil/butter saturated spaghetti places. Everything was fresh and tasty. And our dessert was exquisite - brioche dipped in vanilla ice cream. || Yum! It wasn’t easy to get a reservation here during sukkot but we took a late seating and sat on the bar and it was so worth it. Everything we had was delicious! Loved the black ravioli and the salmon tartare. So happy to see Eilat finally getting some good quality restaurants and this was at the top of our list for the week! || I came here on my birthday, and as soon as I mentioned it the waiter congratulated me and offered shots for everyone at the table which is such a sweet gesture! The food was excellent, the pizza is thin and perfectly made, and the whole restaurant has a beautiful Italian design. Loved it there! || The atmosphere was good, pleasant music and lighting. The service was great, very friendly and the food was on the table in no time. The food itself was very tasty. We had pizzas and a pasta dish. Everyone was happy and thought the serving size was perfect. Only small criticism is that the oven-baked pizzas were a bit too black at the edges for our taste. The dessert, tiramisu and a special were great. Prices were reasonable. Would I go again? That's a firm yes || The food is generally good but risotto frutto di mare was swimming in oil, pizza Margarita had no basil and panacotta was not what it supposed to be. The waiters are snobbish and slow to come. Tiramisu was good by itself but a little drama of covering it with sauce was unnecessary. || We shared a minced meat lasagna and an artichoke salad. Was top notch. Waiter was extremely friendly and courteous. A restaurant  we'll go back to. || The start was very promising with exceptional service and great wine, however it started to degrade with every minute we spend in the restaurant. The shrimps with tomatoes were very good, the rest like risotto with pesto and the lasagna (with huge amount of cheese on top, look at photos) we very average. We ordered 2 deserts (one of them just didn’t make it to our table), asked for water - no reply, and by the end we waited for 15 minutes to get the bill and additional 10 minutes to get the card back. Maybe we had a bad luck, but this time the overall impression was just below average.

Unbelievably good experience! The food was inventive, unique, modern, and healthy. It came to us at lightning speed and with extremely kind, patient service. We honestly have nothing negative to say. This was one of our best ever dining experiences in Israel. Great food for kids and adults alike. || A beautiful final dinner in Eilat! I ordered the chicken salad — perfectly grilled chicken with sautéed onions and mushrooms, fresh greens, and bright flavors. The meal began with three small salads, each one crisp and delicious, and a side of fries that paired perfectly with their tasty sauces. Sat outdoors in the warm evening air, enjoying the quiet and great service. A perfect end to my trip! || The top rating found is well deserved: good food, friendly staff, quick service, fast WiFi and naturally fear pricing. The staff is patient and the cook let me take a picture to share. The cooking is done in front of you, so you know what they are doing. The space is small and busy, so you can't stay too long... But luckily nobody sends you away. We were on a family trip, we saw this place on-line that was in walking distance from the coach station and we walked. We all loved the people and the food style. || Probably my fave restaurant of the entire Israel trip. It is casual and friendly, I have staff coming out to chat with us and making recommendations. The sandwiches are a delight, I ordered something sinful of fried egg and meat. It was a real comfort food. There was multiple sauces to choose from to go with your sandwich. Also recommended with a sweet and strong aperitif to end the meal. Not sure if you can consider this something local but it is something which your stomach will like and a good local experience. || Large variety of options, yummy fries mix (sweet potato fries and regular fries), sabeech in sandwich or without was 100% and the cauliflower wasn’t bad. They have many sauces (majority are mayo based), except for a plum sauce which is sweet and tasty. Recommend! || This is the nicest place to dine in Eilat. Central yet not in the middle of everything, excellent food without show off, good service and reasonable prices. Highly recommended.  It is clear that the owner/chef really likes his job. || Omer is a magician when it comes to tasty food. Not a single thing that could be better when it comes to the flavour profile. Fast and friendly service. Great vibe and homey atmosphere. A truly great original place in the middle of a somewhat artificial city. Would give more stars if possible. || Omer’s is a nice experience for us especially when they bring out eight kinds of sauces that you can put on your burger or just try!!! My wife likes her meal very much, I have to admit that I am a bit disappointed with my burger and the half and half fries (Sweet potatoes and potatoes) is a bit soggy on the side but it is okay. My server is super friendly and that is a plus. They will try to accommodate your needs. Give it a try. || This restaurant makes your heart and belly sing! 😍🙌 Wonderful food from beautiful people made with love in an heartwarming location. 😘👌 If I once come back to Eilat, this will be my first stop! 🤙 … || Wow 🤩 This place serves amazing Sandwiches: Steak & eggs, Sabich, “All night” cooked meat etc. Great Atmosphere and well organized Restaurant. Look at the walls for napkins with customers thank you notes.

place_name: מוד מסעדת שף באילת | mood restaurant eilat
reviews_content: One of my best food and service experiences is Israel. The restaurant is new but the staff and food don't feel like it. The food was of course the highlight, but the service was amazing, the cheff himself came to the tables to ask for the diner's opinions. Music and lighting were just right, didn't have to wait long for the foor or drinks. The place itself is outdoors but doesn't feel hot or uncomfortable. If I ever find myself in Eilat again, definitely will pay a visit. || We're glad you chose to join our mood ♥ || A fresh gastronomique restaurant in Eilat! Liked complicated tastes of the dishes, some of them spicy. Tasted seven courses - and all of them were perfect! Light white wines would match all of them (we selected Pinot Gris and Sancerre). || The vibe is amazing, especially for a date or something for intimate. There was not too much variety and I ended up getting a pizza, but even that wasn’t bad. THE PASTA though was incredible. The sauce was perfect, the texture and the softness as well. Recommend! || It was amazing food, atmosphere and service! Truly recommend. || It is a modern kosher restaurant with a nice atmosphere. The kitchen is an interesting mix of Italian and sushi. The staff was trying to do their best, and they did a good job. The food was good without being anything too special. There is a small pool that creates nicer surroundings. || So disappointed, I thought I would eat in a cozy, lounge place with good music and subdued lighting, I found myself in a canteen in the middle of strollers. || Hello Sandrine,  Thank you for sharing your feelings with us. We certainly understand your disappointment – ​​Eilat during this season is full of families, and in the earlier hours we welcome everyone with love, even with strollers. After 10:00 PM the atmosphere changes completely – exactly to the lounge atmosphere with the music and lighting you were looking for.  It is also important for us to note – personal disappointment with the atmosphere does not necessarily justify a rating of only two stars, unless the food, service or design were also not to your satisfaction.  We would be happy to host you again at a later time, so that you can enjoy the real Mood, and perhaps also improve your mood 😉.  Best regards, Mood Restaurant Team  English  Hi Sandrine,  Thank you for sharing your feedback. We truly understand your disappointment — Eilat during this season is full of families, and in the earlier evening hours we welcome everyone with love, strollers included. After 10 PM, however, the atmosphere completely changes into the cozy lounge vibe with music and lighting you were probably looking for.  That said, we do want to mention — a personal disappointment with the atmosphere doesn't necessarily justify a two-star review, unless the food, service, or design also failed you.  We'd be happy to host you again a bit later in the evening, so you can truly experience the real Mood — and hopefully leave with a better mood too 😉.  Best regards, Mood Restaurant || We had the couple Breakfast Benedict. One egg per person, soft cheeses were not fat, small salad for two. overall, OK. || Overrated and overpriced. I recently dined at this sushi restaurant and unfortunately had a disappointing experience. The service was lacking, with significant delays in receiving our orders. The seating was uncomfortable and too close to the bar area, making it noisy and disruptive. Additionally, the hostesses were not friendly, and seemed unwelcoming which didn’t help the overall atmosphere. The menu lacked variety and didn’t offer anything unique; Having eaten at many sushi restaurants, I found this one to be below average, with the rolls being thinner than usual. I was hoping for a much better experience. || Great food, expensive and too many guests for the waiters to properly treat you, we got half a pizza thrown away because the waiter just walked by and took it which is a shame || Thank you very much for your honest review and feedback  We’re glad you enjoyed the food and sorry for the inconvenience with the pizza. We will address this issue with the team to prevent such cases in the future. We’d love to host you again for an even better experience. || What a great vibe and food, and the staff so incredible, Tomer and Yarom were so on it… sweethearts ♥️🙏

Busy popular place.  Manager very gracious and quick to find us a comfortable spot.  Great music playing and open space to see the water view no matter where  you’re seated.  Our server could have been a bit more attentive but he looked quite young and I will just assume it’s a lack of experience.  But he was always kind and polite and ready to help when we got his attention.  Highly recommend this place. Fun, great food, even kid friendly || If anyone tells you that there are no good places to eat out in Israel, just come to the Ninth Beach in Eilat. The food is delicious, the service exceeds expectations, and the atmosphere has its own vibe. Am here every time when visiting Eilat. || A bar on the beach next to the mall in Eilat. They have a vegan menu, which is impressive in Eilat (unfortunately). The view and the shade are wonderful to sit with friends and family. The alcohol is pretty expensive, but it makes sense to the position of the restaurant. || Evening review: nice atmosphere. Calm and relaxing music. Menu is good (simple food but sometimes it's exactly what you need). What we didn't like: waiter (name starts with D) had 2 mistakes in bill (total mistake value of about 25 USD). We told him and he canceled just one of them. Refused the other was a mistake. Shame because otherwise nice place. Prices are decent though. || Summery: good place for a group who want different kinds of dishes. Food is good, prices are reasonable.  There is only one way to describe the food- OK. Its not bad in any way, tasty to eat even, but not exceptional in any way. I can say this after tasting everyone's dishes, and after asking them. This place is really a jack of all trades but master of none, which is great if you have a big family that wants different things (like us).  Service is great: fast, professional, kind. Cant ask for more.  Atmosphere is great, lighting, music, the option to sit by the sea (we didn't) is all very attractive || Honestly we didn’t expect much and were looking for a spot by the water. But the food is just great!! Really amazing experience, was really full when we arrived but fortunately we got a table. Prices are average for Eilat. || Nice place for breakfast and dinner! Restaurant and seats just few feets from the sea. Prices are good. Breakfast for one was very good and cost about 15€. Burger was ok, price about 16€. Breakfast for two adults and a three year old child cost us 150 NIS. That was about 35€. Well recommended! || The food and service were perfect, I would reccomend coming at a decent hour (19:00-21:00) before rush hour to actually test the waters, Our waitress (Ziv) was spectacular, she was super welcoming and fast with eyecontact service, she came with all of our food at once. Very calming music, super cute I would recommend this place for a date, dinner with friends, familly outing and even meetings. || Recommended! When you are on the beach, go and have some drink! We picked mango cosmopolitan - good one, and Nine beach speciality, i dont really remember the name of the drink, but it was mojito with watermelon and kiwi twist - best one! It really tastes great 😍 and the cakes, oh, no words needed. Staff was nice, attentive, also when i asked if they have gluten free cakes, the waiter recommended me some, and went to double check with the chef, without my request - which I found really nice! In Israel is food more expensive, so don't be surprised if your bill is higher lol. || So the location and overall vibe are simply stellar! Music is good and a normal volume (which is rare for these kinda beach bars). But the service is simply horrible! I took a seat and they were quick to give me a menu and a drink but they never returned after that. I even asked them to take my order and the waitress said; "one minute" and never returned. To make it even worse; the waitress was constantly chatting with what appeared to be her personal friends a table next to me for nearly an hour!

We visit this restaurant annually when in Eilat. It is pricy but typically high quality. This time around we were less enthusiastic about the mushroom risotto, and one of the pasta dishes was just not good enough for anybody in our party to want to eat. The waitress noticed this and got the manager to deduct the dish from our bill without us prompting her to so. I give them extra points just for that gesture. || We came to the restaurant super hungry and with craving for a good Italian food.  The place looked good from the outside and from the inside. Although we usually never complain about the with we get, this time we were really unsatisfied, it was near the kitchen which made the place very loud. We ask the manger to move and with a big smile although the place was full, he found for us a perfect place.  The waiter was super nice and the food came really quick.  Everything was above and beyond. The ganocchi was very soft, creamy, and good. The salads had a bit of too much sauce, but still they were excellent. But the headlight was the pasta!! We had one with goose and one with artichoke.  The price is ok, not expensive and I think it’s worth the money. || Great italian food and good service. Even though it looked like our section was understaffed, our server was able to be attentive to all of our needs and dishes arrived quickly. We really enjoyed the buratta salad and the fish filet. The pizza was good (a bit plain) even though we’ve had better. Would go back again. T || One of the best Italian restaurants that I've visited. Great food with great tastes. The restaurant is beautifuly decorated. The service is professional and the prices are reasonable. You should get there. || Amazing place, great atmosphere and interior. The food was exquisite, great wine selection. Highly recommend beef fillet with Gorgonzola, Caesar salad and Pavlova for dessert! || Very good Italian restaurant, second in Eilat only to Pastory. Elegantly decorated and classy, La Cuccina offers a quiet and relaxed break from the heat and bustle outside.  The salads (endive, artichoke) and Frito Misto were very good. The sea food was especially crispy. The endive salad dressing was a bit too sweet. The kids had pizza and pasta. The pizza was very good, crispy crust with a soft interior. The pasta dishes were nice but nothing special. The main courses, grilled Sea Bream fillet and Duck Cannelloni were both ample portions and very good.  The desserts, Pavlova and Nociolla gelato were average.  This is definitely one of the best restaurants in Eilat, if a bit pricey, and a recommended option for a romantic dinner or a family meal. || Great italian restaurant with beautiful classy European interior. I've visited several times and the service is always good and the food is well prepared. Very different vibe from most restaurants in Eilat. || I visited this restaurant with my family for dinner and unfortunately had a very disappointing experience. Upon arrival, we were told that no tables were available without a reservation. We accepted this and began to leave, only to see another group without a reservation seated immediately after us.  When I politely inquired about the discrepancy, the hostess responded with an unpleasant attitude and showed no willingness to take responsibility or offer an explanation. As someone who dines out frequently, I find this level of service unacceptable. The lack of professionalism and fairness in handling guests leaves a very negative impression and undermines the restaurant’s reputation.  The food may be good, but no dining experience begins well when the front of house treats guests in such a dismissive manner. Management should seriously reconsider the training and approach of the hostess staff. || Delicious food, nice waitress (young and blonde, very professional) she gave us lots of details for various kinds of dishes in order to make the right choice. The waiting time was more than decent and the fact that you could see the action in the kitchen it made us fell that time passed really quickl Not average prices but definitely worth it. Will definitely come back whenever in Eilat. || Best Italian food in the city of Eilat. Absolutely everything we ordered was amazing and full of flavor. From Starters to desserts there was not one dish we could say a simple bad thing about. The service at the restaurant itself was great however trying to get a reservation isn't always the easiest thing.

Exceptional food served with a smile- I had burger and fries which was 1/2 pound but I would recommend medium well since medium was a little rare. My wife had a feta salad which was huge and fantastic. We both started with stuffed grape  leaves on bed of tzatziki which was the best I’ve ever had || The portion size is filling, the salmon was well done and the mashed potatoes (dairy) was soft and tasty. The atmosphere is inviting and fun (especially if you sit outside). Great for any craving! || There sure is a reservation-communication problem, however we got sorted out quickly. The atmosphere is relax and feels like home. The food is just great. Tasty and well served. We ordered salads, pasta and a chicken dish. Excellent food!! || The pastas are excellent.  When we came without reservations we were allotted an hour and fifteen minutes even though there were plenty of free tables.  Cordial service.  Happy hour 17-18 Sunday to Thursday. || Best breakfast that money can buy. Clean place which is important when buying food. The owner is sweet and takes care of uncomfortable situations with love. Makes you keep coming back for more. Food is really good and not super expensive. Enjoyed every minute || It was my first time in Branja restaurant and I really enjoyed my visit. I had green shakshuka for lunch, which was really good. The staff is very friendly, they made me feel welcomed. They have an english menu, prices are reasonable. Toilets are very clean. Interior and art on the walls are cool. It's a hip place and I'd go there again. || Love this place! It was our favorite in Eilat and we ate here several times during our short stay. Breakfast all day if you want it. Brunch (on Sundays?) till 5. Really great food at reasonable prices. Happy hours from 5-6 on off nights (Monday-Thurs?) with 2 for one cocktails. The cocktails here are really excellent as well. The Branja Butty sandwich is delicious as was the sweet potato ravioli.  They are very welcoming with a relaxed beachy/artsy vibe. || Food quality great. Nice snd intersting dishes. Culm atmosphere.  Good price. First time their, we will come again || You coming through a lot you must eat here all of the best test the food you can find we enjoy everything we order on the menu do you have English menu and Hebrew really five star service to || Love the place, the vibes in this place. It's like vintage but with a bit modern. Good service, great plates, I ordered fettucini with smoked goose, my girlfriend ordered fettucini with sweet potato and artichoke. Also cocktail that came in a bicycle. For desert we ordered apple pie with vanilla ic cream, it was delicius. In conclusion, was amazing meal with very good cervice and good vibes. Extremely recomended.

After finding this restaurant on google we decided to give it a try as it was newly kosher. We were so happy with our choice. It feels like homely family run place. Everything we ordered was fresh generous and tasty. My husband had the fish soup which he said was insanely delicious. Salads huge and crunchy and very fresh. And the fish of course was full of flavour and grilled to perfection. The place isn’t fancy but very authentic and clean and the prices reflect that as they’re reasonable. I would 100% recommend. || Thank you very much ❤️ || This place is such a great find. Super fresh fish, simply done and full of flavor. Everything feels home-style and comforting, but still really well thought out and well executed. As a kosher fish spot in Eilat, this place truly stands out for its  freshness and quality.  We loved every bite and would happily come back again. || Thank you very much 🙏 … || INCREDIBLE fish restaurant. One of our favorite meals of our time in Israel. Delicious and fresh fish. Don’t miss out on the fish cigars, SHAWARMA, and fried sea bass. Service was warm, friendly, and patient with our broken Hebrew. Cannot recommend enough! || Thank you very much 🙏 … || I really wanted to eat good fish and booked a table. The restaurant inside, reminds me of the old european restaurants. The hostess was wonderful and gave us great tips on what we should try. Everything was divine (never had such a good ceviche and I've travelled a lot). We loved everything and will come back for sure! || If you like to eat good and tasty fish, this restaurant is the right place. Each time when me and my wife went to Eilat we visited Rak Dagim and were satisfied with the delicious dinner. || Thank you very much 🙏 … || Old school classic fish 👌  The locals little secret, my wife (Israeli) took me the first night of our trip, she couldn’t wait to share this place with me.  I happily recommend if you want the best fresh fish in Eilat within a relaxed and traditional atmosphere. || The food itself was very good! Having said that, we expected more from the service. There were relatively low amount of people (3-4 tables) but we’ve waited a long time just to order or get the attention of the staff. It felt like a very laid back place where you come and is expected to spend a very long time in. || Rak Dagim in Eilat was one of the best dining experiences we’ve had in a long time. From the moment we sat down, the hospitality was incredible. We told them right away, “Just bring us something delicious,” and they did exactly that. Without even asking for a menu, they started us off with fresh salad, creamy baba ghanoush, and warm garlic bread that was insanely good. Everything tasted fresh and homemade, and the vibe in the restaurant was laid-back but full of good energy.  What came next was a surprise multicourse meal that completely exceeded our expectations. The owner, who was kind and welcoming, brought out a huge whole fish cooked with lemon and herbs, served with soft roasted potatoes that soaked up all the flavor. It was clean, rich, and cooked perfectly. We had wine with the meal and just relaxed into it — no rush, just good food and conversation in a place that felt like home.  The restaurant itself has a cozy, inviting atmosphere with simple but tasteful design. It’s a Greek-style place, and you can tell they put real heart into what they serve. The whole experience felt authentic and thoughtful — no frills, just excellent food and genuine hospitality. If you’re in Eilat, Rak Dagim is a spot you don’t want to miss. || Excellent Service just steps from the Eilat promenade. Food was outstanding and hostesses were attentive and helpful. Felt like I was in the restaurants of Israel’s yesteryear, a very good thing 😊. The restaurant is kosher for a year and half which makes it even better! || Don’t let the outside fool you—Rak Dagim is a hidden gem in Eilat! The moment we stepped inside, we were pleasantly surprised by the clean and welcoming atmosphere. The staff were incredibly friendly and helpful, even taking the time to show me how to properly eat the fish and avoid the bones—such thoughtful service really stood out.  We ordered a fresh salad, grilled aubergine, fish arayas, and a whole fish, paired with a bottle of crisp white wine. Every dish was exceptionally fresh, bursting with flavor, and beautifully presented. We were so immersed in the food that we completely forgot to take photos!  This place is a must-visit for seafood lovers. The quality, service, and experience were all top-notch. Highly, highly, highly recommend!

Nice restaurant close to the beach front in Eilat. The sardines are a nice option in the entrees. In the main I had a shrimp with artichoke. The fish looked nice as well. Overall good experience. || Have wanted to try Les Sardines for a long time.  We both loved everything! The service (Amay was absolutely wonderful), the menu, the food.  Definitely recommend and will be back! Thank you for a delicious meal! || Great food and amazing service by Ido. We’ve been in Israel 🇮🇱 for 2 weeks and this is the first restaurant that I can say was AMAZING !!! The food quality and the service. American 🇺🇸 standards here are really remarkable. Definitely recommended!!! || The place seems really luxurious in its setting, and the fish (the two main dishes we ordered) were pretty good. Mine was delicious, the plate with the small fish could have been a bit more crispy. || Very good food and service. The best: the ambient, the fish, the chocolate souffle. The worst (not that much though): the mood of our waiter and the ceviche (was expecting the Peruvian flavor and wasn't there) || I think Le Sardines is one of the best restaurants in Eilat. The cuisine here is excellent - they cook from the freshest products of very good quality. All the dishes, without exception, that we ordered were delicious. I especially recommend trying Sardines bread, grilled sardines and Tiramisu for dessert. The Sangria here is excellent too. The service was 6 out of 5. || Great service, all of the waiters and the staff members are extremely nice and agile. It makes the experience wonderful, along with really tasty fish! We found a coupon on Groupon, you should try to check if it still exists because it's really worth it. || The 1st courses were ok nothing special. Overall there was an atmosphere of pressure by the staff due them reminding us several times before the orders that the restaurant was fully double booked and that we only had a set time to be there, so it was rush rush. The main course were ok, and the creme boules was good but still the place was over priced. Also the lady at the entrance in charge of showing us to the table seemed to be very bitter, not even a small smile and the same can be said for the rest of the staff that also all had hard expressions maybe because of all the pressure to serve quickly. || The most outrageous experience when you ask for a small change in the dish and get a response ' we'll do it today but if you come tomorrow don't expect it' 🤔 No Sir, we won't be coming back ever. Food average.  Not great || Spectacular! Family meal went so well. Our sever was fantastic who helped us make the best decisions on the menu. The shrimps in curry, the seafood casserole, muscles, and other filets we all top notch. A can’t miss spot when visiting Eilat.

From the start, excellent service, very accommodating to some food restrictions. Patient, helpful and friendly. The food was also excellent, and and a pleasure to see bold Italian offerings, and not the typical Israeli dairy restaurant fare. Will definitely return in the future. || The ravioli with sweet potato and chestnuts was so delicious , we returned for it the next day! But, all what we tasted was very good. We are normally not the biggest fan of Italian food, but this is a different level.  The service is very nice and friendly. They just need a bit more training on details. || Great place, not busy early evening came at 7 and had almost no people. Service was great and accommodating to any requests. The appetizers were amazing and the fish were fresh and delicious, pasta was amazing and tasty. Not overly expensive and just a great experience overall. || Lovely place, friendly staff. The food was delicious!  Such a fantastic way to end our visit to Eilat. Thank you || Great place with a good menu. Everyone at our table enjoyed their meal. || Very nice place for a family. Service really good. Special thanks to our waitress Maya. || Very crowded, noisy and chaotic. Food is nice, not much more than that. Service is awful. We got main dishes before first dishes and got glasses and drinks 40 minutes after we ordered them. || Great food and great service at a great price. || A pleasant and very delicious restaurant. The cocktails were awesome! We took several amazing starters, especially the Arancini and the Polenta with mushrooms. For main course we took the Chestnut sweet potato ravioli, which was also delicious. || Been here twice now. Great pizza, delicious food and cocktails and friendly service. Glad to have somewhere with good food in Eilat.

Worst service , starting with the  ´ welcome girl ‘ at the entrance. They have plenty of table all night long and they just don’t want to give it. The food is not good as it used to be . Managers or owners should really take care of this place because it’s a night mare Personnel exécrable et agressif . Baisse considérable de la qualité . Extrêmement décevant . Les managers devraient vraiment s’en rendre compte . || Highly recommend! Excellent place: fast and friendly service, delicious food. Meat is  fantastic, all side dishes are really nice, good choice of vine, home bread. Only recommend to come / book table at restaurant opening around 19-00, as later place is crowded, service becomes a little messy and a lot of families coming with kids so a lot of noise. Other than that - love the place, will definitely come again. || The meat was very good quality, but I would expect a ranch house to grill the meat to perfection. It was very disappointing to order 2 trio meals and in both meals the filet was rare and not medium as ordered. In addition, they also didn't have an English menu and half of our party was English speaking. Overall experience was good but not great || We arrive 8 minutes early. Although tge restaurant was nearly empty we were told we could not enter until the allocated time. After ordering, we waited one hour before any food was brought to us and that was after complaing to the manager who could not care less. Frankly do not bother ti go to this restaurant || Real amrican gril Spare ribs are excellent Fila is very good Service luzi It's not the  first time we are here, but may be the last, its take a lot of waiting time and the reson as other time is there was fire in the kitchen The steak of 700 gr is good for 4 pepole || It become a tradition every year having the best stake in town! I’m not joking around these guys know how to cook a fine medium steak had a wonderful time! Great service :) || Pricy but good value for money. All starters were good and generous, wings mostly. The trio is good for sharing. Service should get better. || A great place for meat lovers, you can see how much they care not only about how the food was prepared but if the client is satisfied with the visit, doing everything quick yet not trying to get you out of the restaurant asap, the food quality is amazing, only the best of the best, and if you dont like something theyll make another dish as you wish, the food varity is quite small, tho when its made with love its tottally wort it, the waiters know how the food was prepared, and the location of the restaurant is really comfortable || Truly world class steak house. Family friendly but clearly aimed at adults, the food is great and so is the service. || Very nice, real meat restaurant in the Eilat. Thanks to our waiter Michael for his great service and efforts

place_name: Hananya Beach - חוף חנניה ספורט ימי ושייט
reviews_content: Nice place they offer various water attractions. We did parasailing. The place is quite expensive, but the instructors were really nice and professional. I noticed that in other places the parachute fell into the water several times, but here they managed to keep it dry and handled everything very professionally. Highly recommended! || A very beautiful and cozy small beach surrounded by palm trees and restaurants near the hotels on the one side, and a lagoon with beautiful yachts and tourist shopping area with numerous outlets - on the other. The water is good, clean and pleasant, but there can be stones near the shore. The best option that I can advise everyone is to buy rubber shoes in a store near the beach specially for beaches. Pleasure and comfort for the feet are guarantee. || I had an amazing time at this beach. The views are incredible, the local offerings are more than sufficient, and it is overall incredibly enjoyable. I recommend (if in a large group) hiring a boat to go out further into the red sea, it's an amazing experience and the views are once in a lifetime. You can even get a speedboat to take you out for water tubing! || Boat cruise and coral and fish gazing.. Superb weather and lovely calm sea.. Excellent way to spend 2 to 3 hours in Beautiful Eilat.. || Nice beach but the music of the Maman restaurant is always too loud || Eilat was nice. A bit expensive overall, for what it offered, but a pleasant experience. || I always include this activity when I'm in Eilat. Great sport sea sport activity, highly professional and service oriented team, great location and variety of activities for almost every age! || Very nice place to take a recreation || Great beach, fantastic relaxation. Clean, peaceful. || Nice place. We stay there in december.

A real fun place for kids, but also for the sea animal lovers. We had a guided tour and it was perfect and well explained. I enjoyed every bit of it. I would have enjoyed more if the glasses were a bit cleaner. Nevertheless, it was fun. PS: The 3D movie was cherry on the top || Would spend there all day. An established place, but it keeps renovating all the time. The shark aquarium is so relaxing and exiting at the same time! The underwater observatory facility is a must. Note- a single ticket is good for a couple of days, so if you want to visit more than once (and you should) plan accordingly. || It is very expensive. The tanks are too small for the large number of fish and turtles. In addition, the glass on the tanks is dirty everywhere, making it difficult to see properly. This needs to be cleaned urgently. The grounds are small overall and half of the attractions consist of films. It is not a must-see. || Good for little kids, probably less for older ones.  The place is trying hard to remain relevant. The underwater observetory is a little old and not really that impressive anymore. However you also get an impressive shark pool and some stingray and sea turtles exhibits. The 3d movie was impressive (but short. 18 min total).  I've certainly been to better aquariums, but this is decent and good for kids. || Wonderful. From walking through the lively coral reef to the 3D cinema which is unlike any other I have witnessed. The screen goes above the head so that it can be protected from any point in the room and looks like the whole is above you. This place is a must see for young and old. It is a beautifully maintained park, with a big variety of coral. The underwater observatory is absolutely amazing. The water of the red see is also accommodating the coral beautifully. The aqua dome is also an experience like none other. The whole is turned into a 3D video and it literally feels like you are under the ocean and touching the sea life yourself. Great place to visit, both educational and fun. its really impressive to see all the unique creatures that live in the ocean. dedicate at least several hours to the visit. || This place gets it!  It's all about the service and people.  Incredibly helpful and friendly staff.  Very clean place.  Food was good and fair priced.  The exhibits were all well maintained.  Especially with children, this is a very nice all day activity. || We’ve been to aquariums all over the world and this isn’t the glossiest or the most high tech. But my kids love it and beg to come back every time we are in Eilat. There’s lots of different things to do that keep everyone entertained and you cannot beat seeing fish in their actual habitat. We love this charming little place. The 3-D movie was a huge hit! || What a great chance to sit and watch fish for hours! Between the underwater observatory and the aquarium we were really pleased with the experience.  Go early for quieter viewing without crowds. There was plenty of parking when they first opened. || We spent the whole day, ~7 hours, so there's lots to do there. I won't give it a 5 star since some things definitely need more love. We saw all the exhibits, there's really a good wide variety and selection of sea creatures, most endemic to Eilat. The highlight must be the shark tank, it has multiple viewing windows, plenty of room, probably the nicest tank I've seen. They feed them twice daily - go to the second feeding! (3pm) it far less crowded. There's a tube to walk under the fish and rays, beautiful. There are also turtles and "rare creatures" (which we didn't find very "rare"). The "deep sea creatures" exhibit is only videos. The lowest point must be the "IMAX", the movie is short, although the 3D effect is cool (kids loved it), but the narration (Heb only) is unintelligible, the content is boring, and they play a "generic" 3D flick. The underwater structure is very nice, but many windows are way too high for a 3-4 y/o to see anything without carrying them 💪, still it's very worth the while (climb up to see the overlook). It's a good place to spend a few hours, it doesn't break the bank, and kids will like it. || Great place to visit. Easy to get to by bus from Eilat. You can buy tickets online or at the gate. The exhibits are lovely.. sharks, stingrays, corals, turtles, octopi, fish. Climb the observatory to the top to see great views of the Red Sea.. then go below sea level to view coral and fish. Try and avoid Jewish / school holidays is it gets very busy. The 3D movie was an extra .. it was not so good.

The owner Leo was super helpful and friendly. Lots of information to be found here by locals and staff. The owner even offered for us to spend a night there on the beach. The Best coffee in Eilat as well to our pleasant surprise. || Quiet place with a lot of activities like banana, parachutes with speed boat. || Could easily be improved with the addition of some changing and showering facilities || Great place to sit back, enjoy the sea, eat, drink and relax! || Great place, quiet and peaceful. A piece of Even || There is shade, no chairs, no toilets || Nice place to sit and enjoy the water || Great, clean and free beach || Excellent Beach with best prices || Great and organized party

A great viewpoint of Eilat and the Red Sea. We visited during sunrise, but for optimal photos, I suggest visiting for sunset. There is pleanty of parking around and it is free. What I didn't love about this viewpoint is all the houses that are between you and nature. || Its high up so you get a lovely view of the sunrise.Tbe mountains are also gorgeous. Probably sunset is also breathtaking. || Nice easy to get to viewpoint of Eilat and The Red Sea with plenty of parking space. || nice view over city of eilat and sea, with info board with voice  (!) hebrew and english explanation of the panorama... worth to visit even for locals to see the city from a different perspective... free parking and easy slope for wheelchairs and baby strollers BUT BUT BUT *not* to the very top of the observatioin desk, there are 20-25 wooden steps in groups of 3 and 4, manageable with strollers probably difficult with wheelchair, should give 4 stars || Very nice view point over Eilat and all around. You can even see Saudic Arabia. There's a switchable voice system on both Hebrew and English, explaining the objects you see from that spot. || Bresthtaking view of red sea n  gulf || Been there at night, great observation over the city area. Well maintained || Great viewing point to see all of Eilat || Excellent place to visit || Bring a coat it can get very windy

This is a really amazing place to learn about the bird migration through Israel and why it happens. The staff is incredibly knowledgeable and it is certainly worth taking their guided tour. They will only allow guided tours with the Ornithologists who work there so it will always be great. There are many different things to see and hear about so make sure to leave yourself a bit of time. || ONLY INTERESTING WITH A TOUR GUIDE UR EXPERT!! There's simply nothing nothing to see by yourself || Very nice place for wildlife and also very nice park to walk and to enjoy nature. I was in december 2018 which is probably not the best month for wild birds, but I still found a lot of interesting species. I attached some pictures with the birds I found there. || The best place for birding Ng and making new experiences. Professional staff around and many interesting people are coming from around the world. The place is real heaven of birds and attracts birders and just nature lovers from around the world. The place is highly recommended to see. || I recommend driving a car there. We were there 20.02 and we didn't see any interesting birds. I think it's only for people who are interested im birds, nature. Or you have to be when it's season for egzotic birds. The biggest advantage is free entry. || Really nice, clean and welcoming, a bunch of birds,plants and insects. Also have a few mini lakes and rivers. There is a nice short trail with information about the place, plants and birds. Good for kids.  Dogs are welcome on a leash, there are public restrooms and a small souvenir store. || Enjoyed the place soo much and stayed there for along time if you are visiting eilat and you would like to see something unusual and not just going to swim this is the place normally it's free of charge to enter there but if you would like to have a guide you need to pay around 35nis which is fair for a very good guide in English or Hebrew and the money for sure is for researching and I really enjoy it || Interesting and peaceful place. I had no binoculars but still was able to see some nice birds. Worth visiting - entrance is free. || a very nice "nature" walk with benches to  sit relax and watch some birds. not many birds (January). but still worth it. free and open all day. || Were there in spring to watch migrating birds. Unfortunatly we had bad wether for photography. But the birds were there

Musical Fountain In Eilat very nice and free attraction at night time for all family, especially for kids. Every show is 15 minutes of long and it's beginning at 20:30. It's show of water with led lights around and popular music in Hebrew and English. It's nice entertainment in the area. Anyway if you in Eilat it's a good place to visit and see the musical fountain by yourself, enjoy. || A lovely experience.  It only lasts about 15 minutes,  but it's free. Good music too! || Lights were nice, but music did the job. Come 10 min early and sit on the left corner (looking form the street) There's nothing better to do in eliat after its gets dark. Show last 15 min || Nice musical and lights spectacle. Unexpected in a city where water is so important for survival. I hope the water is reused. It's nice for tourism, because important cities in Europe has one of these. Please put a sign with the schedule of the fountain. It starts at 20:30 and lasts 15 min. || Started with a great vibe of popular music in English and then moved to old Hebrew popular songs. Really missing some classical music in my taste and can use less Hebrew songs. The fountain bearly reacts to the songs (if at all). Still was nice to sit in the air and hear some music in the middle of the town 😬 … || Sprinklers turn into a light and music show a few evenings every week. Free and great for families! || Very nice experience for the kids, the music is nice for the most parts, the sprinklers are pretty coordinated with the music, for those of you that saw these acts in Europe or the US won't be as impressed. But overall very nice place to hand out, the kids were having a great time watching the show, taking pictures with the stone fish or just running around in the grass || Very underwhelming. Lasts about 30 minutes and it’s a mix of American top 40 and Israeli music. The lights were just kind of on....the fountains just kind of went up and down....if you’re in the neighbourhood and need somewhere to sit than I’d say go. But no need to go out of your way. || Amazing show! BUT - the hours on Google ARE NOT RIGHT! (And can't be changed) it's 2 shows (same one, twice), one at 8:30pm and one at 9:30pm in an amazing and big parking next to the Eilat museum. Every show is about 20 minutes, starting with movie themes, international hits and then some if the Israeli classics. Lots of space to sit (grass and "stairs") and it's wheelchair eccessible.it's 5 mins walk from the "Hayam" shopping center.dont miss it! || The fountain and music is amazing! I just wish that people will be more considerate of others and not go and stand right at the front to take pictures. That means no one who is sitting on the seats can take a clear photo. Those people in the front are in all of the photos.

Clean with lots of sitting options, it costs about 15 shekels a bed/chair. The beach is orderly with showers and with food and beverages served. Also next to the beach you have loads of water attractions to purchase.  We did the water skiing with an instructor which was very good. If more than one of you go you can bargain some good prices || Very nice beach, a little dirty but it's fine. I saw a lot of fish especially when I arrived at morning. || Beach area with umbrella and sitting area by the ocean, restauran and walking area. || The best ⛱ beach in Eilat for sure!! Supervised prices, best location and food, really nice... || Wonderful beach to relax your body and soul..🌴🏊‍♂️ … || Love it sooo much!! Best place eeevvveeerrrr || Good beach, good atmosphere, very good for swimming but almost no coral or fish. You can find interesting spots here and there but they are small compared to southern beaches. The beach itself is neat and clean. || Beautiful beach with chairs, umbrellas and beds for a fee, showers and changing rooms. Quiet on the boardwalk, close to everything. There is waitress service. Paid parking, not accessible. || Clean, well-maintained beach. Sun loungers are available for a fee.

A great beach because : 1. The sea... -) 2. There is plenty of shade - which is very important with the extreme sun. 3. Quiet 4. Good access to the sea bypassing the stones with the bridges. 5. Close to the a supermarket with reasonably prices. || Beach is Nice but be careful with renting a lounger I’ve paid 20 shekels for each and after 20 minutes came different guy saying that i didn’t payed to him and I have to pay again… he tried this trick to several people but when he realized that other people are local he left them and came back to us twice and almost got into fight when he started touching my wife I stood up and started moving his hand like he want to punch me in the face. After this horrible experience we left. Local people just said welcome to Israel. I know it not common behave so tomorrow we are going to the different beach. And advice for other people don’t go there or just equip with lot of money. || Nice view, lots of people. || Unfortunately, the beach is very dirty, a fact I've observed on other Israeli beaches to varying degrees compared to the beaches in Sardinia I'm used to. Its proximity to the city and the resort's facilities makes it unsuitable for those who want to spend some time in the nature of the Red Sea. Despite this, during my short stay, I was able to observe two pufferfish, a clownfish, and a Red Sea ray on the sandy bottom of the beach. It could do with a bit more maintenance, but this is generally true of all Israeli beaches. || The beach is like a beach, a huge plus is that you can come with dogs. Sunbeds, etc. no, you have to bring it with you. || Nice beach, clean, you can enter the sea from the pier. || Amazing beach. For swimming, snorkeling, diving, and also to sit and watch the sunrise or sit in the evening, it's really amazing. || The beach is poorly maintained...dirty...smelly like urine. Too bad || Picturesque location and charming nature || A moderately beautiful beach.

Small but quiet beach in Eilat. You can buy drinks only a few steps away. || I visited Eilat in February. I have experience a lot of people, a shot, that's like a commercial place. But I like a lot of bars and good drinks, chill the atmosphere. 😊 … || Narrow beach, good access to water, with clean water and nice view.  But there is a lot of flies. || Good to have beach shoes because it's rocky and hot. Very clear water perfect for diving. There is a bar next to the beach, offering drinka and snacks. Entry is free, beach bed costs 20 NIS. || Beach is ok. Pebbles at the start of the beach will hurt your feet. Sand area is very narrow at certain points. Public washroom was closed. They have outdoor showers to rinse off. Water is nice and clean and clear || Hey guys an important update. There is no more Rimonim Beach. Rimonim was part of a Hotel chain. And in Eilat they sold the hotel to the  Dan Hotel chain. So now the new name of the hotel is Neptune Eilat!! There fore the beach should have the same name and not Rimonim Beach anymore 😁 … || I loved everything about Eilat. I can't fault it...The red sea waters are crystal clear with lots to discover and see. The weather is perfect. The food is amazing, the weather perfect. I love it! || They have even free WiFi here! || Nice place for evening walking :) || Quite a busy place even in winter. But still a good beach to have a sunbathing procedure or swim.

This is known as Riff Raff beach. Nice seating area outside to watch the wind surfers and kiters. You cannot swim here but a short distance to the right is ok to swim. Good entertainment watching all the action on the sea. It gets very busy so we always go early for our coffee 💕 … || Great beach! Had a lot of fun there worth visiting!! || Amazing location unique to serve kosher food on the sea || Nice beach have a place to seat with small restaurant with limited menu and if the beach is full expect no to find and food. It’s really a place just to have a drink and enjoy the sea. Nicer at the evening time. || Really nice place with access to the sea and shaded chairs. The food and drinks aren't that good.  The is sunken ship really close to the beach - 100m or so. Really cool to look at from above. || We love the village beach! Free seats as long as you order some food and beverages. || Nice once you catch a spot at about 9.00. Perfect for family . food affordable and lots of shadow || Grate place to see lots of fish..worm showers  and good food || Cheap food great atmosphere and clean sea water || Nice beach to relax and good music

There is something called the feast It's a banquet lots of alcohol makes people feel free to interact with one another... Live music (the house D.J) And good food not the highlight of the event so don't expect much... The event is hosted in Hebrew so take it under advisement Highly recommended || We appriciate your compliment very much, thankyou. The Feast is our obligition to make sure that every single visitor has the best experience and we are happy to know that you highly recommend. We would love to see you again soon! || We had such a great afternoon doing a family camel ride and then eating pita made right in front of us while we sipped delicious Bedouin tea. I’m so happy I found this place! So many other fun adventures to do besides camel riding as well. I wish we had more time there! || Absolutely great place. Our friendly guide Eric made it a fun and friendly trip, and shared a lot about Israeli culture over the food he made for us. This made it a great experience way above just riding the camels. || Great low cost alternative for a hotel, you set up your tent here and get a portable ac to keep you cool at night (a must during the summer months). Showers and restrooms also available (and clean). There are other tourists attractions here but I came only for a place to sleep and was very satisfied. || This was a very nice experience for a family with kids. Two (maybe more) hours to spend in a pastoral location, with a very kind guide, a nice desert in the end, makes the experience worth the money. Recommended. || Short walk around an area in the desert just south of Eilat. Loved being able to ride a camel at least once in my life.  Nice little snack of handmade flat bread on an item fire and olives afterward too. Half the staff were really nice, the others... well, it must have been a rough week for them or something. || We used the self tent area, and got to use all facilities and also got small air conditioner to the tent. It was awesome, we slept perfect, price was very low - 50 shekels per person. On the perimeter you can find toilets and showers (privet cells), kitchen with fridge and frizzer, a lot of barbecue for use, many nice sitting areas. Very close to the sea and all the diving and kitesufeing areas and clubs , very quite at night, not close to the city (for us its an advantage). Best way to camp in Eilat. || We came for a short camel ride (~$12 pp) which was very nice. Later, the camel handler let us feed the camels and goats with crackers. There's a small cantina where we got some popsicles. Better to get there before noon or 11am when the heat is still bearable. They have other activities like buggy rides and an extreme park for kids. || Very good and enjoyable place, friendly staff, wonderful guide for the calem ride, who as prepares the bedouin meal in the end of the ride. Camels are calm and friendly, camel saddles are comfortable. Very joyful expetience! || We did donkey carriage ride with tea and pita with small kids. Was a short ride but nice for family will kids. Only disappointment was that pita was replaced with matza during pesach... Camel ride is for a bit more advanced people (because it's high) and jeep to go further into the desert. This place had very clean toilets and gramping facilities and a ninja-kind of athletics for bigger kids over 120cm.

Very solid beach with beautiful coral reefs. Was super quiet when I went practically empty so was added bonus. Perfect for snorkelling and just general sunbathing. No water sports though. || The world northernmost coral reef, really! Right at your foot steps in eilat, Jordan has none. This beach has the advantage of not being overcrowded and all facilities are here, showers, toilets, bar, and a small nature reserve shop and rental services if you forgot your snorkeling equipment. Note, there are no lifeguard, only park rangers, but there is a space by the beach, in shallow water for poor swimmers Plant to bring some water shoes for the beach side. The reef is accessible via a long pier, and a large staircase leading easily to the water. Then it is the wonders of the red sea! || Although its one of the best places to see corals and fish in Eilat. The site could be a bit more developed. There are not many showers and only one dock to enter the water and relatively small place for swimming. With limited hours of operation and mediocre services this beautiful natural reserve should get an upgrade and the site could invest some of the entrance fee in improvments. || The reserve is well-maintained, clean, and organized, with food shops and equipment rental available. While the price is a bit high compared to free nearby spots, the underwater experience is spectacular- vibrant corals, colorful marine life, and plenty to see.  The area is very accessible, and safety is taken seriously with lifeguards on duty. Showers and restrooms are available and well-kept. Most seating areas are shaded with white canopies, which helps, though it can still get extremely hot in July and August.  Some downsides include ongoing renovations, which limit access to newer sections and make planning a snorkeling route a bit challenging. The designated swimming areas are small and enclosed, but beyond the bridge, there are vast open spaces where you can really explore and see a lot of beautiful marine life.  Overall, it’s more comfortable and enjoyable to snorkel in a well-supervised, maintained area than in unofficial sites, and the beautiful coral and abundant sea creatures make it well worth a visit.  * Pros: Clean and organized, lifeguards on duty, beautiful corals and marine life, showers and restrooms, accessible. * Cons: Entry fee is high compared to free alternatives, renovations limit some areas, enclosed swimming zones can feel small, it can get very hot in summer. || Snorkelling is ok. Nice fish and a bit of coral. If you've been in good reef places, you won't be impressed. But if in Eilat, it's worth a visit but a bit expensive for what it offers. || One of the good beaches in Eilat Clean,  had toilet,  shop,  walk route,  bridge directly to Red see with excitement view of corals, different fish types It's needed some payment,  check possible options before coming there It's better come with your own equipment Pay attention - NO SAFE GUARDS || Our preferred place in Eilat! Every time we are in Eilat we go to this place, the best still and ever.  Actually we were there every day, not a problem as we slept at the Yam Suf Hotel, only a 5 minute walk to there. 1. the beach is incredibly looked after 2. The Reserve guards are watching all the time for trespassers so very little chance something bad could happen to you while swimming 3. and of course the corals and the fish. Yes the coral are less beautiful than in the previous years, the mini tsunami a few years ago did damage the reef, but still they are interesting and the fish are till there and still super beautiful. Don't "FOMO" it, would you? || We had a lovely day out here. It was February, so out of season and not too busy. Lots of beautiful sea life up close in enormous tanks. Also, a very nice undersea viewing room and a sub trip if you want. Loads of facilities and other interesting things to see.....  Lovely and we'll worth a visit 😀 … || Amazing place! Make sure you take snorkels!  For 35 shekel, the place offers quite an experience! A long stretch of white sand, beautiful reefs to snorkel and pretty secure! || The most beautiful marine reserve in the world – colorful gardens beneath the sea The reefs of the Gulf of Eilat are the only coral reefs in our country, and among them a wonderful and colorful world of corals, fish and a huge variety of unique creatures can be seen. The Coral Beach Nature Reserve in Eilat allows visitors easy access to the reef, as well as essential beach services, including a shop, showers, toilets, sunshades, deck chairs and sun loungers

This is a really amazing place to learn about the bird migration through Israel and why it happens. The staff is incredibly knowledgeable and it is certainly worth taking their guided tour. They will only allow guided tours with the Ornithologists who work there so it will always be great. There are many different things to see and hear about so make sure to leave yourself a bit of time. || ONLY INTERESTING WITH A TOUR GUIDE UR EXPERT!! There's simply nothing nothing to see by yourself || Very nice place for wildlife and also very nice park to walk and to enjoy nature. I was in december 2018 which is probably not the best month for wild birds, but I still found a lot of interesting species. I attached some pictures with the birds I found there. || The best place for birding Ng and making new experiences. Professional staff around and many interesting people are coming from around the world. The place is real heaven of birds and attracts birders and just nature lovers from around the world. The place is highly recommended to see. || I recommend driving a car there. We were there 20.02 and we didn't see any interesting birds. I think it's only for people who are interested im birds, nature. Or you have to be when it's season for egzotic birds. The biggest advantage is free entry. || Really nice, clean and welcoming, a bunch of birds,plants and insects. Also have a few mini lakes and rivers. There is a nice short trail with information about the place, plants and birds. Good for kids.  Dogs are welcome on a leash, there are public restrooms and a small souvenir store. || Enjoyed the place soo much and stayed there for along time if you are visiting eilat and you would like to see something unusual and not just going to swim this is the place normally it's free of charge to enter there but if you would like to have a guide you need to pay around 35nis which is fair for a very good guide in English or Hebrew and the money for sure is for researching and I really enjoy it || Interesting and peaceful place. I had no binoculars but still was able to see some nice birds. Worth visiting - entrance is free. || a very nice "nature" walk with benches to  sit relax and watch some birds. not many birds (January). but still worth it. free and open all day. || Were there in spring to watch migrating birds. Unfortunatly we had bad wether for photography. But the birds were there

place_name: International Birding and Research Center Eilat
reviews_content: A local centre in Eilat (5km north of the city) focused on the studying and helping of migratory birds that pass from Eurasia to Africa (and back).  Open 24/7, free entrance. BUT! Call in advance to book a local, very experienced, guide that will take you around (mandatory). 35 shekel per person or 100 per family. || Thank you very much, we appreciate your kind words and very happy you enjoyed your visit. || Very peaceful trail, nice place to take family. The employees in the center were overwhelmingly friendly when we went. I also follow the center on FB and they post great bird photos. Really loved this place at sunset, will recommend to anyone traveling to Eilat. || The most important goal of this station is to ensure the well being and safe passage of birds migrating. Dedicated staff and volunteers. || The place looks well equipped with different habitats and nice hides but when we went in late September 2019 only one hide was accessible, the rest were closed off due to construction work and the place was deserted, with no staff around. We saw a few common waders during our visit one afternoon. || It is such an important station for migratory birds. We have not seen too many birds, since January is not the season for migration, but we still enjoyed the tranquility of the place,  took a nice stroll around and read the information that are displayed all over the place. I am looking forward to returning during migration season. || We had a privat guided tour - it was really great and we learned a lot about bird migration! || The entrance is free, and the place itself is tranquil, as it should be. You can see many locals going for a silent job in the morning, enjoying the view and the singing of birds that come to eat, or simply living here. It is not common to have a guided tour, but it will be worth it if you manage to book one. Also, you should bring or rent a binocular. || Internationally important. Hundreds of millions of birds visit the center in spring and autumn. Here they find resources to continue their migration. Come when the center is most active and come in the early morning to see the most. (This is no zoo; everything is wild and free.) || Very interesting and educational. They said it was the second largest bird sanctuary in the world . I was given a free lecture and tour around the sanctuary. I had an enjoyable couple of hours there. || Wetlands with many blinds to observe birds from. In the morning you can see the staff band migratory birds.

A real fun place for kids, but also for the sea animal lovers. We had a guided tour and it was perfect and well explained. I enjoyed every bit of it. I would have enjoyed more if the glasses were a bit cleaner. Nevertheless, it was fun. PS: The 3D movie was cherry on the top || Would spend there all day. An established place, but it keeps renovating all the time. The shark aquarium is so relaxing and exiting at the same time! The underwater observatory facility is a must. Note- a single ticket is good for a couple of days, so if you want to visit more than once (and you should) plan accordingly. || It is very expensive. The tanks are too small for the large number of fish and turtles. In addition, the glass on the tanks is dirty everywhere, making it difficult to see properly. This needs to be cleaned urgently. The grounds are small overall and half of the attractions consist of films. It is not a must-see. || Good for little kids, probably less for older ones.  The place is trying hard to remain relevant. The underwater observetory is a little old and not really that impressive anymore. However you also get an impressive shark pool and some stingray and sea turtles exhibits. The 3d movie was impressive (but short. 18 min total).  I've certainly been to better aquariums, but this is decent and good for kids. || Wonderful. From walking through the lively coral reef to the 3D cinema which is unlike any other I have witnessed. The screen goes above the head so that it can be protected from any point in the room and looks like the whole is above you. This place is a must see for young and old. It is a beautifully maintained park, with a big variety of coral. The underwater observatory is absolutely amazing. The water of the red see is also accommodating the coral beautifully. The aqua dome is also an experience like none other. The whole is turned into a 3D video and it literally feels like you are under the ocean and touching the sea life yourself.
