The floating deck isn't there as summer hasn't begun, the beach bar is run by a nice team, and Anna is always serving with her sweet smile and kindness. The only negative points are the lack of trash pots really close to the waterline, as the typical Israeli is spoiled and used to litter and then have someone around to clean and collect after them. Also dog owners are requested to have them leashed at the entrance and then leave them to circulate freely among the bathers, peeing on or even pooing at chairs, sunbeds and even on people's bags, towels and clothes, something unacceptable.  Updated 25/4/2025: The entrance to the water is downgraded as the carpets have been relocated over the rolling stones. I could not find the previous southern path which was comfortable and ready to walk in as the stones had been removed before the setting of the carpet. It's now very hard to walk on it, as the stones under the carpet make it uncomfortable and unbalancing for those to walk in the path. The beach also still lacks trashcans close to the waterline, as the existing ones are located about 8-10 meters from it; I've seen many pieces of paper, plastic cups and popsicle wrap on the sand. Anyway it's still the best beach in Eilat. || HHEY MOSHE  VEY MOSHE THANK YOU SO MUCH FOR YOUR COMMENT LOOKING FORWARD TO SEE YOU SOON AT THE BEACH || Decent beach with a nice relaxed atmosphere. Free entrance, public washrooms are clean. The restaurant has average prices but not too high for beach side. Food is delicious, we had the fried cauliflower and salmon wrap, Turkish coffee and an orange-carrot drink, all for 132NIS with tip included. There is plenty of parking and you can rent a lounge chair or regular chair. Swimming isn’t recommended here because there is no lifeguard but some people went in anyways. Sand is a bit rocky but water looks nice and clear. Some sand flies here and there, wheel chair accessible entrance. || I gave a low score because of my expectations. Maybe they were too high. Not sure.  I come from Haifa. In Haifa the beaches have sand when you enter the water, here there are rocks, so you better bring footware to enter the water. The area of the beach is also very small and no free shade on the sand. There are no changing rooms, so we had to change in the toilets which is very strange for a beach. Showers were only outdoor ones - also very strange IMO.  So if you expect to have a changing room, indoor showers where you can get naked, free shade and easily to enter the water without shoes - this place sucks.  Otherwise the water is nice,  and I had fun swimming here nontheless. || Hi Arthur Thank you very much for your detailed response During the winter we take down all the shades because they are not resistant to the strong winds Even the natural beach in the Red Sea is not as sandy as in the Mediterranean and we make efforts to keep the beach as natural as possible At the end of winter we add access roads from designated and special carpets on the waterfront to allow for easy and safe access We hope you will come again in the future and enjoy the beach Best regards The Palm Beach Team || The best beach in Eilat! Quiet and relaxed  (at least during mid March), great bar and sea view, lots of shade and trees. Enjoy a good Shakshuka in the morning :) || Thank you very much Guy What a happy response Happy Purim (: || Beautiful beach, calm and cozy. There is shade, restaurant, clean bathroom. Rent a chair or bed. Friendly staff. We had lots of fun there with the kids! Food was ok. || Very nice beach with clean water and easy way to the Red Sea. Excelente atmosphere and good services. The chairs cost us small and you can stay all day. Very much recommend. || Very nice beach with nice restaurant, good prices. Nice to spend some time. Small reef 20m from shore. || Nice and clean beach. The entry, the bathroom and the shower is free. During the day was not so crowded, maybe because the water is still a bit cold. 😬😄 The beach is a bit rocky but there is a path to the water. || Dear Bence Thank you for your positive comment and rating  Hope to see you soon at the beach again  🌴🌴🌴 …

Decent appartment, not the cleanest but okay. Location not the best in Eilat, if you don't have a car, i would search for an alternative closer to downtown. || It was horrible  little rooms and our family has 5 people we barely fit here I doubt you are going to love it || The place looks like a brutalist architecture jail building for hotels worker, but the positive thing have a good laundry || Poorly maintained, smelly lobby. On the plus side - there's a small convenient store and a pool || real nice place to stay in (as well as living in here) || Except the gardians all was excellent. || Great place for family vacation || Nice place with everything || Very terrible place to stay

So beautiful place for date or good photos || Awsome place amazing view || Amazing view of the sea and the city. Worth coming. || A new place, with a view of the city of Eilat. With an audio explanation that was destroyed due to vandalism (too bad). Great potential for the place. || Excellent viewpoint over the Gulf of Eilat, beautiful view || Indeed an excellent viewpoint over the Gulf of Eilat Not to be missed

This is a smaller operation in Eilat and maybe for that reason the operators rake such pride in eilat and interest to make aure that we had the best possible expericne. And we did. || שירות מדהים!! Went with the whole family ages 6 to over 40 had a blast!! They made sure everyone was enjoying and catered to our needs. Highly recommend. We rented a boat for an hour and a half with the piece attached to the back, everyone had a great time. Not all the boaters on Eilat are the same, we've had others who took advantage and ripped us off. Not theses guys, they're were great! || Wonderful experience, loads of fun. Owners are cooperative and professional. Best motor sea activities in Eilat || Great service and a great time! || We did the attraction on the boat in Eilat and it was just sooooo || We were at Aqua Fun today. Eli and his wife welcomed us with a smile and warmth. Even though it was chilly, it was an amazing experience for the whole family. We had a great time and there is no doubt that when we return in the future we will be happy to spend time at Aqua Fun again. Eli shared his experiences in Eilat with us and did everything with a big smile and ease. Thank you! || It was amazing! We came as a family of eight, ages 12-50, and did the combo deal that included a shark, a snorkel, and a dolphin reef cruise. Don't believe me when they tell you that a shark is like a couch. Well, it's more like skydiving, but fun. The dolphins didn't see fit to talk to us and we just watched them from a distance with their fins. The service was excellent and we had a great time, from young to old || What an amazing experience! We were at Aqua Fun Water Sports and we simply enjoyed every moment. The staff was helpful, courteous and professional at a high level, we felt like we were in the best hands possible. There was good energy, they put on fun music for us and everything with a smile and a good atmosphere. Already in the phone call we received all the information that was clear with a video explaining where the place is. They really deserve all the praise, it is not obvious to encounter such heartfelt service, warm treatment and an unforgettable experience. We will definitely be back again! || A fun experience!! Good, honest people, it was very important to them that we enjoyed the experience without any calculation. A great price, a real find!! Thank you, we will definitely be back again!!!

Very solid beach with beautiful coral reefs. Was super quiet when I went practically empty so was added bonus. Perfect for snorkelling and just general sunbathing. No water sports though. || The world northernmost coral reef, really! Right at your foot steps in eilat, Jordan has none. This beach has the advantage of not being overcrowded and all facilities are here, showers, toilets, bar, and a small nature reserve shop and rental services if you forgot your snorkeling equipment. Note, there are no lifeguard, only park rangers, but there is a space by the beach, in shallow water for poor swimmers Plant to bring some water shoes for the beach side. The reef is accessible via a long pier, and a large staircase leading easily to the water. Then it is the wonders of the red sea! || Although its one of the best places to see corals and fish in Eilat. The site could be a bit more developed. There are not many showers and only one dock to enter the water and relatively small place for swimming. With limited hours of operation and mediocre services this beautiful natural reserve should get an upgrade and the site could invest some of the entrance fee in improvments. || The reserve is well-maintained, clean, and organized, with food shops and equipment rental available. While the price is a bit high compared to free nearby spots, the underwater experience is spectacular- vibrant corals, colorful marine life, and plenty to see.  The area is very accessible, and safety is taken seriously with lifeguards on duty. Showers and restrooms are available and well-kept. Most seating areas are shaded with white canopies, which helps, though it can still get extremely hot in July and August.  Some downsides include ongoing renovations, which limit access to newer sections and make planning a snorkeling route a bit challenging. The designated swimming areas are small and enclosed, but beyond the bridge, there are vast open spaces where you can really explore and see a lot of beautiful marine life.  Overall, it’s more comfortable and enjoyable to snorkel in a well-supervised, maintained area than in unofficial sites, and the beautiful coral and abundant sea creatures make it well worth a visit.  * Pros: Clean and organized, lifeguards on duty, beautiful corals and marine life, showers and restrooms, accessible. * Cons: Entry fee is high compared to free alternatives, renovations limit some areas, enclosed swimming zones can feel small, it can get very hot in summer. || Snorkelling is ok. Nice fish and a bit of coral. If you've been in good reef places, you won't be impressed. But if in Eilat, it's worth a visit but a bit expensive for what it offers. || One of the good beaches in Eilat Clean,  had toilet,  shop,  walk route,  bridge directly to Red see with excitement view of corals, different fish types It's needed some payment,  check possible options before coming there It's better come with your own equipment Pay attention - NO SAFE GUARDS || Our preferred place in Eilat! Every time we are in Eilat we go to this place, the best still and ever.  Actually we were there every day, not a problem as we slept at the Yam Suf Hotel, only a 5 minute walk to there. 1. the beach is incredibly looked after 2. The Reserve guards are watching all the time for trespassers so very little chance something bad could happen to you while swimming 3. and of course the corals and the fish. Yes the coral are less beautiful than in the previous years, the mini tsunami a few years ago did damage the reef, but still they are interesting and the fish are till there and still super beautiful. Don't "FOMO" it, would you? || We had a lovely day out here. It was February, so out of season and not too busy. Lots of beautiful sea life up close in enormous tanks. Also, a very nice undersea viewing room and a sub trip if you want. Loads of facilities and other interesting things to see.....  Lovely and we'll worth a visit 😀 … || Amazing place! Make sure you take snorkels!  For 35 shekel, the place offers quite an experience! A long stretch of white sand, beautiful reefs to snorkel and pretty secure! || The most beautiful marine reserve in the world – colorful gardens beneath the sea The reefs of the Gulf of Eilat are the only coral reefs in our country, and among them a wonderful and colorful world of corals, fish and a huge variety of unique creatures can be seen. The Coral Beach Nature Reserve in Eilat allows visitors easy access to the reef, as well as essential beach services, including a shop, showers, toilets, sunshades, deck chairs and sun loungers

place_name: Hananya Beach - חוף חנניה ספורט ימי ושייט
reviews_content: Nice place they offer various water attractions. We did parasailing. The place is quite expensive, but the instructors were really nice and professional. I noticed that in other places the parachute fell into the water several times, but here they managed to keep it dry and handled everything very professionally. Highly recommended! || A very beautiful and cozy small beach surrounded by palm trees and restaurants near the hotels on the one side, and a lagoon with beautiful yachts and tourist shopping area with numerous outlets - on the other. The water is good, clean and pleasant, but there can be stones near the shore. The best option that I can advise everyone is to buy rubber shoes in a store near the beach specially for beaches. Pleasure and comfort for the feet are guarantee. || I had an amazing time at this beach. The views are incredible, the local offerings are more than sufficient, and it is overall incredibly enjoyable. I recommend (if in a large group) hiring a boat to go out further into the red sea, it's an amazing experience and the views are once in a lifetime. You can even get a speedboat to take you out for water tubing! || Boat cruise and coral and fish gazing.. Superb weather and lovely calm sea.. Excellent way to spend 2 to 3 hours in Beautiful Eilat.. || Nice beach but the music of the Maman restaurant is always too loud || Eilat was nice. A bit expensive overall, for what it offered, but a pleasant experience. || I always include this activity when I'm in Eilat. Great sport sea sport activity, highly professional and service oriented team, great location and variety of activities for almost every age! || Very nice place to take a recreation || Great beach, fantastic relaxation. Clean, peaceful. || Nice place. We stay there in december.

Best suited for snorkeling.  Even if you don't know swimming you can  rent the snorkeling face  equipment and just use it next to the beach to view the amazing corals and beautiful fishes. || You might be able to peek here and there at the reef. Not the entire area is accessible to public. They have a 750m long lane accessible with bridges for swimming, snorkeling and scuba diving (bring your own gear- though they might rent if needed - at least snorkeling). Not really food option but it’s a nice bring your own food stay by the beach kind of place. There is a supermarket across from the road where parking is free and where you can get goodies.  Amenities are sparse but that is fine. || Amazing beach. So fun jumping off the deck! Really gorgeous views and access to marine life. Free beach and they offer lounge chairs and snacks! || Very cool beach, only with rocks and perfect for snorkeling and diving. Location well equipped with bar, umbrellas and deckchairs. || Great beach for snorkeling. Gear rental on site. Picnic tables, shade and food. || Heaven for snorkelling, especially for nervous snorkellers: they have designed a snorkelling 'route' around the reef with a rope you can use for guidance and feeling a bit more secure. The marine life is amazing with huge colourful fish. They rope of the main reef to protect it from damage from selfish tourists, but you can still see it from the edge. Beach has plenty of shade and chairs. All equipment and lockers available. Take your own food  as all you can get here are french fries or frozen pizza they heat up. You can get here by a 5 minute bus from the main area of Eilat. || Very well organized for snorkeling but maybe too much... in the water you can’t really get close to the corals and there are many people at the same place so not so wild as you could expect. || Great experience. Lots of space to sit. The snorkelling was great fun and there were lots and lots of fish. || Good facilities with snorkel hire, locker hire, shower, toilets etc. However, you have to view the coral in a guided lane, which is very restrictive. The coral is better in other places along the coast, but there was a decent variety of fish to see. || It's a place with shower, toilets, diving equipment to rent, shops and more. There public bus lines getting you from any point of Eilat to this Nature Reserve Beach. In Hebrew: חוף האלמוג Hof Halmog. The beach is huge and very clean. Wonderful for sea nature lovers because there you can see all the sea life just getting in the sea. The Red Sea waters are an spectacle for the clear swimming, good temperature and the lack of waves that allow you to see all the amazing under water life. The entrance is not free. You may need to call to know opening hours and entry ticket prices.

The Best Hotel in Eilat for kids!!!!!! There is no other hotel that will take it from U koral beach. Just bring your kid in the morning to the entertainment crew and your kid will be busy all day - amazing! Yes, it pretty far from the main city, but you have everything in the hotel, even beach nearby. I will come back next year! || Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We’re delighted to hear you enjoyed your stay and we look forward to welcoming you back again soon. 🌞 … || I have visited this resort 4 times over the past 27 years (three times in the past five years) and am always happy to return there. The staff are friendly and attentive, the location is excellent - within walking distance of tennis courts, … || I have stayed at U Coral Beach Club multiple times in the past few years with my wife. Overall, it remains one of the most activity-rich hotels in Eilat, but the standards decline each year and might no longer fully justify the price.  Room cleanliness was disappointing. We were upgraded from a Superior U room (the most basic category) to a balcony room, but the upgrade was not worthwhile. Last time we stayed in the Superior U room, and to me it felt newer, cleaner, and had a much nicer bathroom than the balcony room. The balcony room’s bathroom was very small, with a combined tub/shower and only a half glass partition, so water splashed everywhere. The Superior U bathroom, while shower-only, is more spacious and modern. In the balcony room, the tub felt old and not properly cleaned, there was hair on the bed, the sofa bed was opened without request, and there was no water or welcome package in the room..  I would not recommend staying during a storm. Check the weather! The power went out for about half an hour, and roads into and out of Eilat were closed. Reception handled this well and graciously offered us an additional night at a slightly discounted rate (around 10%), which we declined. Instead, they offered a complimentary dinner pass, which was much appreciated.  The food remains a strong point. Dinner was excellent, with a wide and impressive variety: steaks, asado, pulled beef bao buns, schnitzel, chicken dishes, and more. The variety is consistently very good. Breakfast, however, was underwhelming. Limited selection, poor pastries, mediocre orange juice, and only black and green tea available.  The dairy restaurant is very good, but availability is limited to certain days and requires first-come, first-served sign-up. Arriving early is essential.  Unlimited cocktails are fun, but the bar offering is basic. Mostly straight liquors with fruit juices. The slushies are extremely sweet and artificial. Bartender skill varies significantly, though one bartender managed to make a decent piña colada. Drinks are always served in plastic cups, though glass cups can be requested at the indoor bar.  Snorkel rentals and beach equipment are excellent. However, windsurfing is advertised but never seems to happen. On multiple visits there has always been an excuse. This time we were told the instructor had passed away...  I would go again, mainly because no other hotel in Eilat offers this level of activities and programming. That said, for the price, cleanliness, room quality, and overall standards should be higher. || We had the best weekend ever! The bridge too the beach is amazing,food was more than expected so much verity options in every meal! The view from the room was breathtaking, it was fun n relaxing.. thank you || Thank you so much for your wonderful feedback! We’re delighted to hear that you had such an amazing weekend and enjoyed the easy beach access, the rich variety of food, and the beautiful room view. It’s great to know your stay was both fun and relaxing. We truly appreciate your kind words! || We have been guests of this hotel for the best part of 20 years already from when it was Club Med, sometimes just the 2 of us, at other times with our family of 8 to 10. In general it used to be very good but has progressively badly … || We have been guests of this hotel for at least 20 years, at times the 2 of us only, other times with a family of 8 to 10. In general it’s good, though standards get progressively lower and lower. The beach is no longer private. The quality … || I left something behind, I feel so bad because it was my favourite to play with. It smells a little, but I promise it’s friendly. Don’t forget to feed it. It’s called “Nigel” please shout his name because he’s hard of hearing. He’s shy so could only one person look for him. Thank you. You are all so lovely. I will come back in 2 days please find him 💔 || Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We’re delighted to hear you enjoyed your stay and we look forward to welcoming you back again soon. 🌞 … || Our stay at Club Inn Eilat was a nightmare from start to finish. The room was neglected and filthy, with peeling walls and a constant smell of mold and dampness. The bathroom was covered with mold – absolutely unacceptable for a hotel, more … || For those who want to save on shopping and dining out  -U coral beach is the perfect place.5 meals -breakfast,dinner,coffee and cake,supper,pizza stand at night,free bar from 9 till 00,entertaining programs for grown ups and kids-so no need … || Huge Thanks to U Coral Beach!  We stayed at U Coral Beach and left with the best impression possible—mostly thanks to the incredible and caring staff.  The welcome was warm and professional. The reception team—just amazing! Polite, patient, and genuinely respectful towards guests. Every request was met promptly and with a smile, every question received an immediate answer, as if they were just waiting to assist.  The rooms were clean, tidy, and equipped with everything you need. And if something was missing, we only had to ask,...It was there. The attention to detail was evident at every turn.  A special thank-you to Pnina, who takes care of guests with allergies. Her attitude was exceptional, straight from the heart. Even on our departure day, she made sure we had sweet surprises and everything we needed for the journey.  The hotel runs on an “all-inclusive” basis, and we’d say—“all-inclusive plus”! Delicious, diverse, clean, and always served with courtesy.  We can’t forget to mention the U Eataly restaurant—part of the package, but it felt like a true bonus! The waitstaff—simply outstanding: polite, quick, and making you feel like a VIP. Even if you’re not a huge fan of Italian cuisine, once you taste it here, you’ll fall in love. We had lunch there and couldn’t make it to dinner.  The hotel offers activities for the whole family—kids, adults, evening shows—it’s all just wonderful.  The lobby bar and the pool bar are always available—hot drinks, cold drinks, whatever you need. And the staff—oh, their patience! With kids, and… let’s just say, with some adults too.  We also want to highlight how the management treats the staff. We witnessed a situation with a guest complaint (let’s be honest—every hotel has them), and we were impressed by how professionally and compassionately it was handled. The manager showed respect both to the guest and to the junior staff member, supporting her while politely resolving the issue. It was very impressive.  U Coral Beach, everything was fantastic! Thank you for an amazing vacation. We will definitely come back! || dear guests Thanks for the support on the site, We are happy to know that you enjoyed your stay We were happy to host you and would love to see you again soon welcome Hotel staff

place_name: שיעור חתירה✔️סאפים להשכרה✔️סאפים למכירה✔️סי וולף✔️Sea Wolf✔️
reviews_content: Aqua Marina SUP is located straight by the Dan Hotel Beach in Eilat. They are official Aqua Marina distributor. You can find the full range of boards for the purchase. As it is a SUP rental point, you can try and ride the models you want to choose from. But, the most important thing is kind and professional staff. I'd like to thank Yuri especially for the best service one can dream about. I, personally, had a hard choice between 4 models: Fusion, Beast, Magma, and Hyper. After detailed explanation only two left in the short list. I was kindly prompted to try both of them on the water. The result is simple: one more 5 star satisfied customer leaving with 5 star 2-chamber Hyper touring board. If I ever need any SUP related service, I will get back there. || Alex , it was my pleasure to help you choose a sup , it is what we do and will continue to work this way . Thank you for your kind review it is very nice of you . || Супер, там можно взять на прокат starboards ❤️  Starboard creates the world's most innovative & quality stand up paddleboards. With the widest range offering on the planet, there is the perfect Starboard paddle board for everyone's individual requirements, skill level, budget and type of paddling. || Great sup instructor, Yuri. The lesson was excellent and the accompanying even better. Highly recommended for beginners and advanced || Thank you Tal  It was my pleasure to share my sup instruction for your lovely family . It was fun and everybody did very well on the sup. Thanks fornthe review 😍 … || Excellent customer services and quality products 👌 , very recommended … || Best paddleboard SUP place in Eilat || Thanks so much for the review !!! || A wonderful shopping experience and super professional people great service and excellent prices highly recommended || Great place, amazing and professional people Great prices!!!!! Don’t hesitate for a minute. || Bought a SUP , service was excellent and so was the price || Good service good quality, waiting to go into the water! || Fantastic service nice people

It is well-organized place there are nice discounts if you buy from clubs like the military Reserve Club or the teachers club or the Police Club definitely don't pay full price. Something I didn't like here is that they're both are really slow compared to other clubs in the city it is probably the club with the slowest boats in the area. They say 'banana' rides but it is actually an air boat and nothing similar If you're going to do it with kids then it's fine if they're small but if you have big kids and they want some action they won't get it here. || Beyond unprofessional and a waste of money. Luckily they gave a refund… my boyfriend purchased the two of us packages (over 600 shekels total) and we weren’t even in the air for 10 minutes while parasailing. The captain of the boat told me I was annoying because another couple asked me to take photos of them while they were in the air. I told him that sounds like a personal problem and I won’t be stopping. Also, you’d think after spending a lot of money, atleast one water could be offered for free. We wanted to buy water and it wasn’t even cold, It makes no sense that a place that makes a lot of money daily is selling warm water and their employees have horrible professionalism while working. We sat on the banana boat for about 20 minutes waiting to leave the dock… then decided to get up and get a refund. I’ll never recommend this place to any of my friends who travel from the USA to Eliat. They can find much better than this! || Beautiful location and a great place to walk or relax. Stopped by and had fun watching everyone enjoy being here. Nice area to relax. || Awesome place! Great stuff, and super safe. We took the boat for a ride, it was super clean and easy to operate. We also did the Banana which was absolutely insane!!! Highly recommend 👍👍👍 … || Absolutely horrible, the boat guide was extremely rude and turned the boat around back to the dock just because my cousin fell of the “banana” intentionally, he was really aggressive and seemed like he was looking for the smallest excuse to turn back, if I could give 0 stars I would, DONT BOTHER COMING HERE AT ALL || After an hour waiting for our order we spent another 30 minutes to cancel it... Nice view, worst service. || Absolutely beautiful and the Red Sea is actually blue. || This is the third time we came here with our caravan, and every it gets even better. We get to park next to our own little picnic table and light. and we have a connection to water and electricity. There are also publuc toilets and showers. We get to park in the middle of a beautiful park, with lots of hiking trails, bicycle trails and other activities. || The water sport service at Kisuski beach is strongly NON recommended!  My wife and I had last morning in Eilat dedicated to do some extreme activity on the sea. We decided to try an aqua scooter (they call it "jenski"). 1 day ahead we called them and arranged it at 9am next day. When we arrived, a guy told us that his scooter driver is still sleeping and he is trying to solve the problem. Then he said to us to walk around and come back at 10:30am. Then he called us at 10:00 and told us he is sorry but the problem is not solved yet. After that we gave up and went to a beach. We believe this behavior is disrespectful to other people time...  What do you think? || Great place to do watersport and we had fun . The organization however is very chaotic and some of the staff is unfriendly and uncommunicative. It's hard to understand what's going on and when the next ride will take place. We had to wait a long time in line.

We came 5 mins after 12pm (and tickets are valid also tomorrow from the morning only! - as explained on the cash desk); spent some half day here late March; sea temperature fresh but still acceptable; not so crowded today; beach service collect beach chairs regularly; easy to find place and take chairs, we enjoy hot and cold sweets with coffee and fresh Mint lemonade. Really tasty; recommended; next time I repeat. || Amazing ! Such an incredible experience ! Staff are also amazing ! Estelle was great called me told me best times to come ! Mayaan was so welcoming and beautiful and IRa was amazing guide ! She was brilliant and supported me on my first dive ! Dolphins are everywhere ❤️❤️ || For the standard entrance fee you can swim at the beach and spend some time on the pier to film and shoot the dolphins (pier closes at 5 pm). Then you have a bar restaurant upstairs in a wonderful place (forbidden under 18 years old). From this place you still can see the dolphins, enjoy the sun and even stay until 11 pm! || Great place. We did snorkeling with the dolphins, it was great to see them in their natural habitat. Our instructor was a very nice and professional lady that took care of everyone’s comfort and made sure everyone is safe and have an amazing time. I was really scared of the depth but thanks to her I could overcome my fear and enjoy the moment. I can’t thank her enough. It’s a place one of a kind and people there are very welcoming. I highly recommend, worth every penny. || I had a great expirience to dive with dolphins..its something amazing..also the place its like heaven..its diferent than other places that i saw in Israel. The relaxing pools inside its something special too. I recommand everyone to visit. || Wonderful location, really worth the detour even though it's located on the other side of Eilat. There's also a bar inside where you can order drinks and bites. Service was great and the food was delicious. A big 5! || Very clean beach and not too crowded. Dolphins seem happy and free. Very good diving guides, and great service. They even offered us a refund for  for one who couldn't make it on time, because they had another person who was interested to dive instead. || Very beautiful dolphin reef. Tourist attraction. We saw 3 dolphins. The food here was delicious, totally recommend! There are also student fares for entry. || Dolphin Reef in Eilat is a natural habitat of Dolphins. We can observe the dolphins 🐬 from the floating bridge provided. The dolphins are very playful and you are allowed to touch them if you wish to.  The security staff watches over the dolphins as well as feeds them.Some snorkeling facility is also there. We visited long back. The Dolphin Reef is open from Monday to Saturday.  Timings: 9 am to 5 pm. We spent some time observing the dolphins.  There is an entry fee. || The most wonderful beach in Eilat. It’s like a completely different world everything beautiful and clean and pleasant. The food at the beach restaurant is great. And to watch the dolphins is certainly a bonus 🐬 …

place_name: שגי סאפ & רכיבה על אופניים - Sheggy Sup&Cycling
reviews_content: One of the best places in Eilat. Great selection of water activities, lovely and friendly staff, always a great time. A real fun place for kids, but also for the sea animal lovers. We had a guided tour and it was perfect and well explained. I enjoyed every bit of it. I would have enjoyed more if the glasses were a bit cleaner. Nevertheless, it was fun. PS: The 3D movie was cherry on the top || Would spend there all day. An established place, but it keeps renovating all the time. The shark aquarium is so relaxing and exiting at the same time! The underwater observatory facility is a must. The tanks are too small for the large number of fish and turtles. In addition, the glass on the tanks is dirty everywhere, making it difficult to see properly. This needs to be cleaned urgently. The underwater observetory is a little old and not really that impressive anymore. However you also get an impressive shark pool and some stingray and sea turtles exhibits. The 3d movie was impressive (but short. 18 min total).  I've certainly been to better aquariums, but this is decent and good for kids. || Wonderful. From walking through the lively coral reef to the 3D cinema which is unlike any other I have witnessed. The screen goes above the head so that it can be protected from any point in the room and looks like the whole is above you. This place is a must see for young and old. It is a beautifully maintained park, with a big variety of coral. The underwater observatory is absolutely amazing. The water of the red see is also accommodating the coral beautifully. The aqua dome is also an experience like none other. The whole is turned into a 3D video and it literally feels like you are under the ocean and touching the sea life yourself. Great place to visit, both educational and fun. its really impressive to see all the unique creatures that live in the ocean. dedicate at least several hours to the visit. || This place gets it!  It's all about the service and people.  Incredibly helpful and friendly staff.  Very clean place.  Food was good and fair priced.  The exhibits were all well maintained.  Especially with children, this is a very nice all day activity. || We’ve been to aquariums all over the world and this isn’t the glossiest or the most high tech. We love this charming little place. The 3-D movie was a huge hit! || What a great chance to sit and watch fish for hours! (3pm) it far less crowded. There's a tube to walk under the fish and rays, beautiful. There are also turtles and "rare creatures" (which we didn't find very "rare"). The "deep sea creatures" exhibit is only videos. The lowest point must be the "IMAX", the movie is short, although the 3D effect is cool (kids loved it), but the narration (Heb only) is unintelligible, the content is boring, and they play a "generic" 3D flick. The underwater structure is very nice, but many windows are way too high for a 3-4 y/o to see anything without carrying them 💪, still it's very worth the while (climb up to see the overlook). If you fear heights, this is the place to get over you fear  Big thanks to Diar for being amazing — super friendly, helpful, and really made the experience even better. We had so muchhh fun! 😍😍 would recommend 10/10 to anyone coming to Aqaba and loved adventure 😍😍 … || The staff are friendly, professional, and make you feel safe the whole time. The atmosphere is fun, energetic, and the views around Ayla make it even better , we had so much fun will definitely try it again . Both Hamzeh and Sanad made the experience even more fun and memorable.  Definitely one of the best adventure spots in Aqaba. Highly recommended! || Rise Up is super fun and addictive! Easy to play, smooth controls, and the levels really keep you hooked. Honestly, such a cool game — totally worth trying!  Rating: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️  A big thank you to *SAND* and *Hamza*! You two made the whole vibe fun, competitive, and full of excitement. Thanks for bringing all this energy — you really made the game so much better! || A very pleasant experience 😍 The staff were kind and helpful 🙏 Thank you, ( Sand and Hamza ) for everything❤️ … || Such a fun place to play! The atmosphere is full of energy and perfect for kids (and adults!) to enjoy. The staff are super friendly, helpful, and make the whole experience even better. Special thanks to captain Sanad and captain Farah! Super helpful! || Amazinggg crazyyy experience!! The games are realllyyy fun and challenging! Captain Sanad was the besttt he definitely leveled up the excitement !! Special thanks to him!! A must go and a nice place to consider while you are in Aqaba || “Coach Sand was amazing! He was very nice, helpful, and made the game so much fun. He explained everything clearly and was very respectful. We really enjoyed the experience. Thank you!” || It was an amazing day! You should absolutely try this adventure. And Sanad made the experience even better 🔥 … || It was one of the most beautiful days❤️. It was a very enjoyable and wonderful adventure🥹. Indeed, it is a very special and elegant place. It contains very special games, including climbing 🧗‍♀️and zip-line. And let us not forget the golf adventure⛳. It is very enjoyable. They have a special place for children🚸 as well. They had a high-quality security system🦸, and what’s best is the very distinguished staff.  Especially Captain🏅 Mo💪❤️ Captain 🏅Abdullah❤️ they are very wonderful

The place is scary but not as much as other places like this in Israel (like the maze ect.) And it's cost more than the other places. The time in the activity depends on the speed you're moving inside. If you're moving fast it's about 5 minutes tops. || This place was definitely scary! Went with my 14 year old son and 12 year old daughter. They had a very scary experience, but my daughter was really scared and even cried a bit at the end. Still loved it though. It is pretty expensive however for such a short experience. I'm glad we went anyway and had the experience. || Been there like 15 years ago and not much has changed.  It's different experience and I like it.  The only reason I gave it 4 stars is how short the activity is and extremely expensive. || It was far more terrifying than I expected! I wouldn’t recommend it if you don’t like scary things, but if you’re feeling brave, consider paying this place a visit! || 70₪ for 7 minutes of "horror". not even a maze just a corridor with a few corners and easily predicted jump-"scares" || A nice and scary place.For some reason no restrooms at a site.As supposed was scary... but not for a 40 year old. || Really nice sort of spooky experience. Is less scary than it used to be, but still something you should try at least once. || Take full caution if you go there! The place is not safe and the management is covering it. not worth the risk any more... || Good effects but less than 10 mintues and 60 ils is too much for what you get. || Not scary at all! Go with 2 year olds or maybe 4 year olds

There is something called the feast It's a banquet lots of alcohol makes people feel free to interact with one another... Live music (the house D.J) And good food not the highlight of the event so don't expect much... The event is hosted in Hebrew so take it under advisement Highly recommended || We appriciate your compliment very much, thankyou. The Feast is our obligition to make sure that every single visitor has the best experience and we are happy to know that you highly recommend. We would love to see you again soon! || We had such a great afternoon doing a family camel ride and then eating pita made right in front of us while we sipped delicious Bedouin tea. I’m so happy I found this place! So many other fun adventures to do besides camel riding as well. I wish we had more time there! || Absolutely great place. Our friendly guide Eric made it a fun and friendly trip, and shared a lot about Israeli culture over the food he made for us. This made it a great experience way above just riding the camels. || Great low cost alternative for a hotel, you set up your tent here and get a portable ac to keep you cool at night (a must during the summer months). Showers and restrooms also available (and clean). There are other tourists attractions here but I came only for a place to sleep and was very satisfied. || This was a very nice experience for a family with kids. Two (maybe more) hours to spend in a pastoral location, with a very kind guide, a nice desert in the end, makes the experience worth the money. Recommended. || Short walk around an area in the desert just south of Eilat. Loved being able to ride a camel at least once in my life.  Nice little snack of handmade flat bread on an item fire and olives afterward too. Half the staff were really nice, the others... well, it must have been a rough week for them or something. || We used the self tent area, and got to use all facilities and also got small air conditioner to the tent. It was awesome, we slept perfect, price was very low - 50 shekels per person. On the perimeter you can find toilets and showers (privet cells), kitchen with fridge and frizzer, a lot of barbecue for use, many nice sitting areas. Very close to the sea and all the diving and kitesufeing areas and clubs , very quite at night, not close to the city (for us its an advantage). Best way to camp in Eilat. || We came for a short camel ride (~$12 pp) which was very nice. Later, the camel handler let us feed the camels and goats with crackers. There's a small cantina where we got some popsicles. Better to get there before noon or 11am when the heat is still bearable. They have other activities like buggy rides and an extreme park for kids. || Very good and enjoyable place, friendly staff, wonderful guide for the calem ride, who as prepares the bedouin meal in the end of the ride. Camels are calm and friendly, camel saddles are comfortable. Very joyful expetience! || We did donkey carriage ride with tea and pita with small kids. Was a short ride but nice for family will kids. Only disappointment was that pita was replaced with matza during pesach... Camel ride is for a bit more advanced people (because it's high) and jeep to go further into the desert. This place had very clean toilets and gramping facilities and a ninja-kind of athletics for bigger kids over 120cm.

Terrible service Terrible people We really did not enjoy either And not from water sports nearby Really do not recommend !!!  Luckily we got a corrective omelet On the south coast of the city  Really not recommended, simply terrible attitude After a big family viewing We were disappointed. Just try the electric beach They gave us a corrective omelet. || When we arrived at the island, the music was horribly loud, we asked to turn it down, and then a guy named Ilan said it wasn't nice to disturb people who were enjoying the music. There were a few of my friends there who were smoking weed the whole time, even though we got there with kids, it didn't bother them. The float didn't go up more than a meter high, even though in the promotional photos it looks like it goes up a few meters, there must have been a problem with the jet ski. After the float, they gave us another five minutes and sent us back to the beach. In conclusion, the final feeling was that we were bothering them and they wanted to get rid of us as quickly as possible, even though we paid 390 shekels for it. Not recommended || That's great, I have an apartment there and I don't need any gifts. || normal place. interesting || Small park. Not particularly rocky. || Crazy experience!!, highly recommended!!!!

We came 5 mins after 12pm (and tickets are valid also tomorrow from the morning only! - as explained on the cash desk); spent some half day here late March; sea temperature fresh but still acceptable; not so crowded today; beach service collect beach chairs regularly; easy to find place and take chairs, we enjoy hot and cold sweets with coffee and fresh Mint lemonade. Really tasty; recommended; next time I repeat. || Amazing ! Such an incredible experience ! Staff are also amazing ! Estelle was great called me told me best times to come ! Mayaan was so welcoming and beautiful and IRa was amazing guide ! She was brilliant and supported me on my first dive ! Dolphins are everywhere ❤️❤️ || For the standard entrance fee you can swim at the beach and spend some time on the pier to film and shoot the dolphins (pier closes at 5 pm). Then you have a bar restaurant upstairs in a wonderful place (forbidden under 18 years old). From this place you still can see the dolphins, enjoy the sun and even stay until 11 pm! || Great place. We did snorkeling with the dolphins, it was great to see them in their natural habitat. Our instructor was a very nice and professional lady that took care of everyone’s comfort and made sure everyone is safe and have an amazing time. I was really scared of the depth but thanks to her I could overcome my fear and enjoy the moment. I can’t thank her enough. It’s a place one of a kind and people there are very welcoming. I highly recommend, worth every penny. || I had a great expirience to dive with dolphins..its something amazing..also the place its like heaven..its diferent than other places that i saw in Israel. The relaxing pools inside its something special too. I recommand everyone to visit. || Wonderful location, really worth the detour even though it's located on the other side of Eilat. There's also a bar inside where you can order drinks and bites. Service was great and the food was delicious. A big 5! || Very clean beach and not too crowded. Dolphins seem happy and free. Very good diving guides, and great service. They even offered us a refund for  for one who couldn't make it on time, because they had another person who was interested to dive instead. || Very beautiful dolphin reef. Tourist attraction. We saw 3 dolphins. The food here was delicious, totally recommend! There are also student fares for entry. || Dolphin Reef in Eilat is a natural habitat of Dolphins. We can observe the dolphins 🐬 from the floating bridge provided. The dolphins are very playful and you are allowed to touch them if you wish to.  The security staff watches over the dolphins as well as feeds them.Some snorkeling facility is also there. We visited long back. The Dolphin Reef is open from Monday to Saturday.  Timings: 9 am to 5 pm. We spent some time observing the dolphins.  There is an entry fee. || The most wonderful beach in Eilat. It’s like a completely different world everything beautiful and clean and pleasant. The food at the beach restaurant is great. And to watch the dolphins is certainly a bonus 🐬 …

It was such a great experience!!! We all had so much fun, everything went smoothly- left on time,  the skipper was very professional, made sure to explain us everything, put great music and did everything for all us to feel comfortable and enjoy, we even went to see the dolphins || Thanks Tal!! What a pleasure to read a comment like this.  You are amazing Thank you very much🩷 … || It was such a great experience nice and friendly owner good vibes couldn’t really see the dolphins but apart from that we had a really good time || Thank You Very Much Tova || Haim was fun as well as responsible and everyone had the best time- kids and adults. His boat and water equipment were clean and great and aside from the extreme stuff, we saw dolphins and got to swim in the amazing Red Sea. This has been a highlight of our holiday. || Thank you very much Ayelet!  So happy you all enjoyed and hoping to see you all again soon || We had very nice experience they were very accommodating and we would definitely go back and definitely recommend || Thank you so much! Visiting for your next visit to Eilat 🙏🏻👍🏻 … || This was so fun!! The entire experience was great! Great communication and Haim was a great captain! Don't miss this if you are in Eilat! Definitely worth it!! || Thank you very much Danna! Was a pleasure having you guys onboard with us! || Perfect we recommend for all || Thank you very much 🚤🙏🏻 … || We went here and it was very fun for all of us. Everyone is really nice. It was a great experience! || Thank you very much Sharon! You are a lovely family and it was our pleasure to be part of your vacation See you next vacation. || Wonderful people to work with. Very sensitive to one child who was scared. Highly recommend || Thank you very much Mimi! Hope to see you all again soon || Super fun experience with really nice people. Strongly recommend! || Glad to hear that! Thank you very much and hope to see you guys again soon || This was a fun experience for my teen daughters. || Thank you very much Emilia What fun we had with you Thank you very much for choosing us See you next vacation

Fun outdoor mall. Lots of cold drinks available, and you will need them! || Fantastic experience, just miracle of creatings watching the corals! || A great place to walk around, shop, eat, or watch the sunset/sunrise! || Nice park with 4 rides and an ice cave with bar and a slide, expensive || Ticket price of 55 ISL is just meaningless. || Best experience in Israel and specialy Eliot || Like all shops in Eilat. Expensive. || Nice night activities

I was truly impressed by how many plants are thriving here in the middle of the desert. You can really feel how much love, care, and hard work have been put into creating and maintaining this beautiful garden. It’s an oasis of green and peace in Eilat! The café is also a lovely surprise - great coffee, a vegan-friendly menu, and delicious homemade sweets. A perfect place to relax and enjoy nature! || Thank you very match.Hope to see you again. || Its a nice little botanic garden with varied species, especially for an arid desert. Many flies around so bring some anti-mosquito cream, also obviously it's outside - so if you come when it's very hot you will have a hard time walking around. || Thank you very much for the high score and the wonderful review. In the warm seasons, it is definitely advisable to come in the morning to enjoy the good and pleasant weather. || Definitely worth visiting. Very nice place a lot of shadow. Most of the wooden staff is made of reused wood. I would add in my personal opinion it's one of the best places to visit in Eilat. || Thank you very much for the high score, And the lovely review || This place was really a suprice. I tought this was quite basic , but this place is very nice. It has many view points to take pictures. There is alot walking routes and places to sit. If you visit eilat this is a good place to go. || Thank you very much for the high score Hope to see you again || Lovely visit and well worth visiting. Warm welcome on arrival. Great views. You'll also find out about an army look out post among the botanical gardens and rain forest. || Beautiful and uniqe tropical island in the desert. Plenty of adorable sitting spots and lots of shaded areas. Don't miss out the rain forest water sprinklers on hot days! The place is way above expectations for a private initiative like that. || Thank you very much for the high score and the great review. We hope to see you again. || I don't know one tree or plant from another but the attraction of this place is just comprehending that they were able to build this beautiful tropical oasis in the middle of a desert. It looks like it's been there forever. I can't even imagine the effort that went in to developing this lovely oasis from scratch. We had lovely weather on a ;day in mid-March and spent 2 hours walking the trails and relaxing in the shade, a morning of tranquility. (If you have mobility issues then it would be difficult to climb some of the steep inclines and stairs. We had no problem but be forewarned). || Thank you very much Eric for the high rating. We hope to see you again." || It's a lovely place to visit Especially because it's one men's dream to fight the dessert.. And boy did it work .. Don't expect to much but it is growing.. I'd recommend it heartily || Thank you very much for the high score Hope to see you again‏‏ || Nice place with kind people The story around it is pretty awesome but the place it self is simple It’s not too big so I would say it’s about 2 hours activity You can enter with any kind of food (just water) so leave it in your car before you go. || Thank you very much for the high score Hope to see you again‏ || They threw us out when we asked if we could eat their. We payed for being there and their only replay was that "you can't eat here if you don't buy food" They also said that your not allowed to bring dogs and they have dogs there. Such hypocrits!

Amazing place: great vibes, great beach, excellent music and DJ!  Come on Friday for the shabbat eve dance party and you won't regret it. Food and drinks are also nice. Staff is busy, but courteous. There is something for everyone.  I've been to Eilat several times and I've never been there. I will ALWAYS stop by there every time I'm there from now on. || Hi Ryan, Thank you very, very much for the kind and detailed feedback, and thank you as well for the positive rating. On behalf of the entire Dekel Beach team, I sincerely thank you. See you again soon. 🌴🌴🌴 || Good clean beach. Chairs are 10 shekels/chair, sunbathing chair 20. Nice food at the restaurant on the beach. Make sure to grab slippers or wet shoes to enter the sea. It's either really hot to walk on the send or really painful to walk on little sharp stones. And bring water:) || Hey Nina  Thanks for your rating and comment  We're very happy to hear that you had a great time at the beach  🌴🌴🍸🌴🌴 … || 2022: Well structured for the beach lover. Clean bathrooms. Good bar service. The site is split into two different styles: - north side has a large wooden deck, suited for those who want to sit by the tables, close to the bar and restaurant; - south side is rustically styled, with straw shades (and also a large canvas tent during summertime). There is chair, table and sunbed rental service available at official prices on both sides. During summertime they also place a floating deck with sunbathing sofas and cushions for rent.  Entry to water is made through carpets on definite corridors in order to prevent visitors from revolving the stones and corals, which is a nice idea. Updated 10/23: entry to the water had been improved by them having removed the larger stones from under those carpets as it was quite impossible not to stumble on them, once we were never able to know where they were. Updated 3/25: The place is clean, beach service has improved. The floating deck isn't there as summer hasn't begun, the beach bar is run by a nice team, and Anna is always serving with her sweet smile and kindness. The only negative points are the lack of trash pots really close to the waterline, as the typical Israeli is spoiled and used to litter and then have someone around to clean and collect after them. Also dog owners are requested to have them leashed at the entrance and then leave them to circulate freely among the bathers, peeing on or even pooing at chairs, sunbeds and even on people's bags, towels and clothes, something unacceptable.  Updated 25/4/2025: The entrance to the water is downgraded as the carpets have been relocated over the rolling stones. I could not find the previous southern path which was comfortable and ready to walk in as the stones had been removed before the setting of the carpet. It's now very hard to walk on it, as the stones under the carpet make it uncomfortable and unbalancing for those to walk in the path. The beach also still lacks trashcans close to the waterline, as the existing ones are located about 8-10 meters from it; I've seen many pieces of paper, plastic cups and popsicle wrap on the sand. Anyway it's still the best beach in Eilat. || HHEY MOSHE  VEY MOSHE THANK YOU SO MUCH FOR YOUR COMMENT LOOKING FORWARD TO SEE YOU SOON AT THE BEACH || Decent beach with a nice relaxed atmosphere. Free entrance, public washrooms are clean. The restaurant has average prices but not too high for beach side. Food is delicious, we had the fried cauliflower and salmon wrap, Turkish coffee and an orange-carrot drink, all for 132NIS with tip included. There is plenty of parking and you can rent a lounge chair or regular chair. Swimming isn’t recommended here because there is no lifeguard but some people went in anyways. Sand is a bit rocky but water looks nice and clear. Some sand flies here and there, wheel chair accessible entrance. || I gave a low score because of my expectations. Maybe they were too high. Not sure.  I come from Haifa. In Haifa the beaches have sand when you enter the water, here there are rocks, so you better bring footware to enter the water. The area of the beach is also very small and no free shade on the sand. There are no changing rooms, so we had to change in the toilets which is very strange for a beach. Showers were only outdoor ones - also very strange IMO.  So if you expect to have a changing room, indoor showers where you can get naked, free shade and easily to enter the water without shoes - this place sucks.  Otherwise the water is nice,  and I had fun swimming here nontheless. || Hi Arthur Thank you very much for your detailed response During the winter we take down all the shades because they are not resistant to the strong winds Even the natural beach in the Red Sea is not as sandy as in the Mediterranean and we make efforts to keep the beach as natural as possible At the end of winter we add access roads from designated and special carpets on the waterfront to allow for easy and safe access We hope you will come again in the future and enjoy the beach Best regards The Palm Beach Team || The best beach in Eilat! Quiet and relaxed  (at least during mid March), great bar and sea view, lots of shade and trees. Enjoy a good Shakshuka in the morning :) || Thank you very much Guy What a happy response Happy Purim (: || Beautiful beach, calm and cozy. There is shade, restaurant, clean bathroom. Rent a chair or bed. Friendly staff. We had lots of fun there with the kids! Food was ok. || Very nice beach with clean water and easy way to the Red Sea. Excelente atmosphere and good services. The chairs cost us small and you can stay all day. Very much recommend. || Very nice beach with nice restaurant, good prices. Nice to spend some time. Small reef 20m from shore. || Nice and clean beach. The entry, the bathroom and the shower is free. During the day was not so crowded, maybe because the water is still a bit cold. 😬😄 The beach is a bit rocky but there is a path to the water. || Dear Bence Thank you for your positive comment and rating  Hope to see you soon at the beach again  🌴🌴🌴 …

Very solid beach with beautiful coral reefs. Was super quiet when I went practically empty so was added bonus. Perfect for snorkelling and just general sunbathing. No water sports though. || The world northernmost coral reef, really! Right at your foot steps in eilat, Jordan has none. This beach has the advantage of not being overcrowded and all facilities are here, showers, toilets, bar, and a small nature reserve shop and rental services if you forgot your snorkeling equipment. Note, there are no lifeguard, only park rangers, but there is a space by the beach, in shallow water for poor swimmers Plant to bring some water shoes for the beach side. The reef is accessible via a long pier, and a large staircase leading easily to the water. Then it is the wonders of the red sea! || Although its one of the best places to see corals and fish in Eilat. The site could be a bit more developed. There are not many showers and only one dock to enter the water and relatively small place for swimming. With limited hours of operation and mediocre services this beautiful natural reserve should get an upgrade and the site could invest some of the entrance fee in improvments. || The reserve is well-maintained, clean, and organized, with food shops and equipment rental available. While the price is a bit high compared to free nearby spots, the underwater experience is spectacular- vibrant corals, colorful marine life, and plenty to see.  The area is very accessible, and safety is taken seriously with lifeguards on duty. Showers and restrooms are available and well-kept. Most seating areas are shaded with white canopies, which helps, though it can still get extremely hot in July and August.  Some downsides include ongoing renovations, which limit access to newer sections and make planning a snorkeling route a bit challenging. The designated swimming areas are small and enclosed, but beyond the bridge, there are vast open spaces where you can really explore and see a lot of beautiful marine life.  Overall, it’s more comfortable and enjoyable to snorkel in a well-supervised, maintained area than in unofficial sites, and the beautiful coral and abundant sea creatures make it well worth a visit.  * Pros: Clean and organized, lifeguards on duty, beautiful corals and marine life, showers and restrooms, accessible. * Cons: Entry fee is high compared to free alternatives, renovations limit some areas, enclosed swimming zones can feel small, it can get very hot in summer. || Snorkelling is ok. Nice fish and a bit of coral. If you've been in good reef places, you won't be impressed. But if in Eilat, it's worth a visit but a bit expensive for what it offers. || One of the good beaches in Eilat Clean,  had toilet,  shop,  walk route,  bridge directly to Red see with excitement view of corals, different fish types It's needed some payment,  check possible options before coming there It's better come with your own equipment Pay attention - NO SAFE GUARDS || Our preferred place in Eilat! Every time we are in Eilat we go to this place, the best still and ever.  Actually we were there every day, not a problem as we slept at the Yam Suf Hotel, only a 5 minute walk to there. 1. the beach is incredibly looked after 2. The Reserve guards are watching all the time for trespassers so very little chance something bad could happen to you while swimming 3. and of course the corals and the fish. Yes the coral are less beautiful than in the previous years, the mini tsunami a few years ago did damage the reef, but still they are interesting and the fish are till there and still super beautiful. Don't "FOMO" it, would you? || We had a lovely day out here. It was February, so out of season and not too busy. Lots of beautiful sea life up close in enormous tanks. Also, a very nice undersea viewing room and a sub trip if you want. Loads of facilities and other interesting things to see.....  Lovely and we'll worth a visit 😀 … || Amazing place! Make sure you take snorkels!  For 35 shekel, the place offers quite an experience! A long stretch of white sand, beautiful reefs to snorkel and pretty secure! || The most beautiful marine reserve in the world – colorful gardens beneath the sea The reefs of the Gulf of Eilat are the only coral reefs in our country, and among them a wonderful and colorful world of corals, fish and a huge variety of unique creatures can be seen. The Coral Beach Nature Reserve in Eilat allows visitors easy access to the reef, as well as essential beach services, including a shop, showers, toilets, sunshades, deck chairs and sun loungers

place_name: Eilat tech center hub האב אילת טק סנטר
reviews_content: THANK YOU Eilat Hub !! On my way to a (much needed) weekend trip, I looked for an office space I could use in the city of Eilat to get some work done. Following a friends recommendation, I checked out the Eilat Hub and was blown away. This business centre provides a free office space for people to get work done with an incredibly gracious staff, brilliant community and wonderful amenities. Huge thanks Gal, Ella & Shany ! || The best place for startups in Israel! Eilat Hub created a community of entrepreneurs in the most exciting city in Israel - Eilat and their vast network of partnerships, investors and other contacts worldwide is priceless for any entrepreneur that sets foot there. Highly recommended! || Best shared work space in Eilat, pleasant stuff and all the basic facilities you need to do your jobs done... || Great place great people - highly recommended for entrepreneurs in any stage that looking for succeed || This place offers Start-ups and innovators a platform to develop ideas, businesses etc. || Great atmosphere to work and connect to people. || Very good and comfortable place. || Thanks for leaving a review, the team of Eilat Hub is thrilled to hear that you had a great experience. || The best place in town for painting renovations and everything you need for your home..good prices, cheaper than other places in town..worth it

Overall the hotel provides great value per price. Basic room, with comfortable beds. The water pressure in the shower is good though the shower itself spread the water all around. The service was very good. The staff is kind and customer oriented. They gave us a welcome drink. The breakfast was quite good. Plenty of vegetables, cereals, coffee, eggs, different types of cheese, bread, juice, and more.  The breakfast area is big, noisy but bearable. || Evening arrival. Friendly and patient staff who communicated in writing as I’m deaf. Noticed that designed colorful which look interesting. Breakfast looked good. Great location near stores, fast food, and the bus station, and about a 15-minute walk to the mall and the beach. || Great value for money. Great experience especially from the staff. Lots of little things that made our stay very special - like playing a Disney movie at night for kids and parents in the garden... Giving out blankets and sweeeet tea!  A huge Mantaray hanging statue that "comes to life at night"  Like i said, attention to little things and an overall feeling of value for money!  Thank you You'll be seeing us again. || The rooms are clean and is a great location but I would suggest not use  room deodorizer with such strong scent or why use at all? Cleaning should be sufficient I wasn't able to sleep got dizzy/headache. If you are scent sensitive you will have an issue. But that would not be a problem for other people || This was a very nice place to spend time in Eilat. I shared a room with some guys I enjoyed meeting. One of them convinced me to try snorkeling, and I’m glad I did. The breakfasts were very good with a lot of variety. 10 minutes to the beach and 3 minutes to the central bus station. The staff was always helpful, especially Donna and Ohrtal. I would enjoy returning. || Excellent location, okay facilities, and an absolutely wonderful team. The staff were incredibly kind, attentive, and made us feel truly welcome. We had a great time- thank you! || Thank you so much for your kind words! We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed our location and felt welcome by our team. It was a pleasure hosting you, and we hope to see you again soon at Abraham Hostels Eilat! || Good price but they should update the pictures, guys at the reception were very nice, breakfast was cool, it’s close to the central bus station, walking/bus distance from the hotels area and the malls/beaches. Taxis should be cheap and you have massages places around, pharmacies(super pharm), and a really close by new mall (״שבעת הכוכבים״) and also the “Terminal Park” that is to be open real soon and looks amazing. || Just. Wow.  The price  value for money here is insane, ordered directly from their website, got help in no time.  The rooms  ARE super clean, VERY good looking and well designed, using the same vibe of the entire hotel. Lots of towels. Everywhere. Hot water?  110% of the time. Superb. Room cleaners? 24/7, all day long you will find 2-3 cleaners somewhere around the hallway.  The team AMAZING. Very professional, super friendly, young and motivated, very cool. At the reception you will always find a smiling face who would be very happy to help out with anything needed.  The food  Breakfast is way above expectation. Very clean, well seasoned, varieties of salads, cheese, bread, eggs in many forms and on and on. Very, very good.  The vibe  The overall vibe is really young and peaceful and colorful and very chill while maintain a very fun attitude, with snooker table, tennis table, a very nice pool, etc. Fir for kids, families, 24~ guys and up.  We had a karaoke night, a dancing party and happy hours.  Their bar contain many different drinks, food etc.  The location is amazing, in the center of everything.  I will be back!!! || We stayed almost a week, the room was very clean and room service tidied up every day. The atmosphere is lively and social, whilst also being immensely peaceful and calm for those wanting solitude and rest. In short it's a sanctuary you won't want to leave. The overall atmosphere of the hotel is calm and welcoming, ideal for both relaxation and recharging. I truly felt cared for as a guest, which made my stay memorable. reviews_content: To be honest, I didn't expect much of this place but what I got was way below the lowest of expectations. The location is OK but that's really the only marginally positive thing I can say about this hotel. First of all, when I booked the room I was offered an upgrade to a larger space and payed extra for it. When I got there, it turned out to be a 2 bedroom instead which I had absolutely no use for. Instead of owning up to their mistake or at least trying to remedy the situation, the receptionist said there's nothing they could do about it and that it's not their problem because they aren't the person who sold me this upgrade. The reception staff were mostly useless, dismissive and rude. Unable to address any issue or question without snarky remarks, basically telling us to leave them alone and deal with it ourselves. For example, on our first day we notified the receptionist that we are vegetarian (as per the hotel's own instruction and a common practice in most places) to which they literally responded with "I don't make the food. Go tell the kitchen staff and see if they can help you." During our stay, we got locked twice out of our room due to lock failure. Both times the receptionist let me go back and forth trying out the card multiple times before finally agreeing to send the security with the master key. The rooms themselves were simply sub-par. The sound isolation was very poor and I could hear all the street noise and every loud conversation going on at the hotel's entrance. This was by far the noisiest room I ever stayed at even compared to low budget hotels in much noisier surroundings. We had all meals included so we only ate at the hotel's dining hall. The food was nothing special, which would be fine except some of us ended the trip with food poisoning symptoms of varying degrees. One of us even developed high fever and spent the last days of our trip in bed. Maybe that was just really bad luck but I doubt we were the only ones. I personally will never come back to this hotel and cannot recommend it to anyone. || Thank you for taking the time to write your feedback Your comments will be forwarded to us We are glad you stayed with us Leonardo Privilege Hotel Eilat Team || TL;DR: this hotel is intended for young families who spends less time in the room, and loves action activities.  More details: The location is perfect, and within a walking distance of many attractions like the icemall, the beach, and good restaurants and bars. The service team is great, always smiling and helpful. The food is surprisingly good, they have large varieties and options to suit most people. However, this hotel is built in an open spaces, in a square shape. It means that you have to walk, and walk a lot. There are limited elevators as well, sometimes far from your room. The sound isolation in the room is very poor, due to the old non soundproof doors. The rooms are old fashioned, with poor equipment and low quality materials. Old wood, carpets, and basic equipment.  Overall, if you're not staying in the rooms much, like to walk a lot, and not looking for peace and quiet, this hotel is a good choice. || We are sorry that we were unable to meet your expectations. Kind Regards Avi Cohen Guest Relation Manager || Good for families with children. The food is very basic. The hotel was very crowded in weekend and waited 4 hours to get room. Rooms are basic .
