place_name: מלון לאונרדו רויאל ריזורט אילת - Leonardo Royal Resort
reviews_content: Was there for shabbat with my 2 kids, and was treated extraordinarily well. The staff was extremely accommodating for all shabbat needs, there were prayers on site. Overall my experience was great. Food was delicious, easily walkable to the beach and Ice Mall, and views from the poolside rooms were spectacular. There is also a great playroom for kids, and they had multiple programs for them. Highly recommend for going away with kids. || Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We’re truly happy to hear that you and your children had such a meaningful and enjoyable Shabbat with us.  It’s great to know our team was able to accommodate all your Shabbat needs and that the prayers, food, kids’ activities, and playroom all contributed to a positive family experience. We’re also glad you enjoyed the location, the poolside views, and the easy access to the beach and Ice Mall.  Thank you for your recommendation – we’d love to welcome you and your family back again soon! 🌊✨ || The hotel located in a very convenient area, not far from shopping malls and the beach.  Food was great! The hotel staff was amazing, everyone so nice! We had great time there 😁 || Thank you so much, Nataniel! 🌞 We’re thrilled to hear you enjoyed your stay, the food, and especially our amazing team – they truly do their best to make every guest feel at home. We hope to welcome you back soon for another wonderful holiday in Eilat!  Warm regards, Leonardo Royal Resort Eilat Team 📞 +972-8-636-6000 || High price for a poor experience. Air conditioning does not cool, constant disturbance, and rooms not worthy of the price or classification. Not worth choosing or repeating || Dear Bailsan, Thank you for sharing your feedback. We’re sorry to hear your stay didn’t meet expectations. Your comments about the room and air conditioning are being reviewed by our team to ensure improvement. We would appreciate the chance to speak with you directly and assist further. || Our experience at this hotel surpassed all expectations, leaving us with cherished memories. From the moment we arrived, we were impressed by the spaciousness of our room. It was thoughtfully designed, offering a generous amount of space for our family to spread out and relax. The beds were incredibly comfortable, ensuring a restful night's sleep for everyone.  One of the highlights of our stay was undoubtedly the breakfast. The extensive spread featured a wide variety of delectable dishes that catered to all tastes and dietary preferences. From freshly baked pastries to a colorful array of fruits, the options were abundant and of exceptional quality. The attentive staff ensured that the buffet was constantly replenished and maintained to a high standard.  What truly set this hotel apart for us was its exceptional family-friendly atmosphere. The amenities and activities provided for children were remarkable. Our kids were delighted with the dedicated play area, complete with toys, games, and even a mini-cinema. The hotel also organized fun-filled activities, such as face painting and treasure hunts, that kept our little ones entertained and engaged throughout our stay. We appreciated the thoughtful touches aimed at making families feel welcome and ensuring that both parents and children had a memorable experience.  The staff members at this hotel were a true delight. From the moment we checked in, we were greeted with warm smiles and genuine hospitality. The staff went above and beyond to make our stay pleasant and comfortable, accommodating our requests and offering helpful recommendations for nearby attractions and restaurants. Their attentiveness and dedication to providing excellent service left a lasting impression on us.  In addition to the outstanding service, the hotel's location was convenient, allowing easy access to local attractions and amenities. We found ourselves within close proximity to popular landmarks, shopping centers, and family-friendly attractions, making it an ideal base for exploring the area.  Overall, we wholeheartedly recommend this hotel to anyone seeking a truly wonderful experience. Whether you are a couple seeking a romantic getaway or a family looking for a memorable vacation, this hotel caters to all. The spacious rooms, delicious breakfast, exceptional amenities for children, and the warm and attentive staff make it a standout choice. Our time here was filled with joy and relaxation, and we left with nothing but fond memories. We cannot wait to return to this exceptional hotel and create more unforgettable moments with our loved ones. || Thank you very much for the opinion See you soon || My husband and I joined our daughter and her family at the Royal Gardens for 4 days.||At reception we were well looked after by Alex a lovely young man.  Friendly and helpful.  We were helped to our by Haim who pointed out the Cafe s and … || We arrived from far away, but when finally reached the hotel no parking was available. The parking is very small, hard to park and not sufficient. The room was with a balcony, but another balcony was right in front , so there was a person who was sitting just outside our room looking into it. We asked for another room, but we were told that other rooms were available. At 23 we went to bed, but discovered that the bed is full of sand...and not from us, probably the bedsheets were not changed from the previous guests. So the experience could be better, we would not stay in this hotel again. || Hello I'm sorry for the unpleasant experience I would love to host you with love again and correct the experience that was created Thank you very much, || The food is really good quality with a lot of options, you get two meals a day, in the morning dairy and in the evening meat. great rooms awesome smell, room service is good and quick. We had an awful with getting the room and we needed to make more than 5 trips to get the key to the room working correctly. || Dear Haim, First of all, we thank you for the compliments to the team. Secondly, I am sorry to hear about the keys not working, the issue is being addressed. We look forward to seeing you again on your next vacation. || the staff was very nice and friendly, the rooms were very clear and the smell is amazing. The breakfast and dinner have a good variety of food, the waiters are super nice and always willing to help. The lobby was decorated very nicely for the world cup! My family and I have a really great trip! :) || Hello, Thank you very much for your kind words to the hotel staff. We look forward to seeing you again on your next vacation. || We arrived on Thursday at 14.30 and received our room  immediately. The room was very clean and nice. Breakfast and dinner were good. Large verity and well made. Pool was clean and many options for sitting. The best thing about this place is the staff. Everyone was so nice and welcoming. Our little fridge didn't work, i called the reception and they had it replaced in no time. Amazing service throughout the vacation from Everyone. We'll be back for sure. || Lovely Dana, thank you! we can't wait to see you again. || Rooms are quite small. We had two 28 inch luggage. One on the sofa and one on the floor and there's barely space to walk. There isn't a view from our balcony as it faces the swimming pool of the resort.  We had welcome drinks with fruits and cookies.The buffet dinner and breakfast were great. I have to say that the food here is one of the best I had in Israel. Definitely will come back just for the food:)  There are many shops around the hotel and ICE MALL is an 8 minutes walk from the hotel.

piano teacher Ms.Olga Didenko is one of the best scholars I have ever had. || Good acoustics, Juanita Smith Cohen concert || Everything is broken in the old building! Very high level || My daughter is studying violin here with an excellent teacher. || Professional private music lessons, a variety of musical instruments, voice development, good choir || Eilat Music Center,,,Conustrium,,, One of the most beautiful and best places I've seen. And professional teachers. || I accompanied my grandson to a piano lesson. It was exciting 😘 😊 … || The Eilat Conservatory is the place to study music in Eilat.

Busy popular place.  Manager very gracious and quick to find us a comfortable spot.  Great music playing and open space to see the water view no matter where  you’re seated.  Our server could have been a bit more attentive but he looked quite young and I will just assume it’s a lack of experience.  But he was always kind and polite and ready to help when we got his attention.  Highly recommend this place. Fun, great food, even kid friendly || If anyone tells you that there are no good places to eat out in Israel, just come to the Ninth Beach in Eilat. They have a vegan menu, which is impressive in Eilat (unfortunately). The view and the shade are wonderful to sit with friends and family. The alcohol is pretty expensive, but it makes sense to the position of the restaurant. || Evening review: nice atmosphere. Calm and relaxing music. Menu is good (simple food but sometimes it's exactly what you need). What we didn't like: waiter (name starts with D) had 2 mistakes in bill (total mistake value of about 25 USD). We told him and he canceled just one of them. Refused the other was a mistake. Shame because otherwise nice place. Prices are decent though. || Summery: good place for a group who want different kinds of dishes. Food is good, prices are reasonable.  There is only one way to describe the food- OK. Its not bad in any way, tasty to eat even, but not exceptional in any way. I can say this after tasting everyone's dishes, and after asking them. This place is really a jack of all trades but master of none, which is great if you have a big family that wants different things (like us).  Service is great: fast, professional, kind. Cant ask for more.  Atmosphere is great, lighting, music, the option to sit by the sea (we didn't) is all very attractive || Honestly we didn’t expect much and were looking for a spot by the water. But the food is just great!! Really amazing experience, was really full when we arrived but fortunately we got a table. Prices are average for Eilat. || Nice place for breakfast and dinner! Restaurant and seats just few feets from the sea. Prices are good. Breakfast for one was very good and cost about 15€. Burger was ok, price about 16€. Breakfast for two adults and a three year old child cost us 150 NIS. That was about 35€. Well recommended! || The food and service were perfect, I would reccomend coming at a decent hour (19:00-21:00) before rush hour to actually test the waters, Our waitress (Ziv) was spectacular, she was super welcoming and fast with eyecontact service, she came with all of our food at once. Very calming music, super cute I would recommend this place for a date, dinner with friends, familly outing and even meetings. || Recommended! When you are on the beach, go and have some drink! We picked mango cosmopolitan - good one, and Nine beach speciality, i dont really remember the name of the drink, but it was mojito with watermelon and kiwi twist - best one! It really tastes great 😍 and the cakes, oh, no words needed. Staff was nice, attentive, also when i asked if they have gluten free cakes, the waiter recommended me some, and went to double check with the chef, without my request - which I found really nice! In Israel is food more expensive, so don't be surprised if your bill is higher lol. || So the location and overall vibe are simply stellar! Music is good and a normal volume (which is rare for these kinda beach bars). But the service is simply horrible! I took a seat and they were quick to give me a menu and a drink but they never returned after that. I even asked them to take my order and the waitress said; "one minute" and never returned. Really nice after a rich dinner at your Hotel. Relax and enjoy. || Very beautiful, good restaurants, yachts for walks. || Lovely. Especially the promenade where you are right on the sea. The greed of the establishment led to the loss of a regular customer || Sorry Oleg, it’s not greedy to try and maximize the space you have. It is normal practice in any professional restaurant.

Fun mall- especially for kids: much to do. Whole thing center around an ice skating rink. We weren’t with kids but so many that seemed to be having a great time with all the activities that were available there a lot of nice shops too although the other large mall in Eilat may be better for shopping.  This is our first visit in six years and most notable was the increase in kosher restaurants and food stands available. great variety. || Thank you very much for your support!  We would love to see you again among our guests in the future. || Stunning unique mall with special features such as huge ice skating rink in middle of mall and special ride going around the ceiling of the mall!! Really enjoyed all the shops and restaurants. Not so large so good for evening chill. || Ice Mall in Eilat is a modern shopping center with a large variety of stores, including several luxury brands. We visited on Black Friday and found excellent deals throughout the mall. It was very crowded, which made it a bit hard to move around, but overall it’s an impressive mall and definitely worth a visit. || Thank you very much for your support!  We would love to see you again among our guests in the future. || They need to renevate, fix the layout so you can walk around sit at a cafe and actually enjoy the ice rink in the middle || Overall we had a great time at the Ice Mall, but it's a bit tough to get through when crowded. Seems like they've got too many kiosks and other shops blocking the walkways. Best to visit outside of peak times. || Thank you very much for your support!  We would love to see you again among our guests in the future. || Very beautiful shopping center downtown Eilat. It's medium size, includes some clothing stores, fashion accessories, places to eat, places to seat, souvenirs shops, playground for kids and ice skating attraction. One of a kind. || Awesome mall in downtown Eilat for kids and the whole family. Includes a ice skating rink, kids roller coaster as well as a hanging ride overhead tracks. Lots of shopping and some restaurants. Has arcade inside, and a small lego store. Prices are somewhat high. || Ice Mall is a large shopping and entertainment center, conveniently located within walking distance of most central hotels in Eilat, with parking nearby. Inside you’ll find a huge variety of shops – fashion, perfumes, electronics – along with plenty of food options and activities.  It can get very crowded, which sometimes makes the atmosphere feel overwhelming, especially for parents who worry about keeping an eye on their kids.  On the fun side, there are lots of games and activities for children (most for an extra fee). The ice-skating rink is the highlight – very enjoyable for kids and adults alike. Even toddlers can join with special seats designed for them, which makes the experience inclusive and fun for the whole family.  * Pros: Central location, wide variety of shops, many kids’ activities, fun ice-skating rink. * Cons: Very crowded at times, extra costs for most activities, can feel overwhelming.  Overall: If you enjoy shopping, family activities, and don’t mind the crowds, Ice Mall is definitely worth a visit. || Ice skating is definitely the highlight of the mall and is very recommended. Good food in the restaurants, and many good brands of clothes and more. Very little if any shaded parking, and summer in Eilat is very hot. || This is a big shopping mall in Eilat with Olympic size ice skating rink. There are lots of stores for varieties ranging from clothing to other things. Various restaurants are also available. We visited on a Saturday, Only McDonald and Arik were open. I guess you should visit between Sunday to Friday to have options to choose from the eateries. There is a lot of games leisure activities for both adult and kids as well. It is perfect for both family and single outing

A real fun place for kids, but also for the sea animal lovers. We had a guided tour and it was perfect and well explained. I enjoyed every bit of it. I would have enjoyed more if the glasses were a bit cleaner. Nevertheless, it was fun. PS: The 3D movie was cherry on the top || Would spend there all day. An established place, but it keeps renovating all the time. The shark aquarium is so relaxing and exiting at the same time! The underwater observatory facility is a must. Note- a single ticket is good for a couple of days, so if you want to visit more than once (and you should) plan accordingly. || It is very expensive. The tanks are too small for the large number of fish and turtles. In addition, the glass on the tanks is dirty everywhere, making it difficult to see properly. This needs to be cleaned urgently. The grounds are small overall and half of the attractions consist of films. It is not a must-see. || Good for little kids, probably less for older ones.  The place is trying hard to remain relevant. The underwater observetory is a little old and not really that impressive anymore. However you also get an impressive shark pool and some stingray and sea turtles exhibits. The 3d movie was impressive (but short. 18 min total).  I've certainly been to better aquariums, but this is decent and good for kids. || Wonderful. From walking through the lively coral reef to the 3D cinema which is unlike any other I have witnessed. The screen goes above the head so that it can be protected from any point in the room and looks like the whole is above you. This place is a must see for young and old. It is a beautifully maintained park, with a big variety of coral. The underwater observatory is absolutely amazing. The water of the red see is also accommodating the coral beautifully. The aqua dome is also an experience like none other. The whole is turned into a 3D video and it literally feels like you are under the ocean and touching the sea life yourself. Great place to visit, both educational and fun. its really impressive to see all the unique creatures that live in the ocean. dedicate at least several hours to the visit. || This place gets it!  It's all about the service and people.  Incredibly helpful and friendly staff.  Very clean place.  Food was good and fair priced.  The exhibits were all well maintained.  Especially with children, this is a very nice all day activity. || We’ve been to aquariums all over the world and this isn’t the glossiest or the most high tech. But my kids love it and beg to come back every time we are in Eilat. There’s lots of different things to do that keep everyone entertained and you cannot beat seeing fish in their actual habitat. We love this charming little place. The 3-D movie was a huge hit! || What a great chance to sit and watch fish for hours! Between the underwater observatory and the aquarium we were really pleased with the experience.  Go early for quieter viewing without crowds. There was plenty of parking when they first opened. || We spent the whole day, ~7 hours, so there's lots to do there. I won't give it a 5 star since some things definitely need more love. We saw all the exhibits, there's really a good wide variety and selection of sea creatures, most endemic to Eilat. The highlight must be the shark tank, it has multiple viewing windows, plenty of room, probably the nicest tank I've seen. They feed them twice daily - go to the second feeding! (3pm) it far less crowded. There's a tube to walk under the fish and rays, beautiful. There are also turtles and "rare creatures" (which we didn't find very "rare"). The "deep sea creatures" exhibit is only videos. The lowest point must be the "IMAX", the movie is short, although the 3D effect is cool (kids loved it), but the narration (Heb only) is unintelligible, the content is boring, and they play a "generic" 3D flick. The underwater structure is very nice, but many windows are way too high for a 3-4 y/o to see anything without carrying them 💪, still it's very worth the while (climb up to see the overlook). It's a good place to spend a few hours, it doesn't break the bank, and kids will like it. || Great place to visit. Easy to get to by bus from Eilat. You can buy tickets online or at the gate. The exhibits are lovely.. sharks, stingrays, corals, turtles, octopi, fish. Climb the observatory to the top to see great views of the Red Sea.. then go below sea level to view coral and fish. Try and avoid Jewish / school holidays is it gets very busy. The 3D movie was an extra .. it was not so good.

A trail tour appropriate for all ages. Very calm yet fun for kids. The vehicles are in good shape and speed limited (maybe too much), the stuff is kind and professional. || Fun desert trek. The service is great and the planned coffee break turned in to a well received popsicle break. Yum. Be forewarned, you will get dusty. A convenient washing station awaits you when you return. || Great customer service and kind manager. Tour guide was cautious and fun he educated us during the tour also! || English after Hebrew. אל תעיזו ללכת למקום הזה! מבטיחים הבטחות ולא מקיימים. לא אקסטרים בכלל, נוסעים בעיקר בכביש סלול במהירות שמגיע במקרה הטוב ל50 קמ"ש. שלא נדבר שהבטיחו שעה של טיול והדלק שהטרקטורון נגמר. אחרי זה עצר ל 15. המדריך הבטיח להשלים ולא עשה את זה, בסופו של דבר בקושי נסענו 30 דקות. הבטיחו לנו תמונות, אני מחכה כבר 3 ימים והם פשוט מסננים אותך! בקיצור, מקום יקר, מקום של שקרנים. Don't even think togo to this place! They make promises and do not keep. It's not extreme at all, we drive mainly on a paved road at a speed that reaches at best 50 kilometers per hour, not to mention that they promised one hour of fun and the buggy fuel was empty, then we had stopped for 15 minutes waiting for them to bring more gas. The instructor promised to return this time but he did not did it. They take pictures and said to ask them by WhatsApp, I've been waiting for 3 days and they just ignore my messagea! In short, an expensive place and a place of liars. || It was great! The vehicles were fun to drive, and the course was really nice, going through palm tree fields, by the border crossing and into the desert. The guide was really nice and even gave us ice pops! They give you goggles (the green ones even fit over eyeglasses) and masks to protect from all the dust. || One of our best experiences in Eilat, The guys are very nice, we had a guide name Igor that really took care of us. He replaced the razer we received to a new one. He checked all the liquids and made sure that it is safe. We received cold water bottles and we were ready to go. We booked the 2 hours tour, started with a nice ride to the mountains area, visited few places we didn't know about, we saw some deers and the view was great. Igor made us some good Arabesque coffee and explained about the area, Igor kept a distance infront of us and yet always looked back to see that we are ok. Definitely worth it. || Went with my husband and 3 kids (13, 9, 4). Had a blast! The staff was super friendly and engaging with the kids. Helped make a fun experience even better! || it was a bad experience. I dont recomend it, the owner is an irresponsible person. The buggies and quads dont receive any maintenance. The tour is very slow. You cannot do anything, you cannot touch anything. You will receive a call from the owner in the middle of the tour to go slower. (buggies max speed 30 kmh... slower??) Duration of the tour: theory= 1h, practice = 40 mins. They are more options to do this kind of tours, with better buggies and cheaper and the most important thing: friendlier and with a little bit of respect to clients.  Another option is to do the same tour with your own car, more fun and safer. || The manager is a little bit stupid, but that isn't the most important thing: The buggies are in very bad conditions, please review the brake and direction system, for the security of users. I dont recomend it. || Well organised, friendly and helpful staff and great for all ages (the little ones especially enjoyed being driven on the Tracteron with our guide)!

place_name: טיולי ג׳יפים באילת - אילת דזרט טורס Eilat Desert Tours
reviews_content: I'm very happy to have found this tour. A comfortable ride through the desert, and a quick hike through the beautiful Red Canyon. Shlomi was very professional and knowledgeable, and even offered to take some photos in scenic spots. I only wish I'd have booked a longer hike, but this way I got to see lots of different views. Would definitely recommend this tour! || Amazing desert experience! The trip with Eilat desert tour introduced me to the most stunning sights of Eilat mountains. The mountains are awesome and the formations created by forces of nature left me at awe. Highly recommended || The Flamingo Ponds was a good desert tour, taking place at the time we requested. Because it was a cold day, the jeep that picked us up was an enclosed one. We got commentary on the bird pools, the history & cultures of the area and the ecosystems. We travelled along the border with Jordan, passing some of the young flamingoes in the salt pools, the border crossing, date palm orchards, the Bird Sanctuary and farmland on our way to the desert area, where we managed to see a couple of deer in the distance. A bonus was the return of a phone later in the day that one of us left in the jeep even after we had been reminded to check that we hadn't left anything! || Shlomi was very pleasant and knowledgeable, professional, and entertaining. We were picked up right at the airbnb we're staying at and we spent an enjoyable 2 hours in the mountains of Eilat.  We highly recommend Eilat Desert Tours and hope to have a chance to work with them again in the future. || The southernmost house in the country... I will never forget.... Thank you || We had an amazing time. My two kids 9,12 were fascinated by all the desert stories. Shlomi is very knowledgeable. Wonderful experience  Thank you 🙏🏻 || Thank you very much, dear Gil, we appreciate the response. || It was an amazing experience! We started the trip at 4:30 PM, a vehicle of 2 adults and 3 children. The pick-up was done from the hotel ahead of time, the route was very friendly to the traveler. And the air conditioner worked properly. There was an excellent combination of stories about what we see in front of spectacular desert landscapes. It is unbelievable that after many years of coming to Eilat we are discovering new places, and we also got to see some desert animals. Highly recommended, the children are delighted and the adults had an experience. || We went on a family trip with Shlomi in the Eilat mountains and had a great time. Shlomi is a great guide, with extensive and comprehensive knowledge. He accompanies the trip with guidance and stories adapted to every age, pleasantly and in the right dosage. Highly recommended, Michal || The tour of Nahal Rodad in Eilat was amazing! An experiential jeep tour with spectacular views and a great atmosphere. Shlomi, the guide, was professional and told interesting stories that added a lot to the trip. Highly recommended to anyone looking for a fun and energetic experience in Eilat! 🚙🌵☀️ || We went on a jeep tour in the Eilat area with Shlomi and the experience was simply excellent. Shlomi demonstrated extensive and in-depth knowledge of the area and explained it in a clear and interesting way. He was kind, patient and made sure that we all felt comfortable throughout the journey. The amazing views combined with the professional guidance and the pleasant atmosphere made the trip an excellent experience. Highly recommend || Michal and I enjoyed a really enjoyable trip, a huge stream route and more. To be sucked deep into the desert, to the lovely corners that only an experienced guide can reveal to us. Shlomi David's special personality and his knowledge of the desert's customs contributed a lot. Really recommended.

Has 3 small pool tables, 1 larger one that  doubles for small snooker and 1 proper snooker table || Thanks for the review || This place is the only place I found in the vicinity of my hotel that was dedicated to billiards. While the drinks and service was okay, the cues and table were comically horrific. The cues were bent, the tables had so many bumps that it felt more like playing Golf than Pool.  Pros: * Pretty accessable * Prices were fair * Service was okay * Has parking nearby  Cons: * Tables have bumps * Cues are bent * It felt stuffy inside.  Notes: * Smoking is allowed || Thanks for the review || Great billiard, dancy atmosphere, and such a lovely owner! Being the only publicly available billiard club in Eilat, we were a bit sceptical at first, but it certainly justified itself! Again, cannot express in words how much the owner of this place affects the experience positively - Truly recommended! Also, the prices are really fair 🙂 || Timor, thank you for the review and response. I was happy to host you and see that you really enjoyed the game and the atmosphere at my place, and most importantly, that you enjoyed each other. I would be happy to host you in the future. Guy Shishu || The place located in  a  basement. the equipment is old. and the service is fine.. However i Think the price is pretty expensive 55 nis / for hour or less Small Beer bottle / 27 nis || Good music good pools, with the best vibe in eilat. Thank you gay for hosting us || Thank you very much for the rating I was happy to host you and would like to host in the future || Best place in Eilat for chill out || Amit, thank you for the response and review. I was happy to host you and I would be happy to host you in the future. || Great music, new tables. || It was a pleasure to host and thank you for the rating. || Thanks for the review || We arrived as a group from Jerusalem for the second year. A pleasant, inviting and luxurious place Awesome karaoke rooms, snooker tables And a fun atmosphere || Meital, thank you for the review. It was a pleasure to host you and I will be happy to host you in the future. || Place on the face, garbage service, crooked tables, really didn't enjoy it

We visited the Three Monkeys Bar in Eilat as a group of eight on a weekday. There weren’t many free seats, but we did manage to get a table. There was a nice live performance, and people were dancing on the floor, creating a fun and lively atmosphere. The place is very loud, so it’s less suitable if you’re just looking to have a conversation. Overall, a good experience — we’ll definitely come back. || We were the first customers to arrive at 8 pm, so the place was empty, but it already had a nice atmosphere. We were told that there would be a live music band on at 10 p.m., and the show started right on time. The band was great, and many people started dancing on the dance floor next to the stage. The audio was not well balanced, so the drums were masking the singing, which was very good. There was a nice selection of beers, but only one option for wine, which was a little disappointing. || A very friendly and professional service.  The barman was very good at preparing the cocktails. The music is nice and the atmosphere is very friendly. They have live music at 10pm each night and it's certainly a great choice for having a cocktail or a beer. || The food and service, by the way, are not amazing. But if you like the 80s, it's worth a visit. There's a band that plays music that makes you happy. Better to come on Friday. || Cool live music but not so amazing Coketails. Prices are at the higher end and yet this is still a landmark in Eilat and always welcomes people to have a good time, party and dance every night. || A really cool pub/dance bar, with live music and nice vibe. It's a good place to have drinks with cool music. Enjoy :) || I love this bar so much! Whenever I'm in Eilat I always try to make it here. There is live music and great drinks. Cheers! || Very nice pub with a good vibes, live music🎸 and songs🕺, fine 🍺 and tasty cocktails🍹. No parking 🤷🏻‍♂️ || One of the famous places of Eilat. Great location. offer a good selection of beers. The main attribute is live music, played mainly by British musicians. You can choose place rather inside or outside, wherever you like. || Sat and ordered 4 beers. After 25 minutes 2 managers came to say it will take a few more minutes.  Left after 35 minutes without getting anything to drink, They totally ruined our night out. Will never go back there and nither should you.
I'm all for this place! There's an opportunity to dance, lots of space. Lots of drinks, competitions. One of the big pluses is that Guf performed there, you know) || Russian Club of Eilat

We where greeted with the words: "I'm Sory but you came in the worst night ever. Our taps don't work, the band canceld on the last mint".we decided to stay. It was a great gin and tonic. Nice atmosphere with good music that allowed us to hear each other. As tour guides the bartender answered our questions about life in Eilat. I will definitely come back next time. || customer service was okay, but there were no menus, music was way too loud, the lighting was terrible (way too dark) and drinks were very overpriced || Sorry for you and this experience. Yes there’s no menus Only special ones for wine bottles etc.. Regular orders as water beer and cocktails are known prices so for Israel Eilat were cheap. our bartenders and waitres are well known with all prices, shame you didn’t ask the price before ordering. And we’re not a club, we’re a bar a real local bar that weekends are crazy mad and middle of the week it’s dark with a band or stage lights sorry that you couldn’t see clear at the dark. || No COVID-19 certificate (green pass) checks, at least for none of my friends and I. || Just wow!! The best pub in eilat! Thanks for a crazy night! || Normal pub Nice vibe A bit over crowded || Good service and nice place to have a beer at night in Eilat || This place has awful treatment. The staff isn't very nice. Not recommended! || Shame for one friend that mixed your shot and she drank yours and you drank hers, your turning our place to a bad one. P.s tell thanks to all of your friends for understanding the situation. ❤️ Hope to see you guys again. :) || A bit expensive but lovely atmosphere || Nice place! Very cool vibes || Exellent homecafe with nightstyle 😉 …

Good atmosphere, beer for 31ils, hookah for 60ils. Free entry. No Wi-Fi, so you couldn’t even scan the qr code on the tables for the menu. There were only local people in our time. Everyone was leaving after 12:00pm 😂. … || I'm liking Israel way better now || It's the first time being in a pub, and while overall it's been nice, there are a few nitpicks I would like to share. The service is slow, we had to call the servers ourselves, while they were not exactly the busiest. The atmosphere was exciting, though the music was slightly too loud for my taste, it was alright being there. There is no food service there, only a service for ordering food from the restaurant nearby, right to the table... If it's open... If I had the option, I would have given a 3.6, it's nice there, it has the atmosphere, it's just the details that turned the experience from a great one to an "alright" one. || The atmosphere is great, good music, especially good for people who like to dance. The stuff is nice, we sat on the bar and they promised us to move us near the dance floor, we asked them several times but they ignored us, at the end we moved alone and left our table and drinks. Prices of the drinks are acceptable, 30 nis for 0.5 draft beer but the shisha is expensive (60 nis) and they don’t change the coals. || Not the greatest bar of all time but most probably the best bar in Eilat Slow service, but good vibes and fair prices (except for the hard liquor bottles of course). Lacking a bit in the variety of draft beers and cocktails. || Thank you very much for the review, we would love to have you again, Have a home chaser on us at your next meeting with us || Nice place to spend one night in Eilat, the beer is not very expensive and the atmosphere is nice. They placed a big speaker right in front of me and refused to move it a bit, so the second half the night was annoying and I had to sit somewhere else... || Crazy place with people dancing on tables etc. But a lot lot of fun! Absolutely great atmosphere - even for foreigners (yes it took some while before you'll find anyone eager to talk to you in EN but be persistent like always) || Probably the best bar in the city for people in their 20's. The dj's are amazing, the service is fast and very good. Its also located in amazing spot incase you want to go grab a bite and come back. Im there every night im spending in Eilat || Good Pub + shisha bar, easy to get in touch with locals. Drinks are a little expensive and no english menue available, but the staffing is good in speaking english. Good Location for drinking and getting ready to Party. Music is good, but a little too loud If you want to have a conversation with a larger group (4+). Would go there again. || Very loud music!!! Can't hear anything, let alone get on to somthing with the ladie's...(quite hard to start a conversation when your head is explouding) Beers are o.k, nothing too special. Was much better a few years ago, so don't quite know what happend there, but ouvieslly somthing wrong went on... the atmosphire has changed dramatically and not for the good, drank one beer and went away quickly

If you are into relatively small,  neighborhood atmosphere,  good music and wide range of drinks,  you would enjoy this one.  I did. Warm welcoming service.  Basic pub food like pizzas and Edamame. No menus I was told,  the waitress is the menu.  She was lovely and took care of us like we were old friends. Many local friends comes here.  Sound is very good, strong but not heartening your ears.  If you are sensitive to smoke it could be challenging but we set in area not so much affected. Decoration gives you the right place atmosphere. I really liked the place. || this is the coolest bar in eilat. and I checked many || Best bar in Eilat to chill!!! Great atmosphere with old school music. Fare prices and great food! You should order the pizza you will not be disappointed! A nice touch is when you order a drink you get unlimited supply of olives and some pretzels! You definitely should try out this bar!!! || I love this bar! It's one of the coolest and we'll hid bars in the city. It's considered a local watering hole for all ages to enjoy. I recommend the pizza if you have the munchies, it's thin crust and absolutely delicious! || The best bar in Eilat! Cool atmosphere, friendly bartenders, great music and drinks...and the pizza is one of the best I have ever had! || You would not find a better place in this side of the galaxy. Great live music (rock !!!) as well as great drinks and people || One of the beast local Bar in Eilat , Mainly local people. Good music , cool atmosphere || great music, nice staff, awesome beer and nothing else needed ;) || Nice place, not too loud. Great music || Awesome place! Probably the best pub in eilat!

The restaurant was empty, except for another couple. They waited on us for 29 minutes. After half an hour we asked to understand what was going on and when we would receive our order and they continued to lie to us that it would be another minute and another minute, they argued with us that only 25 minutes had passed and that was reasonable for them. Simply a significant deterioration in the attitude and conduct that had not been there before. || Hi, We checked the timestamps: you arrived at 13:15 and left at 13:44. This total time includes ordering, waiting, receiving the dishes, eating, and paying so it’s not possible that you waited 30 minutes for your dish. The actual timeline simply does not match what was described. || Super friendly and helpful staff. Welcomed us immediately. They were setting up projectors for Haifa vs Tel Aviv football match for the evening and we could see the crowds of locals, young and older, coming just as we were leaving. || Food was good, arrived fast. Atmosphere was great and there was great early 2000 music. Sadly the waiter was terrible, at the end also demanded a higher tip, complained, and vocally tried to force us to tip him (Extremely aggro). || A nice bar for local people to feel aboard. As a tourist I'll suggest you to go and enjoy the actual local restaurants. American /British menu with good dishes. The stuff are friendly but the service is a bit slow and clueless. The place is open almost 24/7 so a good fit for a night snack. Enjoy :) || Place near the mall. Great choice of draft beers . The bartender knows his stuff , if you ask from something not in the menu and he knows it? He will make it and it will be great. The prices are reasonable and the service is quick || Paddy's is the local Irish pub in Eilat ( Yes, Apparently every city has an Irish Pub 🤣). It's a great place to come have a beer or a late lunch close to the beach. The pub is located in the tourist district of Eilat. It's a walk away from the beach, the shopping mall and most of the board walk hotels. I highly recommend the steak!!! The fish and chips is good too but the streak is simply a winner. They also have a large selection of beers to choose from, along with a full bar and surprisingly decadent desserts 🎂. Great for families or just hanging out with friends to watch a came. || For a pub, this place serves very decent food from a wide menu. Even the pub favorites (burgers, fish&chips, etc.) are surprisingly good. Many kinds of beers available. Good place to have a dinner with kids. Why 4 points then? The one beer I was interested in was not available, and the waitress was very confused, both with prices and the orders. This may happen, though. || Very positive experience. The waiter was patient and explained to us the different food options. We ordered one of the menus that included a drink and a 50% discount on desserts.  The fish and chips dish  was delicious and tasty. The lemonade had too much sugar for my taste but could mix it with water.  We shared one of their desserts (the apple pie) which was served with a vanilla ice cream and whipped cream. Simply delicious.  You are served some peanuts and vegetables to eat while you wait for your dish/drink. || Good place to visit. Always tasty food and a lot of fresh beers. Not cheap but worth it. || The combination of rich bar and restaurant. Bar is rich from beers to cocktails and heavy drinks. The food is very good, I ordered the steak and it was soft and well served. The music was awesome and not too loud or low. The sitting area outside is pretty and has really nice breeze during evening. The service was great and welcoming. Definitely going to return for a second.

Love this place!! Food is delicious and the portions are great. The staff is awesome and very friendly,  especially Mike. Atmosphere and vibes are so chill and welcoming to everyone,  even great for a family night out. Music always on point and the drinks are mixed well. Definitely worth a visit! You wont be disappointed!!! || Thanks Denise, hope to see you again soon || The food is pretty bad. The wings are prepared in advance and have strong chicken after taste. The burger is dry.  I guess if you there for a drink and a show it can be nice. But avoid it as a dinner. || Awesome food, awesome location with great waterfront views, great sports bar! Prices were reasonable during tourist season in Eilat. Highly recommend the double Mike's Burger if you are hungry (see pictures), guarantee you will not be hungry after eating it! Comes with fries or salad. One of the best burgers i have eaten! || Thanks David for the awesome review || It all depends when you come ... I've been trying to escape the heat... So as soon as that opend I sat down .. I haven't been in a bar for ages.. But some how it all feels like home .. The smells the sits etc... So I've had a few drinks ...a conversation with the dude beside me...ate a meat lovers pizza...and left. ... I've been a long mikes place goers in Tel Aviv ..wenn I was young ...so it all looks the same .. There are also  live performances (a bit to loud for my age ) ... Enjoy 🤠 || Thanks, hope to see you soon || the place was absolutely amazing. the interior, service, music, and food and drinks were top notch. Definitely recommend 👌 || Thanks for the awesome review Rona || We were there every evening from 23.09 to 26.09. And every time great food, different dishes, always free space for sitting under air condition. Children were happy too. Beer is great. || Thanks so much for the great review!! We appreciate you!! reviews_content: Nice place they offer various water attractions. We did parasailing. The place is quite expensive, but the instructors were really nice and professional. I noticed that in other places the parachute fell into the water several times, but here they managed to keep it dry and handled everything very professionally. Highly recommended! || A very beautiful and cozy small beach surrounded by palm trees and restaurants near the hotels on the one side, and a lagoon with beautiful yachts and tourist shopping area with numerous outlets - on the other. The water is good, clean and pleasant, but there can be stones near the shore. The best option that I can advise everyone is to buy rubber shoes in a store near the beach specially for beaches. Pleasure and comfort for the feet are guarantee. || I had an amazing time at this beach. The views are incredible, the local offerings are more than sufficient, and it is overall incredibly enjoyable. I recommend (if in a large group) hiring a boat to go out further into the red sea, it's an amazing experience and the views are once in a lifetime. Best suited for snorkeling. Picnic tables, shade and food. || Heaven for snorkelling, especially for nervous snorkellers: they have designed a snorkelling 'route' around the reef with a rope you can use for guidance and feeling a bit more secure. The marine life is amazing with huge colourful fish. They rope of the main reef to protect it from damage from selfish tourists, but you can still see it from the edge. Beach has plenty of shade and chairs. All equipment and lockers available. Take your own food  as all you can get here are french fries or frozen pizza they heat up. You can get here by a 5 minute bus from the main area of Eilat. || Very well organized for snorkeling but maybe too much... in the water you can’t really get close to the corals and there are many people at the same place so not so wild as you could expect. || Great experience. Lots of space to sit. The snorkelling was great fun and there were lots and lots of fish. || Good facilities with snorkel hire, locker hire, shower, toilets etc. However, you have to view the coral in a guided lane, which is very restrictive. The coral is better in other places along the coast, but there was a decent variety of fish to see. || It's a place with shower, toilets, diving equipment to rent, shops and more. There public bus lines getting you from any point of Eilat to this Nature Reserve Beach. In Hebrew: חוף האלמוג Hof Halmog. The beach is huge and very clean. Wonderful for sea nature lovers because there you can see all the sea life just getting in the sea. The Red Sea waters are an spectacle for the clear swimming, good temperature and the lack of waves that allow you to see all the amazing under water life. The entrance is not free. You may need to call to know opening hours and entry ticket prices.

Free, yes but not at the same level than the close Nature Reserve. If you like snorkeling and you prefer to save the 10 bucks of the entrance fee at the Coral Beach Nature reserve, so this is the place to be. There are showers, toilets, but not that many parking spaces. Still the landscape is incredible, especially at sunset. And swimming in the red sea is simply the thing. || One of the best beaches to scuba dive in Eilat, we are coming here every year in the last week of August. Sitting on the beach, relaxing with a cold beer during sunset is amazing !!! || There were closed toilets, no showers. Beach was little. The piers were closed. We didn’t swim there, so i cant’t rate the undersea life. I do not recommend for tourists. Go to another beach. || Princess Beach is an unofficial beach, which means no lifeguards, no supervision, and very limited facilities. The place isn’t well maintained – there’s a lot of rust, the pier is closed to entry, and there are no proper showers or restrooms. Shade is provided only by simple white fabric covers. Parking can also be difficult, especially on hot days, and there’s just one small kiosk that accepts cash only (no apps or credit cards).  On the positive side, the underwater world is stunning. The beach offers free access to some of the most beautiful corals and a wide variety of marine life in Eilat – truly a snorkeler’s dream.  * Pros: Free, amazing marine life and corals, great snorkeling. * Cons: No lifeguards, poor maintenance, cash-only kiosk, hard parking, no showers/restrooms.  In short: if you’re looking for comfort and services, this isn’t the place. I highly recommend all the shows!!!!! || A stunning experience and highly recommended! Thank you ♥️ || Great theater! I highly recommend anyone coming to Eilat to check if there is a show of theirs and buy a ticket. Each show is an event in itself and an unforgettable experience.  Special shows that use sound, image, lighting and space like you have never experienced in your life.  I have no words to describe how special and different the experience there is from any other show I have been to. || An extraordinary cultural experience, theater on a different level than anything you've ever known. Genius and creativity. Highly recommended. || Excellent theater! Every show is different from anything I've seen before. And the children's shows are amazing for adults too, which is nice. It's worth checking the show schedule the next time you're visiting Eilat 😉 … || Original, lively, intriguing and surprising theater in Eilat. We saw the show in Room 201. Amazing organization, the special location is wonderful, the acting is excellent. Simply a pleasure of an evening!! Really exciting to see such a creative and invested venture in Eilat. We have reserved and want to see! || The theater is active in various channels, but I have seen several plays and there is a real search there, especially when it comes to the language of the theater itself. And a real search is rare, blessed and inspiring. May you be blessed and successful. || Intimate and stunning atmosphere The show All the Good Things with Dvir Bandek. Wow! I enjoyed every second! || Excellent actors. The show, An Evening of Love and Wine, had a very nice atmosphere and was interactive. || Thank you Ayelet, we're glad you enjoyed it ❤️

A genuine look back in time. At first it looks like a dodgy theater, based in the basement floor of a everything but abandoned shopping center. Upon further inspection, you notice its charm. A theater built probably in the 70s/80s, it's small, has only three halls and the seats are a few decades outdated.  The movie we went to was a 22:30 showing, there were about 10 people total in the theater, it somehow made the movie much better. You feel free to whisper, laugh out loud and talk about the movie, and although everyone can hear you, it disturbs no one. The comfort you feel just make it a more genuine movie viewing experience, as opposed to the very institutionalised movie experience of today.  Also, the was an INTERLUDE! Who does that anymore?? || I've been to a lot of run-down movie theatres, and this is easily the worst.  FIRST, they don't have a website, so I found movie listings on seret.co.il, but when we made a trip to this theatre - the only one in town - the listings turned out to have been all wrong, like the movie didn't even exist. Cashier shrugged and was like, "It's not our site." Like - surely there's a way to fix that; this is 2022 and people plan moviegoing online.  SECOND, it's in a charmless bunker in the basement and the seats, floor, etc., are grungy from years of wear and tear. A group of older teens came in late and shouted through the entire movie. One guy even took a call - he was like, "I'm at the theatre," and proceeded to talk about the movie. I guess it's a plus that a staff person asked us if we wanted the air conditioning on; otherwise, we might have suffocated. Yuck. Surely with all the tourists in town, a decent theatre could attract some business?  Giving it 2 stars because we were actually able to see a movie, even if we couldn't hear a lot of it because of the shouting hoodlums in the back row. Oh, and the bathrooms were actually really good. Lots of soap, paper, and very clean. If only the theatres were as good as the toilets. || This theater is really fun to see a blockbuster - the big theater is grand enough to make it feel like a special occasion! The staff is very nice and the ladies rooms are clean and classy looking. If you are new to Israeli movie theaters, heads up - if there is a brief pause in the middle of the film, it's not broken.. it is intermission! Take a moment to laugh at the awkward spot they stopped the film, and then take a tinkle (or whatever). Have fun, enjoy the movie! || Very old place, but it has its own rarity. || If I could give a negative score for this place as a movie theater, I would. Lets just say the highlight of the evening was when one of the staff threatened to call the police on people who were being rude. The sound system is decent but the screen is warped and there is serious light bleed in the hall. People use their phones all the time AND the audience basically randomly walks around. Do not go to a movie here unless you have no other option. || Now it's the only game in town if you want to see a movie. Good theater nice staff old style so the screen isn't like the new theaters but it does the job but they have all the hit movies. The only thing they still have an intermission so it's kind of annoying that they stopped in the middle of the movie and then start again || Worst cinema I have ever been in Israel. 3 halls, we were at num 3 which is the largest The seats and the floor was filthy The screen is very small The audio is terrible The seats themselves are very veryyyyy old Just don't go, better to watch Netflix at home || Although recently recarpeted you can still see the place is in need of renovation. But taking in account that cinemas are dwindling all over the world good it's still open - last cinema and Theatre in Eilat. 3D screening available for selected movies and if you are looking for kids movies most of the time screenings are with and without Hebrew sincronisation || Looks like movies is not a good business in Eilat. Large popcorn is small everywhere else. Chairs were cramped with mo legroom like a seat in economy flight! No place to rest head. Sound average. Exit sign so brught it lot the whole room up. No ushers to shoosh the crowd who were all talking during the movie........felt like a lecture hall. And its all down in a cellar and the waitung area looked like a cafeteria! || This is an old-school movie theater, with an intermission in the middle of the movie. We were a little late to the movie and saw a huge line before the  box office. Luckily they started playing about half an hour after the published time, so we got to see everything.

place_name: מסעדת מיה ביץ - מסעדת בשרים כשרה
reviews_content: The menu at  Mia Beach Bar is a true culinary masterpiece. Every dish is meticulously prepared with the finest ingredients, resulting in a symphony of flavors that will tantalize your taste buds. From the first bite to the last, each dish was a delightful revelation. The menu features a diverse range of options, catering to various dietary preferences and ensuring there is something for everyone to savor. || Hot beer in a plastic cup. Dusty plates. A waiter who, when serving dishes, dips his sweater into the sauces on the table. Soy sauce seems to be bottled ten years ago.  Do you think this is unrealistic?  This happened to me today.  Why two stars and not one - they have really good sushi. || Good,loud music and that’s all. Sushi is manageable, salads over dressed, hot drinks in plastic cups. Service is awful, the worst I saw since. A bunch of waiters are walking up and down disoriented. At the end the bill came wrong with things we didn’t order. Good as a bar, but not as a restaurant. And defenetly is not a place for kids! || very nice place right next to the beach in the tourists zone, the food is very tasty and fresh, the portions are good, all that along with music from the 80s make it a perfect place for dinner or a drink. I will surely revisit this place next time I'm in Eilat. || Not sure if it's new here or not but when we were there it was mainly a sushi place named Jiro and also they had Susu burgers (for those from the center) sushi is average but I'd say overpriced compared to other places. || Food was decent. Although we had not a very nice service. I asked for a certain bottle of dry wine, it was not available. We were offered to choose between 2 different bottle, we chose one, tried it and it was not dry, although I asked for dry. I do not read Hebrew very well so I couldn’t read what was written on the bottle. After we found out we asked to replace the bottle or find some other kind of compromise, cause it was mutual mistake. The waitress just refused to do anything, we didn’t even get a simple sorry. So in general unpleasant experience. || Foods was delicious ambiance was perfect  workers was kind really satisfied this place exactly i will come back again || good location but ...expensive as it often is the case with beach restaurants. Still a nice and enjoyable place to be || Very good location by the beach. Lovely waiter. But his kind attitude couldn't save the place. It could be a good restaurant with cool vibes, but it seems like they just don't care. Dirty, neglected exterior space. Menu with non-existing food and drinks.  It's very unfortunate... || Cool bar located right on the shore of the Red Sea in Eilat. I was there in the mid-afternoon, sat on the beach, the service was great but not evasive. I visited in Israeli 'winter' but I'm sure it's a go-to place when the weather warms up! Check it out!

Awful service, cheap place, cheap vibes ! If you look for a fancy place with good taste that’s definitely not the place ! But I guess some people like this cheap atmosphere as it was full! We booked a table for 10, food was surprisingly not so bad but such amateur service. We left after one hour begging for our bootle of wine and decent service. Run if you can ! || Cool place for events, was there and it was a warm attitude from the staff || Amazing!!! Thanks👍 Good place Good Food A great place to enjoy a good night fever🤩 || Really enjoyed everything and everyone || It's a shame the place closed Wow, fun, quality, good atmosphere, flowing and pleasant music, the place turns from a restaurant where the food is delicious for meat eaters only then into a small and flowing party, reasonable prices for every pocket, located near the center of Eilat, the services are a bit of a mess for such an invested place || We booked a table for 9:00 PM. When we arrived, there was a guy who screamed at us that there were still no bartenders and no hostess and that we would have to wait outside until they arrived. We tried to explain to him that we booked a table for a certain time and accordingly we made plans for the rest of the evening, but there was no one to talk to. He screamed at us at that moment. We canceled the table and went to another restaurant with a high level of service! I should mention that we came from the far north to take a break from the hard routine. It's simply disappointing that this is the attitude they give.

Came here to watch the new avatar with family! Was incredible movie but other than that. The girl left disappointed and crying and they just let us down. Disappointing cinema Bis Planet and Cinema City This would not have happened It is an insult to Eilat that they do not have a real, quality movie theater in the city || Trying to book tickets but the website only says phone bookings, the phone hasn't been answered for a few days... Watching the movie, the cleanliness, the air conditioning, the attitude of the employees was a real experience. And we sat in the V.I.F. We really enjoyed such a Tel Aviv experience....keep it up, thank you😍 …

I stayed overnight as I was flying from Aqaba in the morning. This was an excellent value for the price! But more importantly to me, the staff was awesome. Each staff member that I interacted with was knowledge, kind, and thoughtful. The dinner buffet is also a great choice! Yes, there are larger hotels, but if hospitality is important to you, book here. || Pros (many)|Shiran, Vivi, Sivan reception attendants were professional||++ Price:  even cheaper than Eilat youth Hostel with a full breakfast||1. Room|Basic But  Spacious|+ Kettle, coffee, tea, big fridge|+ Bathroom with really strong … || Receptionist was very sweet helpful  Price is great.pool is adequate for rhe guests during the week  Room was small but very clean  Bathroom was refurbished recently  Told by other guests that breakfast was tasty  Asked for more towels and pillows and received then right away  Scuba diving is the reason we came  We always use deep siam || Nice quality for fair price. We had everything we needed in our room: several beds, fridge, microwave and electric kettle. Also they provided us with baby bed. Breakfast is very good. Scrambled eggs, roasted and fresh vegetables and fruits. Wide number of yogurts, also some traditional dishes. Personal is welcoming and friendly. The biggest disadvantage is it's allowed to smoke at the summer terrace on the second floor and if your room is near - you can feel awful smoke all the time. I would highly recommend owners to prohibit smoking on the territory of the hotel. || I was ignored by the Reception staff for 5 mins before they checked me in pretty rudely. The first room I was put in (and slept a night in) was dire. The curtain didn't properly close, it was generally very rough round the edges, it didn't … || The staff is super nice. They really try to make everything to the guests liking. Therefore I don't blame the staff for the awful stay we had at the hotel. We booked the "suite" for our stay and expected not much, for the price was very low. But when we got there we were really disappointed. The room wasn't clean, there were holes in de ceiling and everything was one room. It was for 5 persons, so just one room was very annoying. The bathroom is also the living room and the bedroom is sepparated from the bathroom by just one single slide door. We told the manager, we didn't really like it and he was really nice and tried to help us. The next day we came across the owner of the Hotel in the hall. She basically told us we should shut up and leave if we didn't like it. She was the most rude and unfriendly person I have ever met. The staff acted as they were scared of the owner and I wouldn't blame them. To sum up: Don't stay at this hotel. It is not what they say it is and the owner is a really mean person. || I had a very comfortable stay at the red sea hotel. The staff were helpful and friendly.  Breakfast was varied and tasty, something to suit all tastes. The rooms were cleaned every day with fresh towels provided daily also. The room was spacious enough although the bathroom could have done with some renovation. Very convenient location only 10 minutes walk from the beach, shops and restaurants all close by. I would recommend this hotel it was good value for money :) || A cheap hotel. The breakfast was surprisingly good 😋. After two nights here I can say that there are quiet nights here, and Very noisy ones, with teenagers shouting very late at night - the acoustics is a nightmare. The interior design is brought straight from the 70s. Considering the price - it's not as bad as we expected. Big comfortable bad, good shower if you don't mind stepping on a too long curtain shower - the place is full of these small annoying things. It's much much better than staying in a tent... And the staff are kind and helpful. Clean as well || Price unbeatable, plentiful and good breakfast, will be back, but earplugs are mandatory! By the way you have free sunbeds at the Maman Beach near the Marina Beach, close the the Queen of Sheba and these are very good. || Awful place, we came here for 4 nights and really regretted it.  The acoustics are terrible, the room has additional closed doors, behind which there are other rooms and literally everything is heard!  Music plays all day near the pool, so …

We stayed at the Royal Garden in Eilat as a couple with our 10-year-old daughter, celebrating a special birthday, and our experience was absolutely wonderful. From the moment we arrived, the staff made us feel warmly welcomed and truly … || Beautiful room, very clean, comfortable and delicate finishing. Food is amazing and even on Shabbat, we didn't feel anything was missing in the dining room. Food was fresh, well presented, tasty and Friday dinner a delight! || Dear Dariana,  Thank you so much for your wonderful review! I'm delighted to know you enjoyed our clean and comfortable rooms with their delicate finishing. It's fantastic that the food met your expectations, especially the Friday dinner. At Isrotel, we maintain high standards in hospitality and culinary experiences, and I'm glad this was reflected in your stay. We look forward to welcoming you back soon for another great experience.  Regards, Dorin || We spent a lovely 5 nights in this hotel , family of four, couple + 7 and 9 years old. We arrived at Saturday, we book a family suite, but were upgraded to a bigger family suite (the balcony is a bit bigger with two exists , from the both rooms. The room had a living room with a sofa bed and a main bedroom with a queen size bed, the room had a mini bar and of course a nice bathroom, we did miss a hair dryer (maybe it was possible to ask on the reception, but we didn't try). The hotel has 3 or 4 pools, none of them are deep , so great for kids , abit less for grown ups but it was okay. There is also a pool with a sea send , that looks exactly as if it's a beach , very nice . The main pool has some waterfalls, the kids absolutely loved it . Aside of the pools there is a kids club , would recommend it till the age of ten , but we had some shows where if the adults really enjoyed. The down side is a missing of an open bar , like a place where you can grab coffee or some other drinks after dinner, there is a very nice coffee shop , but it doesn't operate on Saturdays as it's Kosher. The rest of the week, great place to have a coffee. Now regarding the food , we booked half a pension, so we enjoyed both breakfast and dinner, so first of all there are plenty of gluten free options, aside of it , we enjoyed the food a lot, the verity was great , especially on dinner. So bottom line, we really enjoyed this hotel , definitely recommend it for family with small kids . || Dear Mark,  Thank you for your detailed feedback. I'm delighted to know you enjoyed your stay with your family. Upgrading you to a larger family suite is part of our efforts to ensure a comfortable and luxurious experience. I apologize for the absence of a hairdryer in the room; our reception is always available for additional requests. I'm glad the pools were a hit with your kids and that you enjoyed the club and shows. Regarding the open bar, we are exploring ways to enhance our services. I'm pleased you appreciated the meals and gluten-free options. We look forward to welcoming you back soon.  Regards, Dorin || I spent 3 wonderful days at this hotel during the recent annual Zumba event . The spacious rooms, delicious food, beautiful decor and great service made my vacation unforgettable. Will surely return 🥰 || Dear Liat,  Thank you so much for your positive feedback! I'm delighted to know you enjoyed your stay during the annual Zumba event. It's wonderful to learn that the spacious rooms, delicious food, beautiful decor, and great service contributed to an unforgettable vacation. We would be thrilled to welcome you back in the near future. Isrotel is always here to provide you with a fantastic experience on every visit.  Regards, Dorin || One of the best hotels in Eilat, big, clean, renovated rooms, wonderfull breakfast and dinner!  Very tasty desserts. Very kind and helpfull stuff. Recommend. || Dear Igor, Thank you so much for your warm recommendation! I'm delighted that you enjoyed our spacious, renovated rooms and the diverse, delicious meals. Our team strives to provide kind and helpful service, and I will pass on your compliments to them. Isrotel is proud to offer a high-standard hospitality experience, and we look forward to welcoming you again soon. Regards, Dorin || I don’t write negative reviews. I never have. But what we went through at the Isrotel Royal Garden in Eilat still haunts me. This time, I simply can’t stay silent.  We stayed for seven nights in April 2025 with our two small children. We paid over 26,000 NIS for what was supposed to be a relaxing, high-end family vacation. Before arriving, I spoke directly with the hotel and was clearly assured that the pool would be heated. That was important because of our son’s sensitivity to cold.  In reality, he went into the water and came out violently shivering. Not a light chill, but full-body, uncontrollable shivering. In a moment of panic, we gave him hot tea to warm him. Because of the shaking, the tea spilled on him. He suffered a second-degree burn. We spent the rest of the trip in daily treatments at the clinic, changing bandages, dealing with pain, fear, and exhaustion.  But the worst part came after we left.  We contacted the Isrotel chain with full documentation: videos, temperature readings (22.6°C), medical reports, photos, audio recordings. At first, they even offered two nights as compensation. Then, suddenly, they called back and canceled it. They told us clearly: "You won’t receive any compensation. You don’t deserve it."  I usually avoid naming names. That’s not my style. But this time, I have to make an exception. The phone call we received from Saar, who introduced herself as the head of customer service for the entire Isrotel chain, was one of the most disrespectful and dehumanizing experiences we’ve ever had with any service provider. Not only was there zero empathy, she blamed us completely as parents. She dismissed our feelings and ended the call with cold, hurtful statements. I don’t understand how someone with that attitude is leading customer service for a major hotel brand. This wasn’t a local misunderstanding. It was their official position.  You go on vacation to escape the stress. But in this case, the stress followed us to the pool and continued long after we left. I still think about it every day. Our son still has the physical scar. We carry the emotional ones.  And for anyone thinking that summer pool water can’t be cold, I have videos, audio recordings, and statements from other guests who said they were freezing too. None of that mattered to management.  I’ve never shared personal recordings or evidence before. But this time, the lack of accountability is too big to ignore. It’s not even about the compensation anymore. It’s about the way we were treated.  By the way, I am a very active Google Maps contributor with over 95 million views on my photos and reviews. I wanted to share a good experience. I was ready to recommend this place. But after everything that happened, I feel a responsibility to be honest with others. Because people deserve to know not just how a hotel looks when things go well, but how it behaves when something goes wrong. || Dear Shai,   We are familiar with your inquiry and, despite the fact that Isrotel is not a party to this matter, we nevertheless made every effort to address your concerns during your stay and thereafter.  As you are aware, the incident occurred when your wife handed your son a cup of hot tea, which was then spilled. Naturally, this was beyond the ability of the hotel or its staff to prevent.  Out of respect for your privacy, we will not go into further details on this public platform. However, we would like to emphasize that a full explanation and response were already provided to you both during your stay and again following your vacation. A goodwill gesture was also offered to you at the hotel, which you declined, and therefore it is no longer valid. Best Regards Dorin || The hotel is amazing, the food amazing, the service amazing but… the view and the comfort of the beds are that good I love everything but honestly I couldn’t sleep and well the parking is just awful || Dear Noam,  Thank you so much for your feedback. I'm delighted to know you enjoyed the service and food at our hotel. I apologize for the discomfort with the beds. We understand the importance of a good night's sleep and will look into this matter. Regarding the parking, we are aware it's a challenge and are seeking solutions to improve it. We hope to welcome you back for a flawless experience next time.  Regards, Dorin || This place is wonderful the location could've had a better view, but other than that, food is amazing, rooms amazing and the pool also I love it 5 stars || Dear Ari, Thank you so much for your positive feedback! I'm delighted to know that you enjoyed your stay with friends. I appreciate your comment regarding the view and will pass it on to management. I'm glad to hear that the food, rooms, and pool met your expectations. We at Isrotel strive to provide unforgettable experiences for all our guests. We look forward to welcoming you back soon! Regards, Dorin || Thank you to Inbal at the Esprit Spa for excellent customer service and professionalism. || Hi Harrison,  Thank you for your wonderful feedback! We're delighted you appreciated Inbal's professional service at the Esprit Spa. Isrotel takes pride in our skilled team, and we'll make sure Inbal knows of your appreciation. We look forward to welcoming you back soon for another relaxing experience.  Regards, Dorin || Kid friendly amazing weather nice staff and convenient location good food and a nice pool highly recommended || Dear Michael,  Thank you so much for your wonderful feedback! I'm delighted that you enjoyed your stay with us. It's important to us that our hotel provides a perfect experience for the whole family, and I'm glad the convenient location, friendly staff, and lovely pool contributed to that. We would be thrilled to welcome you and your family back soon.  Regards, Dorin

The atmosphere was vibrant yet relaxing, with great music, delicious food, and stunning views that made it feel like a perfect getaway.  A special mention goes to Sanad from the entertainment team — he truly made the experience memorable! His energy, professionalism, and ability to engage with everyone brought the place to life. Whether it was organizing fun activities or keeping the vibe going throughout the day, Sanad went above and beyond to make sure everyone was having a great time. || Beautiful vibes right on LaPlage beach!The food is really good, I loved the fettuccine & service is excellent. || Favorite spot in Ayla! The place, atmosphere, food, and service, all were perfect❤️ Only downside is that it closes early at sunset. || I think they have the best beach in Aqaba, clean sand and nice furniture with a nice helpful friendly staff the food is delicious and the bartender makes a great drinks, I really enjoyed the place ❤️❤️ || Awesome food and service! The chicken quesadillas and mini chilli tacos were really good, and extremely flavorful, and the fries were to die for! The protein bowl was a little dry, but quite filling, and probably would have been better if we were not as hungry and wanted something lighter.
