Very nice, good coffee, lovely owner. || Thank you very much, we are glad you enjoyed. || good coffee, delicious snacks, cheap. highly recommend!!?

Caffe Optimi was the perfect place for a very special family celebration, and we couldn’t have chosen better.  We came as a large family gathering, with relatives visiting all the way from Byron Bay, Australia and Boston, USA, to celebrate our son’s Bar Mitzvah — and from the moment we arrived, we felt completely welcomed.  The atmosphere was warm, relaxed, and joyful, exactly what you want for a meaningful family occasion. The food was outstanding: the pizza was absolutely amazing 🤩, fresh, flavorful, and clearly made with care, and the hot chocolate was divine 🤤 — rich, comforting, and unforgettable.  What truly elevated the experience, though, was the people. Our waiter Idan was attentive, kind, and genuinely lovely. And Ofer, the manager, was so friendly, welcoming, and present. You can tell he truly cares about both his guests and his team, and that warmth fills the entire place.  This is what our son had to say, and honestly, it says it all:  “The pizza was amazing 🤩, the hot chocolate was divine 🤤, and the staff was nice. If I could give this place more stars, I would.”  If you’re looking for a café with great food, wonderful service, and a heart big enough to hold special moments and celebrations — Caffe Optimi is it. Highly, highly recommended. 🌟 || Thank you for choosing to stay with us. We appreciate you taking the time to write a positive feedback. Customer satisfaction is our top priority. We look forward to seeing you again. || More suitable for day time probably. Wouldn't recommend choosing to eat on the main promenade, but this place had many vegan options. Salad came without dressing and was kinda depressing, pasta was good (both vegan and non vegan) , one of us ordered a pizza and was satisfied. Not breath-taking but a solid choice if you're spontaneously hungry and have a group with various dietary prefrences. || Service was bad: had to explain what a cold coffee with oat milk is, had to wait 30 mn for a carrot juice. We almost felt we should apologize for refusing the hot coffees we had never ordered. Brunch 78 shekels, we thought, it’s going to be good. But: barely any food, salad vegetables barely chopped no sauce, super basic boiled eggs, vegan omelet as thin as a sheet of paper, vegan cheese totally bland, greasy and overcooked sabir, the rest out of tins except maybe the avocado purée which was basic but fresh. Bread supposedly homemade but then they shouldn’t brag about it. In fact we left half the food, and my husband vomited half an hour later. In short: what a scam. || Thank you for sharing with us! We are sorry that your experience with us was not perfect, and appreciate the opportunity to learn and improve. We would appreciate it if you would contact us by email and let us know at optimiknd@gmail.com so that we can fix it and make sure that this time the experience will be positive and enjoyable. || In a shopping center with great views of the downtown Eilat area and beautiful palm trees. Can get busy during tourist time. Food was ok. Had stuffed mushrooms as appetizer and fish and chips. || We ordered take away, 2 pizzas at the price of over 170 ILS, the pizza itself was fine, tasty. Better than all the other industrial pizzas around. The thing is, for that price I would expect something larger than personal sized pizza. Also, one of the pizzas, the most expensive one, had a huge cheese ball in the middle, making the cutting action pretty impossible. I would reconsider the way of serving that dish || A nice café. I’d definitely recommend the shakshuka—it’s very delicious and comes with fresh bread. The fish and chips, however, felt overpriced with an uneven fish-to-chips ratio, and it didn’t come with any special sauces. The waiters were friendly and attentive, and the dishes arrived quickly. Overall, a great spot for breakfast || Thank you for choosing to stay with us. We appreciate you taking the time to write a positive feedback. Customer satisfaction is our top priority. We look forward to seeing you again. || The staff is really nice and fast with your order. They have French, Hebrew, and English menus and they don't roll your eyes when your wacky family asks for all three. Our waitress (Eden) was very sweet and didn't miss a beat when we ordered in three languages. The food was very good (I had the "cool salad" and haloumi always makes me happy). They have gluten free and vegan options as well! Also... They gave us napkins AND water, and if you know the bad service in Israel, you know this is a luxury! || Cafe Optimi is a great spot for basic Italian cuisine. While the menu is somewhat limited—mostly catering to meat lovers—the dishes are rich in authentic Italian flavors. A nice, cozy place to enjoy a satisfying meal. || Thank you for choosing to stay with us. We appreciate you taking the time to write a positive feedback. Customer satisfaction is our top priority. We look forward to seeing you again. || A good option for a date night or a family night out. The prices are reasonable for its extensive menu of starters, pizza, pasta fish dishes, and Get reservations unless you want to wait 30-40 minutes. || Great place, The food was tasty, bus need some slat and lemon... Stuff was great when they came to the table but only after they saw that we need them || Thank you for choosing to stay with us. We appreciate you taking the time to write a positive feedback. Customer satisfaction is our top priority. We look forward to seeing you again.

place_name: Café LOBBY at Shoshana קפה לובי שושנה
reviews_content: Really great vibe, decent service, food is made with lots of fresh ingredients, super flavoursome & the helpings are hearty. The only tiny detail is that the menu is only in Hebrew, but google translate takes care of that plus most the wait staff speak very good English. Well worth a visit! || Fantastic spot! The service was warm and attentive, making us feel welcome right from the start. The food and drinks were exceptional—thoughtfully prepared, with incredible attention to detail and flavors that really stood out. The design and atmosphere were just perfect—chic yet inviting, with music that added to the relaxed vibe without overpowering the conversation. Overall, great value for money and an experience I’d definitely recommend! || Probably the best place in Eilat for coffee / breakfast / brunch experience. Fresh morning dishes, great salads and surprisingly good fresh hummus. Cool vibes, attentive service. This is perhaps the only place in Eilat I really look forward returning to... || Came as a couple and had the shared breakfast – it was absolutely delicious. Everything was fresh, well-made, and full of flavor. Perfect way to start the day together. || Best Cappuccino and breakfast in Eilat. We went there twice within 4 hours, it was that good! Keep up the great service and quality!! || Great fresh food for a fair price, amazing ingredients and generous dishes. || The best breakfast we ever had in Eilat, don’t look any further! || Amazing food, very nice personnel, cozy and warm atmosphere. Best wishes to the owners and staff, made us feel lifted up! || We came to have breakfast and the food was excellent with a very good atmosphere. We sat outside in April it was excellent weather || nice option to have breakfast good menu European/middle east(even hummus and jahnun) Good coffee, plesent atmosphere

Exceptional food served with a smile- I had burger and fries which was 1/2 pound but I would recommend medium well since medium was a little rare. My wife had a feta salad which was huge and fantastic. We both started with stuffed grape  leaves on bed of tzatziki which was the best I’ve ever had || The portion size is filling, the salmon was well done and the mashed potatoes (dairy) was soft and tasty. The atmosphere is inviting and fun (especially if you sit outside). Great for any craving! || There sure is a reservation-communication problem, however we got sorted out quickly. The atmosphere is relax and feels like home. The food is just great. Tasty and well served. We ordered salads, pasta and a chicken dish. Excellent food!! || The pastas are excellent.  When we came without reservations we were allotted an hour and fifteen minutes even though there were plenty of free tables.  Cordial service.  Happy hour 17-18 Sunday to Thursday. || Best breakfast that money can buy. Clean place which is important when buying food. The owner is sweet and takes care of uncomfortable situations with love. Makes you keep coming back for more. Food is really good and not super expensive. Enjoyed every minute || It was my first time in Branja restaurant and I really enjoyed my visit. I had green shakshuka for lunch, which was really good. The staff is very friendly, they made me feel welcomed. They have an english menu, prices are reasonable. Toilets are very clean. Interior and art on the walls are cool. It's a hip place and I'd go there again. || Love this place! It was our favorite in Eilat and we ate here several times during our short stay. Breakfast all day if you want it. Brunch (on Sundays?) till 5. Really great food at reasonable prices. Happy hours from 5-6 on off nights (Monday-Thurs?) with 2 for one cocktails. The cocktails here are really excellent as well. The Branja Butty sandwich is delicious as was the sweet potato ravioli.  They are very welcoming with a relaxed beachy/artsy vibe. || Food quality great. Nice snd intersting dishes. Culm atmosphere.  Good price. First time their, we will come again || You coming through a lot you must eat here all of the best test the food you can find we enjoy everything we order on the menu do you have English menu and Hebrew really five star service to || Love the place, the vibes in this place. It's like vintage but with a bit modern. Good service, great plates, I ordered fettucini with smoked goose, my girlfriend ordered fettucini with sweet potato and artichoke. Also cocktail that came in a bicycle. For desert we ordered apple pie with vanilla ic cream, it was delicius. In conclusion, was amazing meal with very good cervice and good vibes. Extremely recomended.

Love the Cream express! Delicious fresh breakfast and sandwiches. Interesting mix of customers, including locals, tourists, pensioners, hippies and bus drivers. Very accommodating. What a local cafe should be. Open from morning to early afternoon. || Attractive prices (9 ILS for espresso macchiato), good service, coffee is just okay. Atmosphere leaves a little to be desired -- only few tables in the air conditioned area. || Our breakfast was delicious and the guys here were very friendly || I came to eilat after a long bus trip ,looking for a great place to eat , 5 min from the bus station  i found it . a cozy  small restaurant with a huge terrace , great food , even for vegan, all handmade with love , great chill out  and not exspensive. Crema Express is the place for me , great food , friendly owner , all made with love , very friendly to tourists. || Fresh and tasty food. Super-friendly service. One of the best coffees ever! I recommend the croissant with  egg, salmon, and cheese -- a super generous serving that was really delicious. || Amazing service and amazing food! The staff was very personable and friendly. Food was plentiful and really good! There is outdoor and indoor seating. If youre visiting Eilat I highly recommend going to crema express! || Friendly service. Tasty food. || Amazing food, amazing prices, amazing vibes, perfect place. Amazing service too!! || Coffee quality was very good. Croissant was fresh. Staff spoke English. || Great food for a great price. Lovely staff with awesome vibes. Will definately go again. || Thank you very much .

Lovely, clean, and a service with a smile.  It's definitely worth a visit and also a variety of cookies, cakes, and sweets . But I came for the coffee and it's well made . Good coffee !! || I came to Eilat to celebrate my partners 70th birthday with his 4 children and grandchildren. I ordered quite a few cakes and cream puffs. Each and every cake was delicious especially the cream puffs that were drowning in cream😋 || Best place in town. 🎂☕️🥐🥪 My family and I are regular guests for almost eight years, tried many...there's  no comparison. Great choice of sweets also for people who have particular dietary restrictions. The pâtisserie is very delicate and well presented and doesn't feel heavy or too sugary on the palate. The Israeli breakfast options are nice, everything is fresh and tasty and a great choice for a late breakfast. Also the quiche...soooo good! Coffee...absolutely the best ❤️ The staff is lovely, they are always very nice, helpful and kind...by now for us it's like family. The cleanest place around too! Recommended 100% 🔥🔥🔥🔥 || Russian speaking waiter declined to take order in russian. Okay, it's not a big deal. After that we switched to english but she messed with the order 3 times in a raw. Awful. Food tastes good, but I visit such places not only for food but for good service too. So, if you looking for good service it's wrong place. || Great coffee and pastry. Cool vibe, friendly and delicious. The Israeli breakfast was fresh , rich and very tasty. Highly recommended || Tasty coffee! Have a variety of milk substitutes.... In my option the place lack of  vegan food choices. Other than that, lovely experience. Along the side the road with intimate vibe. || Good coffee! A variety of cakes and cookies to eat there or to take home. Even vegan and non sugar (for diabetics). And the most important for me... No loud music. One can talk there with the people he's sitting with. || Very professional! Fulfilled my every wish! Thank you one more time! As I heard, the cake was very tasty! See you when I come to Israel!!! 💙 … || Unfortunately I'm talking about my favorite coffee shop. ... Over the past few months something has  changed and the bad service or lack of it made us think twice before going there.. Yesterday we decided to go and have coffee there, at our favorite place .. We ordered our usual cold coffee . Ten minutes later the waitress came and said : " I'M SORRY BUT WE DON'T HAVE GLASSES FOR THE COFFEE. WOULD YOU LIKE ME TO PUT IT IN A TAKE AWAY --  DISPOSABLE  CUP" ???     DA-AAAA????? She was quite serious ..though we were in shock ... REALLY???  You don't have glasses for the drinks ??? Is it a proper business or not ?? Are they jocking ?? Go and wash a glass ... Or go and buy a glass ...  steal one if need be 😉 They were in shock when we got up and left..... Maybe we were too demanding.. Difficult customers... Conclusion ; mustn't forget to bring my own cold coffee glass from home next time Disaster. !!! || Very busy, good cakes

Great place for a breakfast meal. Staff are very friendly and the food is freshly prepared and reasonably priced. Will definitely return. || Never had breakfast...but it's my first stop of the day ..fresh coffee.... sandwiches...and all kind of early Bird snacks ... Come see for yourself || Great place. Nice sandwiches and cakes all made fresh on the premises. Indoor and outdoor seating area. Good breakfast too. || Food is fresh and delicious as well as affordable. Amazing little gem in the Middle of a busy downtown. || Tasty, fresh bread, fresh orange juice. Very vegan friendly. Great service. || Great place, tasty and cozy atmosphere. || Love this place good service .good cakes and cofee . || Great service and food || A particularly sweet and professional experience 🍰☕ We visited the pastry shop and cafe Hauman 9 in Eilat and left simply enchanted. The amazing sound and the entire amazing team provide warm, courteous service with attention to the smallest details. The pastries and desserts are of a high standard, fresh, creative and insanely delicious, every bite a real pleasure, especially the little fricassee. The atmosphere in the place is pleasant, clean and inviting, and you feel that this is a work of the heart and soul. Highly recommended to anyone looking for good coffee, quality sweets and a genuine smile on the go.

Busy popular place.  Manager very gracious and quick to find us a comfortable spot.  Great music playing and open space to see the water view no matter where  you’re seated.  Our server could have been a bit more attentive but he looked quite young and I will just assume it’s a lack of experience.  But he was always kind and polite and ready to help when we got his attention.  Highly recommend this place. Fun, great food, even kid friendly || If anyone tells you that there are no good places to eat out in Israel, just come to the Ninth Beach in Eilat. The food is delicious, the service exceeds expectations, and the atmosphere has its own vibe. Am here every time when visiting Eilat. || A bar on the beach next to the mall in Eilat. They have a vegan menu, which is impressive in Eilat (unfortunately). The view and the shade are wonderful to sit with friends and family. The alcohol is pretty expensive, but it makes sense to the position of the restaurant. || Evening review: nice atmosphere. Calm and relaxing music. Menu is good (simple food but sometimes it's exactly what you need). What we didn't like: waiter (name starts with D) had 2 mistakes in bill (total mistake value of about 25 USD). We told him and he canceled just one of them. Refused the other was a mistake. Shame because otherwise nice place. Prices are decent though. || Summery: good place for a group who want different kinds of dishes. Food is good, prices are reasonable.  There is only one way to describe the food- OK. Its not bad in any way, tasty to eat even, but not exceptional in any way. I can say this after tasting everyone's dishes, and after asking them. This place is really a jack of all trades but master of none, which is great if you have a big family that wants different things (like us).  Service is great: fast, professional, kind. Cant ask for more.  Atmosphere is great, lighting, music, the option to sit by the sea (we didn't) is all very attractive || Honestly we didn’t expect much and were looking for a spot by the water. But the food is just great!! Really amazing experience, was really full when we arrived but fortunately we got a table. Prices are average for Eilat. || Nice place for breakfast and dinner! Restaurant and seats just few feets from the sea. Prices are good. Breakfast for one was very good and cost about 15€. Burger was ok, price about 16€. Breakfast for two adults and a three year old child cost us 150 NIS. That was about 35€. Well recommended! || The food and service were perfect, I would reccomend coming at a decent hour (19:00-21:00) before rush hour to actually test the waters, Our waitress (Ziv) was spectacular, she was super welcoming and fast with eyecontact service, she came with all of our food at once. Very calming music, super cute I would recommend this place for a date, dinner with friends, familly outing and even meetings. || Recommended! When you are on the beach, go and have some drink! We picked mango cosmopolitan - good one, and Nine beach speciality, i dont really remember the name of the drink, but it was mojito with watermelon and kiwi twist - best one! It really tastes great 😍 and the cakes, oh, no words needed. Staff was nice, attentive, also when i asked if they have gluten free cakes, the waiter recommended me some, and went to double check with the chef, without my request - which I found really nice! In Israel is food more expensive, so don't be surprised if your bill is higher lol. || So the location and overall vibe are simply stellar! Music is good and a normal volume (which is rare for these kinda beach bars). But the service is simply horrible! I took a seat and they were quick to give me a menu and a drink but they never returned after that. I even asked them to take my order and the waitress said; "one minute" and never returned. To make it even worse; the waitress was constantly chatting with what appeared to be her personal friends a table next to me for nearly an hour!

Do you want Quality? Do you enjoy friendly service? Do you appreciate reasonably priced dishes? This is the place to patronize. Congratulations to all the team , you guys are just the best !!! And good luck the your new venture at 7stars, can’t wait 😛 || Thank you very much🙏🙏 … || We just love this place, the sandwiches are great, coffee and hot chocolate wonderful. And all surrounding is so cozy. The staff is great. We definitely will return here, when we will visit Eilat again. || Thank you very much Beatrice🙏🙏 … || We came around 8:30am and the small line took about 25-30 minutes. The sandwiches were great, but the coffee was weak. Not the best choice if you're in a hurry || Very high quality pastry products and very good sandwich, mid range prices, great service, lovely atmosphere. Worth getting out from the hotel.  A MOST VISIT IN EILAT. || Thank you very much Micael :) || Very good bakery in Eilat. There are not a lot of places like this on the city so this one definitely stands out! Good coffee, tasty sandwiches ( brie and pear is really good) and fresh pastries. The place is the best for breakfast in the city. They are very busy so the service is not super nice, but it was ok, I understand that is just because they have a long queue to serve… || Thank you very much Tanya. We apologize for the long queue. Due to the war, there is an unusual load, and we are doing the best we can. 🙏🙏 … || The coffee is good. The pastries are amazing. Very crisp and fresh. The butter croissant is very good. Very recommended! || Thank you very much Hadas🙏🌸 … || One of the best bakeries I’ve seen! Food is perfect. Prices are fair, and the ice coffee with the sandwich fits perfectly. Also, we joined their membership and got free coffee. || Thank you very much Alon🙏🌸 … || One of the oldest bakery's in Eilat if not the first ... Fresh bread is not the only thing here Cheese and all kind of Small added things that make life better my favorite is the eteupian thina... There is also a Koffee house with sweets and sandwiches.... I think the pizza is New || Thank you very much🙏 … || Broitman’s Bakery is my go-to spot in Eilat, mainly because their coffee is absolutely perfect — smooth, rich, and consistently great every time. You can tell they know what they’re doing. I’ve also grabbed a sandwich a couple of times, and it was fresh and really tasty. Everything there looks homemade and made with care. Highly recommend if you’re into quality coffee and good food || One of the better backeries in Eilat - you can take away or sit in. Everything we had was freshly backed and really good. We got different buns and a variety of sweet pastries, some cheese, coffee, fruits, and juice. Prices were fair and worth it. || Thak you very much Lior :)

Pastory in Eilat is easily one of the best dining experiences the city has to offer. From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere feels warm, lively, and welcoming, with a classic Italian touch that immediately sets the mood for a great meal. The staff are incredibly attentive and friendly, making sure you’re comfortable without ever being intrusive.  The food is the real highlight. Every dish feels thoughtfully prepared and full of flavor. The fresh pasta stands out — perfectly cooked, rich sauces, and generous portions that still feel balanced. The seafood dishes are especially impressive, with ingredients that taste fresh and well-seasoned. The pizzas are also excellent, with a thin, crispy crust and high-quality toppings.  Service is surprisingly fast considering how busy the restaurant often is, and everything arrives hot and beautifully plated. The menu has great variety, so both picky eaters and adventurous diners will find something they love.  Prices are on the higher side, but absolutely justified for the quality and overall experience. Pastory is the kind of place you look forward to returning to — a reliable, flavorful, and memorable spot in Eilat. Highly recommended for couples, families, and anyone who appreciates great Italian food. || The place itself was pleasant, and I was glad we were seated outside. Inside there was a very strong smell of fish and meat, which made the outdoor seating a much better choice. The staff was very kind and welcoming throughout the meal.  The food was a mixed experience. The salad was fresh, lemony, and very tasty. We also ordered an aglio olio pasta and asked for it to be made vegan. It arrived a bit dry and had a lot of greens, so it was not the best dish. On the other hand, the focaccia was amazing and definitely a highlight.  The restaurant was full, most likely because of its high rating, but based on this visit I feel there are better pasta options in Eilat || The best Italian restaurant in Israel.  Even in Italy not so often you can get such delicious food.  Everything is just excellent there.  Going there for 15 years at least. And every time it's very enjoyable.  Need to book in advance!!! || Great Italian dishes, not one of those overly oil/butter saturated spaghetti places. Everything was fresh and tasty. And our dessert was exquisite - brioche dipped in vanilla ice cream. || Yum! It wasn’t easy to get a reservation here during sukkot but we took a late seating and sat on the bar and it was so worth it. Everything we had was delicious! Loved the black ravioli and the salmon tartare. So happy to see Eilat finally getting some good quality restaurants and this was at the top of our list for the week! || I came here on my birthday, and as soon as I mentioned it the waiter congratulated me and offered shots for everyone at the table which is such a sweet gesture! The food was excellent, the pizza is thin and perfectly made, and the whole restaurant has a beautiful Italian design. Loved it there! || The atmosphere was good, pleasant music and lighting. The service was great, very friendly and the food was on the table in no time. The food itself was very tasty. We had pizzas and a pasta dish. Everyone was happy and thought the serving size was perfect. Only small criticism is that the oven-baked pizzas were a bit too black at the edges for our taste. The dessert, tiramisu and a special were great. Prices were reasonable. Would I go again? That's a firm yes || The food is generally good but risotto frutto di mare was swimming in oil, pizza Margarita had no basil and panacotta was not what it supposed to be. The waiters are snobbish and slow to come. Tiramisu was good by itself but a little drama of covering it with sauce was unnecessary. || We shared a minced meat lasagna and an artichoke salad. Was top notch. Waiter was extremely friendly and courteous. A restaurant  we'll go back to. || The start was very promising with exceptional service and great wine, however it started to degrade with every minute we spend in the restaurant. The shrimps with tomatoes were very good, the rest like risotto with pesto and the lasagna (with huge amount of cheese on top, look at photos) we very average. We ordered 2 deserts (one of them just didn’t make it to our table), asked for water - no reply, and by the end we waited for 15 minutes to get the bill and additional 10 minutes to get the card back. Maybe we had a bad luck, but this time the overall impression was just below average.

We visited the Three Monkeys Bar in Eilat as a group of eight on a weekday. There weren’t many free seats, but we did manage to get a table. There was a nice live performance, and people were dancing on the floor, creating a fun and lively atmosphere. The place is very loud, so it’s less suitable if you’re just looking to have a conversation. Overall, a good experience — we’ll definitely come back. || We were the first customers to arrive at 8 pm, so the place was empty, but it already had a nice atmosphere. We were told that there would be a live music band on at 10 p.m., and the show started right on time. The band was great, and many people started dancing on the dance floor next to the stage. The audio was not well balanced, so the drums were masking the singing, which was very good. There was a nice selection of beers, but only one option for wine, which was a little disappointing. || A very friendly and professional service.  The barman was very good at preparing the cocktails. The music is nice and the atmosphere is very friendly. They have live music at 10pm each night and it's certainly a great choice for having a cocktail or a beer. || The food and service, by the way, are not amazing. But if you like the 80s, it's worth a visit. There's a band that plays music that makes you happy. Better to come on Friday. || Cool live music but not so amazing Coketails. Prices are at the higher end and yet this is still a landmark in Eilat and always welcomes people to have a good time, party and dance every night. || A really cool pub/dance bar, with live music and nice vibe. It's a good place to have drinks with cool music. Enjoy :) || I love this bar so much! Whenever I'm in Eilat I always try to make it here. There is live music and great drinks. Cheers! || Very nice pub with a good vibes, live music🎸 and songs🕺, fine 🍺 and tasty cocktails🍹. No parking 🤷🏻‍♂️ || One of the famous places of Eilat. Great location. offer a good selection of beers. The main attribute is live music, played mainly by British musicians. You can choose place rather inside or outside, wherever you like. || Sat and ordered 4 beers. After 25 minutes 2 managers came to say it will take a few more minutes.  Left after 35 minutes without getting anything to drink, They totally ruined our night out. Will never go back there and nither should you.

The restaurant was empty, except for another couple. They waited on us for 29 minutes. After half an hour we asked to understand what was going on and when we would receive our order and they continued to lie to us that it would be another minute and another minute, they argued with us that only 25 minutes had passed and that was reasonable for them. Simply a significant deterioration in the attitude and conduct that had not been there before. || Hi, We checked the timestamps: you arrived at 13:15 and left at 13:44. This total time includes ordering, waiting, receiving the dishes, eating, and paying so it’s not possible that you waited 30 minutes for your dish. The actual timeline simply does not match what was described. || Super friendly and helpful staff. Welcomed us immediately. They were setting up projectors for Haifa vs Tel Aviv football match for the evening and we could see the crowds of locals, young and older, coming just as we were leaving. || Food was good, arrived fast. Atmosphere was great and there was great early 2000 music. Sadly the waiter was terrible, at the end also demanded a higher tip, complained, and vocally tried to force us to tip him (Extremely aggro). || A nice bar for local people to feel aboard. As a tourist I'll suggest you to go and enjoy the actual local restaurants. American /British menu with good dishes. The stuff are friendly but the service is a bit slow and clueless. The place is open almost 24/7 so a good fit for a night snack. Enjoy :) || Place near the mall. Great choice of draft beers . The bartender knows his stuff , if you ask from something not in the menu and he knows it? He will make it and it will be great. The prices are reasonable and the service is quick || Paddy's is the local Irish pub in Eilat ( Yes, Apparently every city has an Irish Pub 🤣). It's a great place to come have a beer or a late lunch close to the beach. The pub is located in the tourist district of Eilat. It's a walk away from the beach, the shopping mall and most of the board walk hotels. I highly recommend the steak!!! The fish and chips is good too but the streak is simply a winner. They also have a large selection of beers to choose from, along with a full bar and surprisingly decadent desserts 🎂. Great for families or just hanging out with friends to watch a came. || For a pub, this place serves very decent food from a wide menu. Even the pub favorites (burgers, fish&chips, etc.) are surprisingly good. Many kinds of beers available. Good place to have a dinner with kids. Why 4 points then? The one beer I was interested in was not available, and the waitress was very confused, both with prices and the orders. This may happen, though. || Very positive experience. The waiter was patient and explained to us the different food options. We ordered one of the menus that included a drink and a 50% discount on desserts.  The fish and chips dish  was delicious and tasty. The lemonade had too much sugar for my taste but could mix it with water.  We shared one of their desserts (the apple pie) which was served with a vanilla ice cream and whipped cream. Simply delicious.  You are served some peanuts and vegetables to eat while you wait for your dish/drink. || Good place to visit. Always tasty food and a lot of fresh beers. Not cheap but worth it. || The combination of rich bar and restaurant. Bar is rich from beers to cocktails and heavy drinks. The food is very good, I ordered the steak and it was soft and well served. The music was awesome and not too loud or low. The sitting area outside is pretty and has really nice breeze during evening. The service was great and welcoming. Definitely going to return for a second.

Love this place!! Food is delicious and the portions are great. The staff is awesome and very friendly,  especially Mike. Atmosphere and vibes are so chill and welcoming to everyone,  even great for a family night out. Music always on point and the drinks are mixed well. Definitely worth a visit! You wont be disappointed!!! || Thanks Denise, hope to see you again soon || The food is pretty bad. The wings are prepared in advance and have strong chicken after taste. The burger is dry.  I guess if you there for a drink and a show it can be nice. But avoid it as a dinner. || Awesome food, awesome location with great waterfront views, great sports bar! Eilat Bazar is a simple, small market located not far from the central hotel area of Eilat. It offers a basic shopping experience with a few stalls selling clothing, souvenirs, beach gear, and everyday items. The place is convenient if you happen to pass by, but it doesn't stand out compared to other shopping options in the city.  The variety of shops is limited, and many of the products feel repetitive. Prices are generally fair, but some items seemed overpriced for the quality. If you enjoy bargaining, you might be able to get a slightly better deal, but don’t expect huge discounts.  The atmosphere is calm, and the open space with its covered sections provides some shade, which is appreciated in Eilat’s hot weather. Still, it can feel quite empty at times, especially in the middle of the day when the heat is strongest.  Overall, Eilat Bazar is fine for a quick visit if you're nearby, but it’s not a "must-see" attraction. If you're looking for a wider range of shops and activities, other malls like Ice Mall or Mall Hayam offer a much better experience. Entry to water is made through carpets on definite corridors in order to prevent visitors from revolving the stones and corals, which is a nice idea. The floating deck isn't there as summer hasn't begun, the beach bar is run by a nice team, and Anna is always serving with her sweet smile and kindness. I've been visiting since 1994, this is a real pub, one of the last in Israel. Gaby is a one man show, always funny to chat with, and the carrots are legendary. The bar is owned by the bar tender and he has so much energy it's incredible. The music is ALWAYS INCREDIBLE  good old rock really really good songs. I always go here, no judgement just good people good beer and good vibes. Love the bar one of my favorites in the world. || Perfect spot to get away from the noise and crowds of Eilat. Classic small pub, had an excellent combination of great whiskey and tasty food delivered directly to my table from a nearby restaurant, thanks to a successful collaboration. || a lovely, tiny old-school pub. Gabi, serves great 60-70's music, booze and carrots. This place haven't changed a bit in the last 30 years, and it's got more character than any other pub in Eilat. || Easily the best Matcha I had in town. Thank you Gus for the amazing service and recommendations. || Best Bar in Eilat, Amazing owners and regular customers to create the perfect atmosphere for beer and blues! Quoting Greatful Dead: ONCE IN A WHILE YOU GET SHOWN THE LIGHT, IN THE STRANGEST OF PLACES IF YOU LOOK AT IT RIGHT. || this is the coolest bar in eilat. and I checked many || Oldest pub in Eilat! Great place to talk about Eilat with locals on a drink. Don’t miss the carrot, it’s a must!

A dance bar, I don't like them but there Ware nothing wrong with the place so 5 Stars. Has nothing to do with the Beatles 🙂 … || 100 $$ for 18 shots and a hooka  very understaffed.   extreamly understaffed . Though the waitress looked nice   feel bad for her .    Enjoy eilat. || Terrible music, has nothing to do with the titular beatles music wise, over priced, suffocating from all the smoke inside, i wouldn't go back on my own volition || They shouldn't call themselves "Beatles" when they play such terrible music || The drinks were overpriced, bar was mostly empty, the place is called Beatles but had nothing to do with them music-wise || I come here a  lot when i'm in the area. They have good drinks and staff. || Cool bar. Lots of dancing. A little pricey. || atmospheric, fun. want to go back there again!)) || Where the hell a person needs to pay 12 shekels for a tap water while dancing?! || Not suitable for everyone, loud with a lot of smoking inside.

A high end quality food restaurant, and a great brewery. I recommend the ceviche and carpaccio. Make sure to ask about the beer of the month, it was a great surprise! || Michael, thank you so much for the amazing review! We’re thrilled you enjoyed the ceviche, carpaccio and of course our Soof beer. Glad the Beer of the Month surprised you, we put a lot of love into it 😊 Hope to see you again soon! … || The food is meh. There's a vast selection in the menu which was immediately a red flag. The fried cauliflower was a bit burned. The bangers & mash was simply merguez/chorizo (nothing like bangers) on potato puree with demi-glace/BBQ sauce (instead of the traditional onion gravy). I ordered the beer tasting flight, and the beers are alright. As an IPA lover I didn't really like their IPA at all, but I did like the wheat beer and the Thaistory limited edition beer. Our friends mentioned a weird smell when walking into the restaurant. The music that was playing in the restaurant was nice. || Hello Amit, thanks for the review.  Regarding the IPA, it's a style that has a very personal taste; many IPA fans like ours, you probably didn't connect as much, and that's natural. We'll check the smell at the entrance immediately to make sure there's nothing unusual.  Thank you for your honesty, and we'll be happy to host you again for a better experience. || Went with the kids on a Saturday night. We ordered several starters (chicken wings, fried cauliflower, onion rings) and several entrees (Cesar salad, three types of pasta for the kids and a hamburger) as well as an assortment of beers. The beers were quite good and the starters went down well. The salad and pastas were mediocre, but that's to be expected of a place that specializes in beer and meat.  After all the entrees arrived and everyone was finished eating I asked our waiter if the hamburger would be making an appearance. They forgot about it. Well, that happens. I was told that it would be free and they'll immediately prepare it. I can live with that.  Twenty minutes later, it had still failed to make an appearance, although at least seven other burgers successfully made it out. They forgot it a second time! I asked for the bill... || Hi Gilad, Thank you very much for your review and for sharing with us what happened tonight.  We sincerely apologize that the burger did not arrive – tonight was unusually busy, especially since it was the eve of Tisha B’Av, and we are among the only restaurants in the city that were open. Unfortunately, the order was missed – and this is not something we take lightly.  We would be very happy to compensate you with two burgers and two appetizers at home – either sitting in with us or by delivery, whichever is convenient for you.  You are welcome to contact me personally at 054-6333903 or directly to the restaurant at 050-5595576 – and we will make sure that you receive the compensation you deserve.  Best regards, Natan – Owner Eilat Brewery 🍻 || You have to come here!!! Food is incredible, drinks also, and service efficient and so friendly.  We arrived at 8pm on Friday night (Shabbat), they initially said they didn’t have any tables until late but we’d been driving for hours through the desert and I asked once more and they tried their absolute best to fit us in to our relief. Everyone was so accommodating, food was incredible (my partner said the best steak he’s ever had) and the beef stew is unreal, cannot recommend this place enough. I didn’t have their beer this time but I’ve also had it before and it’s amazing. Don’t miss eating out here if you come to Eilat! || Thank you so much for your kind words and for sharing your experience 🙏 We’re really happy we could make you feel comfortable after such a long drive, and that you enjoyed the food and atmosphere. Your compliments to the team and the dishes truly warm our hearts ❤️  We look forward to welcoming you again on your next visit to Eilat 🍻  The Brewery Team || Lovely restaurant, great for family lunch and at night for a bar. Dishes are unique and different interesting vibe. We visit here when we leave Eilat, it’s on the way out of the city. Fresh dishes and beer brewery. The carpaccio is delicious, bolognese, hamburgers, actually everything was yummy. The lychee mojito was great.  We also had the best Crème brulee desert! || Highly recommend this place! The dishes are very tasty, large and not to expensive. We had the sausages and the filet. The place also server fresh tap beer made by them.  We didn't like the ice burger dish. But the cream brulee is great.  It is quite far take a cab. || Great design, great concept. The stuff is young local and very nice. The beers are good in average, some better than the others. Would recommend the IPA and the Porter. Unfortunately haven't had a chance to try the food but other's dishes looked very inviting. || Excellent food, excellent service, great atmosphere. Lidia the owner was so kind and it shows that they do everything with love. Highly recommend this place for anyone seeking a great meal. Portions are very generous and looks amazing. There are excellent beers on tap, all worth trying! || Set in a more industrial part of Eilat, the Brewery has great fois gras and fried cauliflower.  Unfortunately the beer isn't anything to write home about.  Great wait staff and if you choose to sit outside, enjoy the plants and intermittent spritz of water mist to cool you off. || Very good restaurant, testy food and big portions, I found several special dishes I didn’t see before. The place itself has interesting interior, the stuff was very friendly. The prices are pretty regular for Eilat, but here the price really corresponds to what you get. Strongly recommend 👍

My favourite bar in Eilat. If you want to feel home and experience the true local company- that is the place || We are a couple from Australia, we arrived in Eilat for the first time, we were looking for a nice pub to drink and experience an Israeli atmosphere. We arrived there without any intention, and good that it happened, the pub is magical, the atmosphere is amazing and warm, the owners are lovely, We have never encountered such a family pub that does not stop indulging. It is highly recommended that there is no doubt that in our next visit we are there!! || Quiet cozy place, excellent for having a few drinks with a date.  Not expensive. || A quiet and clean place with a good atmosphere, the owner Gekko, who generously pampers at prices that are affordable for everyone. || Simply magical! The bar has character, atmosphere and a simply amazing welcome from the owners, Jacko and Shoshi, who are a lovely and special couple. The place is a hidden gem that hosts mainly long-time Eilat residents, but not only. A fun place to sit and indulge in quality alcohol and snacks from the heart, have a conversation with the "regulars" and leave feeling the best there is! We really really enjoyed ourselves and we will definitely be back again and again! || An amazing place in a local and quiet and calm atmosphere. The perfect place to go out and start the week. Special design, authentic dishes and nibbled generously. We will come back again, my favorite in Eilat! || An old pub.. "Like the old days" is located in the Shalom Center in Eilat.. which is also from "the old days"... regular customers.. the owner is called Jaco.. like the parrot.. a mythical man with his amazing wife who is a cook.. Mazets flow non-stop on the tables.. in addition to the house flavors that are truly delicious.. drinks without nonsense.. the most original.. no cocktails from the north.. hello.. this is Eilat. There are no northerners in Eilat..only gnarled southern Eilatians..tanned..and young people of all ages..there is.."Bring me a whiskey..coke on the side" which is the best cocktail there is..what is called..mix me a vodka and Red Bull..two types of draft beer without getting involved..and a great atmosphere of the time tunnel..great place..everyone is welcome, even northerners who want a trip through the time tunnel..great people..prices are ridiculous..come on..tell Daniel he sent you..whoever comes..deserves it..and whoever doesn't come..deserves it too..the tradition must be maintained..love you guys..❤❤❤ || An Eilat bar experience with all the heart and soul. Drinks at reasonable prices, food served as an appetizer on the house, delicious, high-quality, inviting and enjoyable. A great corner to sip a glass of wine, beer or coffee.

Barama Lounge Buffet with delicious rotating food Always clean and with a good atmosphere || A 5-star hotel in every sense, rooms with spacious clean showers, towel service immediately as needed. Delicious meals with a huge selection, accompanied by a chef and waiter who immediately clears the table until your plate is bursting with content as you can. Going to the sea and the promenade, which is open until the night, even on weekends. Some of the shops are open. You can order tickets at the reception for all cultural activities in each hotel. It is recommended to take into account the rates for a jacuzzi of 90 NIS or a sauna of 380 NIS per person with advance booking. Option to choose the type of sauna. I recommend checking the ticket type when buying on the website, some of them VIP, including a lounge, a type of restaurant open from 9 am all day for a meal and alcoholic drinks, so entry is only for those over 16. A games room on site with a fee for each game. || Good quality lounge, the food is very tasty and varied. Large variety of cold alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks Very polite and helpful staff Highly recommended for those staying at the Royal Beach Hotel Eilat

Very nice restaurant on the beach ⛱️. The food is amazing.  All ingredients are fresh and tasty 😋 it's possible to sit on the balcony and have a sea view.  The beach is not propriet for children due to the fact that there is no easy way to go from veranda to beach.  The breakfast was super.  Israeli and  spuily breakfast are highly recommended.  Also, shrimps and kalamari were super delicious.  The service was excellent 👌 👏 || Service was great, location was incredible - right on the beach. We enjoyed snorkeling then grabbed dinner. Food was pretty good, but we were there for the views! Cocktail was delicious! || We came here for lunch and thoroughly enjoyed ourselves. I was worried about the heat but there was a lovely breeze blowing which made everything perfect. Service was friendly and helpful, food was good, prices reasonable and plenty of parking available. Recommended. || I love this place! They have awesome breakfasts and lots of choices for food and drinks! The staff is very helpful and nice! We stayed at the hotel located on top: Coral Beach Pearl -- I highly recommend going there since you get discount in both the bar and the diving place close by! || The setting is amazing... You sit literally next to the water including a beautiful view. The service was really good as well as the food. Plus they prepared it pretty fast. Perfect place for a relaxed evening with a nice cocktail in your hand! || Best place for breakfast in the area if u don't have hotel breakfast 😁 Not the cheapest but great view right on the water. Decent food also. Good service here. … || Ordered sweet potato French fries (which was not on the menu but the staff recommended) and fried shrimp! Both were super good and shrimp was freshly made! My boyfriend and I saw the beautiful sunset from the outside deck. The staff were so friendly and nice, spoke good English and made us feel very comfortable! Highly recommended to go there around sunset ;) || Great atmosphere sitting on the deck by the ocean. Food is ok, prices are above average. || Nice restaurant. Kind service. Burger and fish-n-chips were good. || The best food in Eilat!! The view is also amazing! 10/10!

place_name: מסעדת מיה ביץ - מסעדת בשרים כשרה

reviews_content: Has 3 small pool tables, 1 larger one that  doubles for small snooker and 1 proper snooker table || Thanks for the review || This place is the only place I found in the vicinity of my hotel that was dedicated to billiards. While the drinks and service was okay, the cues and table were comically horrific. The cues were bent, the tables had so many bumps that it felt more like playing Golf than Pool.  Pros: * Pretty accessable * Prices were fair * Service was okay * Has parking nearby  Cons: * Tables have bumps * Cues are bent * It felt stuffy inside.  Notes: * Smoking is allowed || Thanks for the review || Great billiard, dancy atmosphere, and such a lovely owner! Being the only publicly available billiard club in Eilat, we were a bit sceptical at first, but it certainly justified itself! Again, cannot express in words how much the owner of this place affects the experience positively - Truly recommended! Also, the prices are really fair 🙂 || Timor, thank you for the review and response. I was happy to host you and see that you really enjoyed the game and the atmosphere at my place, and most importantly, that you enjoyed each other. I would be happy to host you in the future. Guy Shishu || The place located in  a  basement. the equipment is old. and the service is fine.. However i Think the price is pretty expensive 55 nis / for hour or less Small Beer bottle / 27 nis || Good music good pools, with the best vibe in eilat. Thank you gay for hosting us || Thank you very much for the rating I was happy to host you and would like to host in the future || Best place in Eilat for chill out || Amit, thank you for the response and review. I was happy to host you and I would be happy to host you in the future. || Great music, new tables. || It was a pleasure to host and thank you for the rating. || Thanks for the review || We arrived as a group from Jerusalem for the second year. A pleasant, inviting and luxurious place Awesome karaoke rooms, snooker tables And a fun atmosphere || Meital, thank you for the review. It was a pleasure to host you and I will be happy to host you in the future. || Place on the face, garbage service, crooked tables, really didn't enjoy it

place_name: Dakota Grill Bar | דקוטה גריל בר
reviews_content: My recent visit to Dakota restaurant was quite underwhelming. The service was notably slow, with a 30-minute delay before our food arrived and no explanation or acknowledgment of the wait. When my meal finally did arrive, the steak was unfortunately not cooked to the specification I had requested, which was disappointing given the restaurant’s reputation.  Adding to the poor experience, my family had already finished their meals by the time mine arrived, and they had moved on to dessert while I was still trying to finish my main course — which made the entire dining experience feel disjointed and uncomfortable.  To make matters worse, we were served the wrong bottle of wine and only discovered the mistake after questioning it — something that should have been communicated upfront. The manager did offer a complimentary glass of wine and desserts as an apology, but I had already ordered a glass, and as I’m mindful of my diet, I tend to avoid desserts, so the gesture did little to resolve the disappointment.  For the price point, the overall experience fell far short of expectations. Neither I nor my family and friends will be returning. || We had dinner at the Dakota restaurant in Eilat, near the Dan Eilat Hotel. The service was perfect, the food was very tasty, the service was at a 5-star level, the atmosphere in the restaurant was pleasant, accompanied by a cool breeze from the sea. It was excellent!!!! We enjoyed it very much, the prices are affordable for every pocket. Highly recommend! You are welcome to stay at the restaurant and enjoy. || We were the whole family in Dakota and we enjoyed every moment! The food - 10 out of 10, every dish is fresh, well thought out and insanely delicious. The location is excellent, and the service is simply above and beyond - a smiling, courteous staff, who constantly checks that we are satisfied. We left blown away, satisfied and happy. We will absolutely be back again! || Excellent restaurant. Fine and high quality meat, courteous and exceptional service Excellent location || Excellent food, exceptional service! Highly recommended || If you want bad service and reasonable food this is the place for you || Excellent restaurant, excellent food, very tasty, very good atmosphere || A restaurant in a hotel but not a hotel ;-) || Spectacular Pesach at this wonderful hotel

I believe that the food here is the definition of mediocrity. It isn't  good, and it isn't bad. However, I did feel disappointed. We were a group of six. 3 different burgers tasted bland, schnitzel and chicken wings were also bland.. The only saving grace was the chips. Seriously, the chips was very good, but everything else was bland and not interesting. It is what it is... || Hi Ohad Amittai, we are sorry to hear that you did not experience the place according to your and our expectations. We would appreciate it if you could send us an email with your phone number, name and the subject of your inquiry and we will get back to you as soon as possible. || The restaurant is located in the park among small hills. It is nice to visit such a place and then sit on the grass. very tasty food inexpensive alcohol. Indian burger with sweet onion jam and pineapples!!! for example. food is prepared very quickly... and there were people in the hall. we are happy happy 🔥 || Thank you friend :) Come nack soon! || One the better restaurants in Eilat. Highly recommend anyone who visits the beautiful city of Eilat to come and sit down at this lovely, cozy restaurant right by the red sea. The prices are higher then average but the taste of the food justifies the price so it's fair value for money. In conclusion, everyone should come here and enjoy some high quality food and friendly staff. || Review from 2025: All the portions were delicious, but we waited for 5 out of 6 for 40 minutes, and for the last one another hour.  Review from 2018: The place is absolutely amazing! The service is cordial. The burgers came out fast. They were exactly like ordered (one medium, another medium well). The onion rings were were also great.  Moreover, as we entered with kids they were offered Dora coloring papers and crayons, so we could make our order in peace instead instead of begging for the menus from the little monsters. || Good local burger place The menu has many options, even vegans will find what to eat. The service may not have been perfect, but good enough. The place wasn't overcrowded, good A/C Overall a good experience-decent location, nice variety and good burgers || Best hamburger 🍔 place in Eilat with variety of meat 🥩 meals and hamburger with many toppings and side dishes. When you taste it it's better than pictures! Good choice to eat here and its not expensive . P.s You can also book for a VIP room for birthday celebration 🍾 or anniversary. || Great food. One of the best onion rings I ever had. The hamburger was great and the bacon (which wasn't crispy as promised) was good as well. Great service, although the kitchen is a bit slow. Cleaning could have been a bit better. || This place used to be my favourite restaurant in Eilat, for years. Last weekend we've had an extremely bad experience which practically almost every part of dining was the worst I've ever had,except for the food which stayed top notch. It started with the host lying on the phone when we called prior to ask for indoor availability, and was told there will be a table available in 1/2 hour. Arrived at that time to be told they don't have any tables available and won't have any for further 1/2 hour, so we sat outside, hoping to get drinks in the meantime and go in for our food reservation. Time goes by, and when we next asked if we could sit inside at the several table vacant, just to be told they can't and the indoor sitting is done for the day and we can stay sitted outside 😳🥵. Another problem was when the head of the restaurant came out (about 35-40 minutes after we ordered our food) apologising that food will take another 40 minutes 🤦🏻. At this point us, and all other tables around us were fuming with rage as you can't tell that after orders have been placed and we've already been there for about an hour. We didn't know what to do since it was very late in the evening and the kids were not at a state that we could move to a different restaurant. At no point we got offered with an apology nor some sort of compensation for theirs disgusting behaviour, and lack of transparency.  Unless I/you can have a reservation, don't even bother going in, this type of service is completely unacceptable!  To the Barbis team - please do your house cleaning, your food and chef deserve much better host, service professionals, and management to reflect your high standard dishes! || Best Dinner and Bar place in Eilat. Eating there for more than 10 years every time visiting the city. Wide range of meats and hamburgers. Special deals for divers all around the clock including first and main dishes, dessert and pint of local beer. Very kind staff and service. || A very nice burger place; the food is good, with a large variety of burgers and toppings to choose from. I recommend the antricot burger that also comes with fried onions. The service is nice, but seems to be a bit slow at times. Overall, we enjoyed it.

The Restaurant had just moved to a new location a week before. We had eaten there several years before and had been very pleased.  The best thing about the Hidaway is the food. I had a cheesburger.  It was cooked to perfection. It was one of the best I've had. I'm from Nebraska so eating meat is almost a religious experience. The gave me a generous portion of their famous Brown Sugar Dejon mustard dressing. It is out of this world. One of our guests had their signature steak with  the above dressing. He said it was the best steak he'd ever eaten.Our other guest a a prawn entree that was also excellent. When you are in Eilat, do yourself a favor and eat there. || One of the best restaurants in Israel! An amazing rich menu of seafood and steak dishes. It's very hard to choose your dish as all are absolutely delicious, good quality and with unique flavors. The dijon steak is my number one. The stuff are very friendly and welcoming, professional and know their work. Highly recommended to book a table in advance. Enjoy :) || LOVED IT!  Usually in restaurants, you can easily find some defects in the dishes, but honestly here - we couldn’t.  Everything was amazingly delicious!  The Mustard & Honey Steak is recommend, very good.  The gnocchi is heavenly as a starter. Everything was great!  Enjoy! || As mediocre as it gets. The food was decent, for the most part. The servers mean well, but they are clueless about their craft. The facilities aren't designed/maintained well, but nothing terrible. Also, it's unfortunate there are no ethical options on the menu. || The food was amazing, the staff were very attentive and gracious. I will definitely go back. Tomer, our waiter, was super. || Starters were ok, I expected a higher selection and quality.  I took a 300 gram entrecote steak which was simply not tasty.  I expected much more from the menu at this price. Service was average also. || We had a great time! First we ordered the filled mushrooms and the onion soup, delicious! These dishes are not for sharing, they are small, but they are not main dishes so its fine. For the main dishes we ordered the cordon blue and the spaghetti carbonara, they both did not last long, the portions are pretty big, and each dish could be easily shared. For desert we ordered the cheesecake, it was perfect, exactly what I craved for on my visit to Eilat.  All in all, an awesome experience, would recommend anyone visiting Eilat to go to Eddie's Hideaway. || We had a reservation for 22:00, they set us a table only at 22:30. Then we got the wine only after we finished our first dish.. Actually it was in the middle of the main curse. So.. The waiters quality isn't top notch. The food was pretty good. We really liked the Carpaccio and Ceviche. || We came here for an early dinner and found a lovely cosy but tastefully decorated restaurant with staff eager to please. We ordered mainly seafood and it was all delicious. This place is definitely upmarket with prices to match but in my opinion well worth the experience. || table for four, that we had reserved- when we arrived we been told that reservation is at the bar. after several minutes we had a table at the back of the restaurant, there are two dining areas. the atmosphere there were so so, about 4-5 tables in a big room, feeling is like sitting a place that being under development- sub par to the main dining area. we had ordered the ribeye steak - asked for medium all of us received medium well, some areas because of the thin cut were well done. service - took some time to get out order, following one of us that ordered sea food waited about 15-20 minutes more while the three of us received the stake. as a bonus he also waited about half an hour for a cocktail.

Nice restaurant close to the beach front in Eilat. The sardines are a nice option in the entrees. In the main I had a shrimp with artichoke. The fish looked nice as well. Overall good experience. || Have wanted to try Les Sardines for a long time.  We both loved everything! The service (Amay was absolutely wonderful), the menu, the food.  Definitely recommend and will be back! Thank you for a delicious meal! || Great food and amazing service by Ido. We’ve been in Israel 🇮🇱 for 2 weeks and this is the first restaurant that I can say was AMAZING !!! The food quality and the service. American 🇺🇸 standards here are really remarkable. Definitely recommended!!! || The place seems really luxurious in its setting, and the fish (the two main dishes we ordered) were pretty good. Mine was delicious, the plate with the small fish could have been a bit more crispy. || Very good food and service. The best: the ambient, the fish, the chocolate souffle. The worst (not that much though): the mood of our waiter and the ceviche (was expecting the Peruvian flavor and wasn't there) || I think Le Sardines is one of the best restaurants in Eilat. The cuisine here is excellent - they cook from the freshest products of very good quality. All the dishes, without exception, that we ordered were delicious. I especially recommend trying Sardines bread, grilled sardines and Tiramisu for dessert. The Sangria here is excellent too. The service was 6 out of 5. || Great service, all of the waiters and the staff members are extremely nice and agile. It makes the experience wonderful, along with really tasty fish! We found a coupon on Groupon, you should try to check if it still exists because it's really worth it. || The 1st courses were ok nothing special. Overall there was an atmosphere of pressure by the staff due them reminding us several times before the orders that the restaurant was fully double booked and that we only had a set time to be there, so it was rush rush. The main course were ok, and the creme boules was good but still the place was over priced. Also the lady at the entrance in charge of showing us to the table seemed to be very bitter, not even a small smile and the same can be said for the rest of the staff that also all had hard expressions maybe because of all the pressure to serve quickly. || The most outrageous experience when you ask for a small change in the dish and get a response ' we'll do it today but if you come tomorrow don't expect it' 🤔 No Sir, we won't be coming back ever. Food average.  Not great || Spectacular! Family meal went so well. Our sever was fantastic who helped us make the best decisions on the menu. The shrimps in curry, the seafood casserole, muscles, and other filets we all top notch. A can’t miss spot when visiting Eilat.

Food is amazing. Great selection of dairy food. This place is merhardrin kosher and also have vegan options.  Service is slow but staff is friendly. This is a very busy mall and I assume  other restaurants will be slow to handle all customers. It is good to sit down after all the shopping! || Staff incredibly slow. We've ordered only two drinks and it took them over 20 minutes. They forgot about straws so we asked for them... never got those straws. We had to go the counter and get them ourselves. Getting the bill was another good 10 minutes. Place was almost empty yet the staff was terribly slow. || We came 3 people,asked only for mentha and ginger tea, they brought to us very weak liquid ;-), with weak taste :-( but with high price, cant recomend it to others, sorry. || Delicious food, friendly staff.  A fun experience. || It changed from a cafe to a kitchen and this is delicious Badatz Beit Yosef and excellent service || A cesspool... the food is not tasty, for the first time in my life I ate a Caesar salad in which they put bread instead of chicken! The only thing worse is probably a garbage dump. I felt like I was humiliated when I tried the food there!!! || The food took a long time to arrive, we didn't get any glasses, the one we did get was missing, and some of the food wasn't ready. || My wife and I had breakfast Friday. Simply a pleasure, a selection of comfortable places, calm, clean and precise. Excellent service. Great fun || Disappointing service.

Unbelievably good experience! The food was inventive, unique, modern, and healthy. It came to us at lightning speed and with extremely kind, patient service. We honestly have nothing negative to say. This was one of our best ever dining experiences in Israel. Great food for kids and adults alike. || A beautiful final dinner in Eilat! I ordered the chicken salad — perfectly grilled chicken with sautéed onions and mushrooms, fresh greens, and bright flavors. The meal began with three small salads, each one crisp and delicious, and a side of fries that paired perfectly with their tasty sauces. Sat outdoors in the warm evening air, enjoying the quiet and great service. A perfect end to my trip! || The top rating found is well deserved: good food, friendly staff, quick service, fast WiFi and naturally fear pricing. The staff is patient and the cook let me take a picture to share. The cooking is done in front of you, so you know what they are doing. The space is small and busy, so you can't stay too long... But luckily nobody sends you away. We were on a family trip, we saw this place on-line that was in walking distance from the coach station and we walked. We all loved the people and the food style. || Probably my fave restaurant of the entire Israel trip. It is casual and friendly, I have staff coming out to chat with us and making recommendations. The sandwiches are a delight, I ordered something sinful of fried egg and meat. It was a real comfort food. There was multiple sauces to choose from to go with your sandwich. Also recommended with a sweet and strong aperitif to end the meal. Not sure if you can consider this something local but it is something which your stomach will like and a good local experience. || Large variety of options, yummy fries mix (sweet potato fries and regular fries), sabeech in sandwich or without was 100% and the cauliflower wasn’t bad. They have many sauces (majority are mayo based), except for a plum sauce which is sweet and tasty. Recommend! || This is the nicest place to dine in Eilat. Very solid beach with beautiful coral reefs. Was super quiet when I went practically empty so was added bonus. Perfect for snorkelling and just general sunbathing. Note, there are no lifeguard, only park rangers, but there is a space by the beach, in shallow water for poor swimmers Plant to bring some water shoes for the beach side. The reef is accessible via a long pier, and a large staircase leading easily to the water. Then it is the wonders of the red sea! || Although its one of the best places to see corals and fish in Eilat. The site could be a bit more developed. There are not many showers and only one dock to enter the water and relatively small place for swimming. With limited hours of operation and mediocre services this beautiful natural reserve should get an upgrade and the site could invest some of the entrance fee in improvments. || The reserve is well-maintained, clean, and organized, with food shops and equipment rental available. While the price is a bit high compared to free nearby spots, the underwater experience is spectacular- vibrant corals, colorful marine life, and plenty to see.  The area is very accessible, and safety is taken seriously with lifeguards on duty. Showers and restrooms are available and well-kept. Most seating areas are shaded with white canopies, which helps, though it can still get extremely hot in July and August.  Some downsides include ongoing renovations, which limit access to newer sections and make planning a snorkeling route a bit challenging. The designated swimming areas are small and enclosed, but beyond the bridge, there are vast open spaces where you can really explore and see a lot of beautiful marine life.  Overall, it’s more comfortable and enjoyable to snorkel in a well-supervised, maintained area than in unofficial sites, and the beautiful coral and abundant sea creatures make it well worth a visit.  * Pros: Clean and organized, lifeguards on duty, beautiful corals and marine life, showers and restrooms, accessible. * Cons: Entry fee is high compared to free alternatives, renovations limit some areas, enclosed swimming zones can feel small, it can get very hot in summer. || Snorkelling is ok. Every time we are in Eilat we go to this place, the best still and ever. nothing extraordinary || A vast nature reserve. The Eilat Mountains. This time Mount Yoash. The peak above, the eastern part of which is limited by power cables and on its summit are huge antennas. place_name: International Birding and Research Center Eilat
reviews_content: A local centre in Eilat (5km north of the city) focused on the studying and helping of migratory birds that pass from Eurasia to Africa (and back).  Open 24/7, free entrance. BUT! Call in advance to book a local, very experienced, guide that will take you around (mandatory). 35 shekel per person or 100 per family. || Thank you very much, we appreciate your kind words and very happy you enjoyed your visit. || Very peaceful trail, nice place to take family. The employees in the center were overwhelmingly friendly when we went. I also follow the center on FB and they post great bird photos. Really loved this place at sunset, will recommend to anyone traveling to Eilat. || The most important goal of this station is to ensure the well being and safe passage of birds migrating. Dedicated staff and volunteers. || The place looks well equipped with different habitats and nice hides but when we went in late September 2019 only one hide was accessible, the rest were closed off due to construction work and the place was deserted, with no staff around. We saw a few common waders during our visit one afternoon. || It is such an important station for migratory birds. We have not seen too many birds, since January is not the season for migration, but we still enjoyed the tranquility of the place,  took a nice stroll around and read the information that are displayed all over the place. I am looking forward to returning during migration season. || We had a privat guided tour - it was really great and we learned a lot about bird migration! || The entrance is free, and the place itself is tranquil, as it should be. You can see many locals going for a silent job in the morning, enjoying the view and the singing of birds that come to eat, or simply living here. It is not common to have a guided tour, but it will be worth it if you manage to book one. Also, you should bring or rent a binocular. || Internationally important. Hundreds of millions of birds visit the center in spring and autumn. Here they find resources to continue their migration. Come when the center is most active and come in the early morning to see the most. (This is no zoo; everything is wild and free.) || Very interesting and educational. They said it was the second largest bird sanctuary in the world . I was given a free lecture and tour around the sanctuary. I had an enjoyable couple of hours there. || Wetlands with many blinds to observe birds from. In the morning you can see the staff band migratory birds.

Clean bathrooms. Good bar service. The site is split into two different styles: - north side has a large wooden deck, suited for those who want to sit by the tables, close to the bar and restaurant; - south side is rustically styled, with straw shades (and also a large canvas tent during summertime). There is chair, table and sunbed rental service available at official prices on both sides. During summertime they also place a floating deck with sunbathing sofas and cushions for rent.  Entry to water is made through carpets on definite corridors in order to prevent visitors from revolving the stones and corals, which is a nice idea. Updated 10/23: entry to the water had been improved by them having removed the larger stones from under those carpets as it was quite impossible not to stumble on them, once we were never able to know where they were. Updated 3/25: The place is clean, beach service has improved. The floating deck isn't there as summer hasn't begun, the beach bar is run by a nice team, and Anna is always serving with her sweet smile and kindness. The only negative points are the lack of trash pots really close to the waterline, as the typical Israeli is spoiled and used to litter and then have someone around to clean and collect after them. Also dog owners are requested to have them leashed at the entrance and then leave them to circulate freely among the bathers, peeing on or even pooing at chairs, sunbeds and even on people's bags, towels and clothes, something unacceptable.  Updated 25/4/2025: The entrance to the water is downgraded as the carpets have been relocated over the rolling stones. I could not find the previous southern path which was comfortable and ready to walk in as the stones had been removed before the setting of the carpet. It's now very hard to walk on it, as the stones under the carpet make it uncomfortable and unbalancing for those to walk in the path. The beach also still lacks trashcans close to the waterline, as the existing ones are located about 8-10 meters from it; I've seen many pieces of paper, plastic cups and popsicle wrap on the sand. Anyway it's still the best beach in Eilat. || HHEY MOSHE  VEY MOSHE THANK YOU SO MUCH FOR YOUR COMMENT LOOKING FORWARD TO SEE YOU SOON AT THE BEACH || Decent beach with a nice relaxed atmosphere. The area of the beach is also very small and no free shade on the sand. There are no changing rooms, so we had to change in the toilets which is very strange for a beach. Restaurant is home for frog fish and crocodile fish. || We had a great experience here, the instructors were professional and nice, and helped us all have a great time.
