We came 5 mins after 12pm (and tickets are valid also tomorrow from the morning only! - as explained on the cash desk); spent some half day here late March; sea temperature fresh but still acceptable; not so crowded today; beach service collect beach chairs regularly; easy to find place and take chairs, we enjoy hot and cold sweets with coffee and fresh Mint lemonade. Really tasty; recommended; next time I repeat. || Amazing ! Such an incredible experience ! Staff are also amazing ! Estelle was great called me told me best times to come ! Mayaan was so welcoming and beautiful and IRa was amazing guide ! She was brilliant and supported me on my first dive ! Dolphins are everywhere ❤️❤️ || For the standard entrance fee you can swim at the beach and spend some time on the pier to film and shoot the dolphins (pier closes at 5 pm). Then you have a bar restaurant upstairs in a wonderful place (forbidden under 18 years old). From this place you still can see the dolphins, enjoy the sun and even stay until 11 pm! || Great place. We did snorkeling with the dolphins, it was great to see them in their natural habitat. Our instructor was a very nice and professional lady that took care of everyone’s comfort and made sure everyone is safe and have an amazing time. I was really scared of the depth but thanks to her I could overcome my fear and enjoy the moment. I can’t thank her enough. It’s a place one of a kind and people there are very welcoming. I highly recommend, worth every penny. || I had a great expirience to dive with dolphins..its something amazing..also the place its like heaven..its diferent than other places that i saw in Israel. The relaxing pools inside its something special too. I recommand everyone to visit. || Wonderful location, really worth the detour even though it's located on the other side of Eilat. There's also a bar inside where you can order drinks and bites. Service was great and the food was delicious. A big 5! || Very clean beach and not too crowded. Dolphins seem happy and free. Very good diving guides, and great service. They even offered us a refund for  for one who couldn't make it on time, because they had another person who was interested to dive instead. || Very beautiful dolphin reef. Tourist attraction. We saw 3 dolphins. The food here was delicious, totally recommend! There are also student fares for entry. || Dolphin Reef in Eilat is a natural habitat of Dolphins. We can observe the dolphins 🐬 from the floating bridge provided. The dolphins are very playful and you are allowed to touch them if you wish to.  The security staff watches over the dolphins as well as feeds them.Some snorkeling facility is also there. We visited long back. The Dolphin Reef is open from Monday to Saturday.  Timings: 9 am to 5 pm. We spent some time observing the dolphins.  There is an entry fee. || The most wonderful beach in Eilat. It’s like a completely different world everything beautiful and clean and pleasant. The food at the beach restaurant is great. And to watch the dolphins is certainly a bonus 🐬 …

After a week with 3 teenagers practicing for their diving certifications and diving myself I can say that Manta is a professional and kind place. Ohad, Shir, Sa Bi and Adi were all very professional guiding groups of various sizes, ages and experience. Special thank you to Noa, the diving instructor for the patience with 3 teenagers and teaching them to love the reef and diving. Last but not least, the patient administrative staff in the counters, filling the tanks and especially Zohar who supported us with health enquiries even before our arrival, are not less important for a great experience. || Incredible diving center! Super organized, friendly, and efficient. Stayed for 3 days at hotel connected and dove multiple times every day, could not have been a better experience and my guide Shir was amazing! || Although I’ve been diving here for many years I must say this dive center became the worse in Eilat- rental equipment is falling apart while prices are going up, and service is just terrible. Today we came in with my husband who holds an international diving insurance -we’ve been diving in multiple countries with it, including Israel. Yet, they made a problem out of it and asked him to purchase an Israeli insurance (he is not Israeli) just for a 1 day of diving at their center. We signed up for 2 guided dives (they offered us a deal for two, we initially we were planning to just dive together). So after we got back from the first dive, we were suddenly told that our second dive has been cancelled because they need the instructor for the private dive, on which I asked why can’t another instructor do the private one, apparently there was only 1 instructor in their dive center for the day. We were told to wait for 3 hours for the next dive, which we didn’t of course. In a nutshell- all they see is money. And they do nothing that would be of value for the amount they are charging. Don’t go there and save yourself the ruined experience. || Thank you so much to the amazing instructor Boas, who was super patient and encouraging during my first dive of 40 minutes. And giving me a great diving experience and the wish to pass the diving classes in the same diving centre! || An overall great diving center. Spent Friday and Saturday diving through them. Very well organized, professional and patient staff. I have been diving in Eilat for 8 years and this was my first time at Manta and I was very impressed. I never saw a diving center in Eilat that was so well organized with such good staff. They get a 10/10 from me 👏 👏 👏 👏 👏 || One of the best diving club. Friendly staff (especially chapur and natasha) beautiful place, clean, good equipments and many activities. The price is not the cheapest especially during holidays such as the summer. But during other seasons it's the best price for these qualities. THE BEST!! || Thank you very much Enoch || Manta was amazing!!!  We had a few glitches with our day (NO FAULT of Manta) and they went above and beyond to come to a quick, easy, and amazing solution.  We had a great day of diving and then snorkeling with the kids.  They really wanted us all to have a great day and enjoy our time!!!  Thanks for a great day!! || thank you Susanna for taking the time to write this kind words. we are very happy to know you had a good time with us and hope to see you again! || I had an absolutely brilliant time diving with Manta!  I dived there on 20/08/22, being a Saturday and in the middle of school holidays the place was buzzing with people but I did not feel like it was packed to the point that we had to wait ages for stuff or hard to get staff attention.  I originally booked three dives but due to an error in my order it only came up on the system that I booked the one dive. Nevertheless the staff made it their mission to make sure I got on to three dives that day and I did (For a diving centre this size, this level of personal attention is outstanding).  Each dive I did was with a different guide and they were all brilliant, I received helpful advice in regards to buoyancy and they made sure that I wasnt carrying redundant weight.  A big shout out to my first dive at kaza'a, one of the best group of dive buddies and guide I have ever been with in my years of diving.  Yes this is a big diving centre (largest in the middle east according to their website) and it will feel as such when you first walk in, in the morning but don't let that dissuade you, they welcome everyone with a smile and they give everyone the time they need/deserve.  Some things to note, they do seem to be rather strict with having a logged dive in the past six months so make sure to have a way to prove it with you either logbook or dive computer etc... so as not to impede your day. Their rental equipment is in immaculate condition and above all there is no added cost for nitrox!  I look forward to diving with Manta when I am next in eilat (hopefully in the near future)! || Thank you very much Motti. We hope to see you again soon || Best Dive club !! Great service at the counter and very professional crew of instructors for all levels-recommended for Dive courses and also instructed dives. They have a House Reef and a couple of more dive sites nearby. || Thank you very much Ran. Much appreciated. We hope to see you again soon. || Very friendly, highly professional, instructors are in highest level and the equipment is very good. Very high levels of safety above and under the water. Highly recommended || Thank you Sport Clinic, much appreciated. We hope to see you soon again.

Dreadful experience and huge disappointment. Inconsiderate service at best, fraudulent at worst. There was a disgustingly overwhelming chemical fragrance throughout the hotel, including the dining room. They actually take pride in their toxic indoor air pollution and they call it their "signature scent", from which we all suffered adverse health. Rooms with sea views were disappointing, as the sea view was limited and most of the view was to the noisy tennis courts. Mouldy doors and poor maintenance. Swimming pool was unheated and there was no sauna or hot tub available. It was slso very much overpriced for what was on offer. The only nice thing was the fact that it was on the beach and you don't have to cross the road to get to the beach. We left after one night to the nearby Isrotel Yam Suf, across the road, which was a much better (and less expensive) hotel, with stunning sea and mountain views, great service and elegant atmosphere. You can also breathe the lovely sea breeze without the sickening stink of synthetic fragrances around you. || A charming and luxurious hotel with a pool and a nearby beach. You have to take into account that it is not in the center, for us this was an advantage. Good breakfast, excellent service, the rooms are large and very luxurious, we loved it. … || Outstanding Service and Great Value Our experience at the hotel exceeded all expectations. The staff were incredibly kind and helpful, especially Alon and Slava at the front desk who went above and beyond to make our stay enjoyable.  The breakfast was generous and varied, with a wide selection of fresh and tasty options, including freshly squeezed juices and every kind of coffee you could want.  The hotel also offers direct access to a beach with complimentary kayaking and surfing equipment, which was a fantastic bonus.  While it’s not the most luxurious hotel, it’s clean, located in a fun and lively area, and above all – the service is truly exceptional.  Highly recommended! || This is our 4th stay, we enjoy it immensely. One of the only hotels in Eilat that is really on the beach|Great see view, Attentive staff|Amazing breakfast right near the beach || An Honest Review After 15 Years – This Will Definitely Be My Last Time! After 15 years of coming to this hotel every year, this time will be my very last visit. I booked a Shangri-La Villa, which is supposed to be the hotel’s VIP accommodation — but everything inside is broken and falling apart. There are ants in the room, the light switches don’t work, the electric curtains have been dead for years, and all the furniture is old and crumbling. The TV looks like it’s from before the state was founded, the shower pressure is extremely weak, and the dining room food is worse than an army base cafeteria. And all of this costs 2,500₪ per night — on a weekday, not even during a holiday! An absolute disgrace and shame. ‏ I have to say that the service from the stuff is very good, but it has nothing to do with the poor condition of the accommodations! || The hotel itself is remote, quite and feels new for the most part. The staff is nice and accommodating. Be advised, this hotel is far from the city, a 10 minute drive by car at least. This isnt a negative, just something to look out for. || I come for a 2 days holiday with my son . |I pay 1300€ for 2 nights. ||In our room, we find cockroach|They came to pick up the dirty towels, but they never left new one. ||The sun bed mattresses was so dirty that it was disgusting to lay … || For me it ithe best hotel in Eilat, on the beach direct access to snorkel and view beautiful fishes near the coralt reserve, sea surfing, excellent breakfast, good service and not crouded. Recommended! || Great location, excellent service. Very good breakfast. Room could use some renovation. || We’ve just completed a perfect family vacation at the reef hotel in eilat. This hotel is how hotels should be. Perfect location. Great breakfast. But the crown of this hotel is the staff ! Always ahead of what you need and want. Always with a smile and with a speedy service. It starts with the receptionists and all the way to the cleaning staff. Everything is pleasant and clean. Highly recommended!!!

place_name: Tortuga Freedivers - בית הספר לצלילה חופשית באילת (טורטוגה פרידייברס)
reviews_content: Strongly recommend to anyone who loves challenges. I got to know myself better and to enjoy the moment. I’m simply obsessed with this discipline! I owe this to Daniel! Couldn’t have asked for a better instructor! Thank you for being clear, calm and patient at all times. Definitely coming back to finish the Wave 2. || I found Daniel by mistake; A different instructor gave me his number since his course schedule did not fit my needs. It was the best mistake I made. I enjoyed the course very much, Daniel has so much patients which is the secret key for this type of course, it takes time to learn how to equalize, and how to position your body in the 3 dimension surrounding of the ocean, and Daniel is the perfect instructor to teach it. I was deeply impressed from his professionalism and calmness. My next course will definitely be with Daniel. || Daniel was super professional and I learned a lot and loved every minute! I did the wave 1 course, he speaks English so this can be done in English or Hebrew, I can dive without tanks to depths I never thought possible! Thank you! || Daniel is a very patient and caring instructor. I enjoyed the course and felt safe in his hands. I felt he was very knowledgeable and I plan to dive with Daniel in the future. I can strongly recommend him. || Dani was very professional and extremely patient. I would highly recommend Dani to anyone looking to experience the magic of free diving Plan on coming back soon || We took the first course and it was an unforgettable experience. A very in-depth course rich in theory and knowledge. Daniel, an amazing instructor, gave us a sense of confidence and extensive knowledge about our abilities to control our bodies. || Daniel, the most famous and coolest instructor in the universe! My cousin and I just finished a W1 freediving course and we are both in a crazy high, the professional and human way in which Daniel conveyed the content to us helped us apply and understand the world of freediving in the most appropriate way for us. Freediving requires a lot of calm and a safe environment, so Daniel is the perfect guy for it! Thank you very much for everything! || I did a basic freediving course with Daniel and it was simply excellent, Daniel works from the basics and in a serious and professional manner, guiding us throughout the course with lots of practice and repetition according to our progress. Daniel, with a smile and a good mood, gave us an excellent, professional and experiential course! Highly recommend!! He also took care of pampering us and practicing an ice bath at a low cost, I also recommend this in the heat (or cold) :) || Wow, a big one. A pleasant, relaxing atmosphere and most importantly, safe, Dani is a serious, professional, honest, decent, dedicated and gives his full attention. A year ago I did the Wave 1 course and this week the second wave. Have fun, Dani, you are a walking legend, thank you very much for everything. And also for all the training days that you give in addition to the courses. I appreciate you very much. Thank you very much, I will always come back for more diving days in the Red and Blue Seas || My personal experience was simply wow, a huge one!! A talented, kind and pleasant person who knows how to convey knowledge in an excellent way and makes the experience pleasant and fun!! Highly recommended because in my opinion the guide is what makes all the difference and he is an excellent guide!!!

place_name: לעוף על המים ספורט ימי באילת FLY ON WATER - WATER SPORTS
reviews_content: What a great time out on the beautiful Red Sea. The wind, the sun, and the relaxing fun made a perfect morning. Captain Johnathan is so friendly and helpful.  I went wakeboarding and had such a great time.  There is also a giant air seat available where you and your friends can get pulled at fast speeds.  For those wanting to just swim, snorkel and watch dolphins, this can be arranged. Often the dolphins come very close. The snorkeling is fantastic in this area. Reefs are becoming more difficult to find in the world, However, in the Gulf of Eilat the country of Israel is doing very good work to conserve the undersea world. Don't miss out. If you are going to be visiting Eilat Contact "Fly On Water" right away. || Excellent value for money. Did the extreme package (inflatables, snorkeling, Dolphins). Was actually surprised how close we got to the dolphins! Better value than any Banana boat etc...  The "Captain" was charming and good natured and tried hard to accomedate our specific requests.  The place is a little difficult to find, so make sure you look at the map before you go. || We had a wonderful trip with Yonatan, snorkeling, seeing dolphins and water sports. Yonatan was amazing, so relaxed and accommodating, encouraging everyone. We enjoyed every minute! Super worthwhile, and highly recommended! || Incredible activity! The Red Sea is just uniquely beautiful. Yonatan goes all out to make sure all ages have a meaningful and thrilling time on the water. Very well worth it || Our family had so much fun! We saw dolphins jumping and we waved to 4 different foreign borders. Yonatan, our guide, was a pleasure. Highly recommended! || Sooo much fun! Yonatan is great captain and we enjoyed his trip. Small boat/Small group. The tube ride in the sea was great and he adjusted the speed for some who wanted to fast and others who wanted to go less fast. || We had the best time with yonatan, definitely recommended || Yonatan was so accommodating and nice! It was so fun!! We felt safe while having a great time! || Very professional, we had much pleasure! || Amazing Super cool dude Yonathan Beautiful experience I will never forget

It was such a great experience!!! We all had so much fun, everything went smoothly- left on time,  the skipper was very professional, made sure to explain us everything, put great music and did everything for all us to feel comfortable and enjoy, we even went to see the dolphins || Thanks Tal!! What a pleasure to read a comment like this.  You are amazing Thank you very much🩷 … || It was such a great experience nice and friendly owner good vibes couldn’t really see the dolphins but apart from that we had a really good time || Thank You Very Much Tova || Haim was fun as well as responsible and everyone had the best time- kids and adults. His boat and water equipment were clean and great and aside from the extreme stuff, we saw dolphins and got to swim in the amazing Red Sea. This has been a highlight of our holiday. || Thank you very much Ayelet!  So happy you all enjoyed and hoping to see you all again soon || We had very nice experience they were very accommodating and we would definitely go back and definitely recommend || Thank you so much! Visiting for your next visit to Eilat 🙏🏻👍🏻 … || This was so fun!! The entire experience was great! Great communication and Haim was a great captain! Don't miss this if you are in Eilat! Definitely worth it!! || Thank you very much Danna! Was a pleasure having you guys onboard with us! || Perfect we recommend for all || Thank you very much 🚤🙏🏻 … || We went here and it was very fun for all of us. Everyone is really nice. It was a great experience! || Thank you very much Sharon! You are a lovely family and it was our pleasure to be part of your vacation See you next vacation. || Wonderful people to work with. Very sensitive to one child who was scared. Highly recommend || Thank you very much Mimi! Hope to see you all again soon || Super fun experience with really nice people. Strongly recommend! || Glad to hear that! Thank you very much and hope to see you guys again soon || This was a fun experience for my teen daughters. || Thank you very much Emilia What fun we had with you Thank you very much for choosing us See you next vacation

It was a great, welcoming place to stay. We stayed 30 people on the Deck area, we put lots of tents and had an enjoyable multi-night stay. The toilets were about clean, in comparison to other places I've stayed at. The part I didn't really like, is the shower - it was at least 300m away from the Deck, which is pretty far away after a shower.  But at all, a very great place to stay at if you wanna have a stay in the mountains of Eilat, just a few blocks away from the non-tax city. || The place has pretty comfortable mattresses and  lot's of hot water. Good for one night of sleep. || What a beautiful and peaceful place, we had the pleasure of meeting Beni and his wife. Thank you || A very pretty spot on the outskirts of Eilat. I was supplying beer to a wedding. || Toilets and shower cabins are not clean and in very unmaintained condition || We stayed in the rooms and enjoyed it very much. A pleasant and well-kept place, an excellent location in the mountains for those who want to stay close to Eilat but still in an atmosphere of nature and quiet. || The place is cozy, inviting, very well-maintained. There are excellent showers with excellent water, A fully equipped kitchen with stoves, work tables and refrigerators. The toilets are clean, there is a building inside which you can eat and get organized comfortably, Our private tents were inside a large tent with a carpet so it is much more pleasant to sleep inside. Excellent place!! Highly recommended!!! || Excellent campsite 5 minutes from Eilat. Lots of quiet corners. Very suitable for families. My son is available and helps with everything. Recommended. In the summer it is probably too hot for camping. During Passover it was ideal. || The place is very low level. Shower without privacy, in sight of sound. The sleeping tent is actually a tent.. No protection from the rain or animals.. Completely open from both sides.. There was no lighting in the bathroom.. In short, do not recommend

Really nice after a rich dinner at your Hotel. Relax and enjoy. || Very beautiful, good restaurants, yachts for walks. || Lovely. Especially the promenade where you are right on the sea. The stairs and wooden deck and everything is amazing and romantic.... It's a shame I didn't take a close-up photo of the benches facing the sea || Nice place at the end. || Excellent sports facilities, cold water station next door. In front of the sea. Fun to train there! || A large, elegant place, full of luxurious and high-quality equipment for productions of all kinds, a great place to visit. || An open amphitheater on Herods Beach. Suitable for holding events, especially chuppahs. || One of the most beautiful and clean beaches in Eilat! Usually not many people.. || Please rename it "Amphitheater." It looks so ridiculous.

Butiful concert place || Instead of building something new, instead of demolishing.. The old club has undergone renovations... An open gallery downstairs, all "Ofek-Nevo".. And I suggest you make the effort to come here... The exhibition is accompanied by a story by "Mirel'a Harel"... Who is also his grandmother, his teacher and received a gift from God... Brought Nevo to the "heights" to "break the glass ceiling" And received from me the title of "angel". We try || Clean, tidy, inviting, pleasant. There is accessible parking. Toilets || A small, well-maintained conference hall. This is the real place! Not where it appears on Weez (it appears in the Red Sea Mall...) || Nice place for children's shows, it's just a shame there's no cafe for parents || The inauguration of my beloved hall after renovation with the unforgettable songs of Abba Nachcha, the late || We arrived at the place as part of an art tour by the Eilat Municipality, which deserves all the credit for all the beautiful and fascinating free tours. At the place we heard the story of the wonderful artist Apek Nevo, we watched his exhibition displayed there, beautiful, interesting and fascinating. Highly recommend coming to the exhibition and hearing the artist's story || A lovely place, beautifully renovated and a great staff. ***Little tip*** Although the front row is reserved for people with disabilities, you should think about a location for wheelchairs in front of the stage and not on the side.👩‍🦽 May we all have a happy, sweet and accessible New Year.🍎🍯🌺😊🙏 || Philip Murray's house has an interesting history. Go to Google. I recently attended two shows at the Friends Eilat club. Curious to know how many seats there are there. Thanks. Good acoustics. Everything is tastefully renovated. The club manager, Mr. Gur, is an attentive person and an excellent manager. || I was at my son's graduation party, Philip Murray House. The last time I was there was a long time ago. I was really pleasantly surprised. The place has been renovated, looks good, most importantly all the chairs have been replaced, simply comfortable. I sat for more than two hours, very comfortable. A great place for plays, shows, and experiences. Plenty of parking even when it's really busy. A beautiful place.

Just fun! The prices aren't the cheapest, but that's how it is in Eilat. The atmosphere was fun and the music was very good. The local bands were also really good and lifted the festival and the atmosphere. Highly recommended. Basically in any weather || We passed by there at noon when the place was still closed. Unfortunately we didn't see the place in the evening - but judging by the size and the area, it looked like fire Too bad we missed it || Exceptional organization! The beer selection is larger than I thought and the food is really excellent! || The most fun beer festival there is. An event experience. Performances, music and good food. Recommended 🔥🔥🔥 … || Full of specialty beers, free shows, and a fun atmosphere! Highly recommended! || One of the best and most fun projects in Eilat, led by Sagi and his entire team. Keep it up 🙏 … || Main performance very late! Almost 2240. Everything is very expensive. || All honor to the Ayelet Municipality, the bands, and everyone who took part in this amazing event! || The best beer festival in Israel returns to the Eilat promenade

Musical Fountain In Eilat very nice and free attraction at night time for all family, especially for kids. Every show is 15 minutes of long and it's beginning at 20:30. It's show of water with led lights around and popular music in Hebrew and English. It's nice entertainment in the area. Anyway if you in Eilat it's a good place to visit and see the musical fountain by yourself, enjoy. || A lovely experience.  It only lasts about 15 minutes,  but it's free. Good music too! || Lights were nice, but music did the job. Come 10 min early and sit on the left corner (looking form the street) There's nothing better to do in eliat after its gets dark. Show last 15 min || Nice musical and lights spectacle. Unexpected in a city where water is so important for survival. I hope the water is reused. It's nice for tourism, because important cities in Europe has one of these. Please put a sign with the schedule of the fountain. It starts at 20:30 and lasts 15 min. || Started with a great vibe of popular music in English and then moved to old Hebrew popular songs. Really missing some classical music in my taste and can use less Hebrew songs. The fountain bearly reacts to the songs (if at all). Still was nice to sit in the air and hear some music in the middle of the town 😬 … || Sprinklers turn into a light and music show a few evenings every week. Free and great for families! || Very nice experience for the kids, the music is nice for the most parts, the sprinklers are pretty coordinated with the music, for those of you that saw these acts in Europe or the US won't be as impressed. But overall very nice place to hand out, the kids were having a great time watching the show, taking pictures with the stone fish or just running around in the grass || Very underwhelming. Lasts about 30 minutes and it’s a mix of American top 40 and Israeli music. The lights were just kind of on....the fountains just kind of went up and down....if you’re in the neighbourhood and need somewhere to sit than I’d say go. But no need to go out of your way. || Amazing show! BUT - the hours on Google ARE NOT RIGHT! (And can't be changed) it's 2 shows (same one, twice), one at 8:30pm and one at 9:30pm in an amazing and big parking next to the Eilat museum. Every show is about 20 minutes, starting with movie themes, international hits and then some if the Israeli classics. Lots of space to sit (grass and "stairs") and it's wheelchair eccessible.it's 5 mins walk from the "Hayam" shopping center.dont miss it! || The fountain and music is amazing! I just wish that people will be more considerate of others and not go and stand right at the front to take pictures. That means no one who is sitting on the seats can take a clear photo. Those people in the front are in all of the photos.

Went to check out a game between the home team Hapoel Eilat and their visitors Hapoel Jerusalem. While Eilat didn't play well in the game itself, the stadium was very nice. Small but modern. || my home school, where my home team plays, great amazing vibe, very recommended || Nice little basketball gym with ample parking and air conditioning inside. || Small arena but nice experience watching a game || Nice place for sport. || Anyone who loves basketball is a perfect place for them. Interesting games for sports lovers. || It's fun to be part of the sports activity in Eilat!!! || I was never a big basketball fan...but when 101 Experiences suggested going to cheer on the local team, I jumped at the idea. Years have passed and my tastes in many areas have changed...so just know that watching a game up close is worth it, it's interesting and recommended. Hapoel Eilat has a great team and fans...unfortunately we lost, but it was great.

Best club in eilat 100% || Very loud (even for parties) , the sound manager does a terrible job Every party feels exactly the same as the other very expensive || One of the things that makes a club a good club in my opinion is the security and order staff. The place has a professional staff, eyes and it's just fun to know that you can dance and change calmly and that someone is watching over you. We had when Skazi was a guest - the guy is crazy, it's a shame he came up so late (about 2:15) The DJ before him was weak - they don't play a line of every song all evening. || I paid 100 NIS for entry, which included a drink. Add a glass and I paid 68 NIS. Some come with partners and they pay double. So what did we get? +\-300 NIS for such a fun atmosphere with half-Arsist, half-English music? What's more, the bartenders were pampered and had good service. Beyond that, I think it's very expensive! Good luck. || Crowded place, too many people are allowed in. Just another disappointing club. There is no paper in the toilets and the doors don't close... crazy. What is there is security at every corner, that's a plus. That's probably the only thing you pay for at the entrance. || They do combos on advance tickets, charge you for the advance ticket as well, then at the entrance they say you don't have a ticket / the ticket was not approved and then demand more money from you (double payment), after a few days you will see a charge on your credit card + the charge at the entrance, be careful like hell!! You know what? It would be worth the money anyway: Their screen that is supposed to create an atmosphere is also broken, There is also no place to dance, they pushed bars and tables everywhere, Not to mention the sound... In short, save yourself || It was really fun! A mini Tomorrowland atmosphere with all the lights and screen effects, great music. Enjoyed || Entrance 100 NIS glass 68 NIS atmosphere completely lukewarm Leave nonsense not worth the effort || Expensive and bad. Plus, if you're not a slob, you're going to be lonely there, everyone is a slob. If that's not enough, the guy who sold us the tickets told us there wouldn't be any slobs this week, don't fall for it.

Busy popular place.  Manager very gracious and quick to find us a comfortable spot.  Great music playing and open space to see the water view no matter where  you’re seated.  Our server could have been a bit more attentive but he looked quite young and I will just assume it’s a lack of experience.  But he was always kind and polite and ready to help when we got his attention.  Highly recommend this place. Fun, great food, even kid friendly || If anyone tells you that there are no good places to eat out in Israel, just come to the Ninth Beach in Eilat. The food is delicious, the service exceeds expectations, and the atmosphere has its own vibe. Am here every time when visiting Eilat. || A bar on the beach next to the mall in Eilat. reviews_content: Highly recommended from experience! A store with a large selection of toys and gifts and most importantly with a warm and caring attitude towards customers. We received quality, professional and fast service. Cheers! || Amazing place, excellent prices

After reading very mixed reviews, we were a bit nervous to come but we were really surprised. Everything was great. We there during a very busy holiday and it wasn’t crowded at all. Full but not crowded. One thing you really notice is how on top of things the staff was - about safety, having everything run smoothly. They did a really great job which just makes for a fun day. My little one LOVED the play area and the big ones did all the slides over and over. Definitely look for discounts - there’s tons available and it makes it much more reasonable. All in all a great day! || The park is really awesome. there are lots of slides. I think 10 slides. there is a pool wave and kids area. The staff is very nice and the place is very organized and clean. there is plenty of places to rest with shade. Food court was also very nice, above standards of such places.  The only downside was that we visited in August with 38 c outside and even in the water it was hot. the pool was warm. the slides where warm. you couldnt cool down in any way except a visit in the well air conditioned toilets :) || The new water park is lots of fun for kids and adults a like. Well planned and top quality facilities. The water felt clean, and you enjoy Negev desert vista on the slides  top floor  towers.  We were on a very hot day, and some desert breeze was felt. The youngester enjoyed the extreme slides.  I gave 4/5 stars due orientation issue.  No map of the park, and some marking was missing || I came to visit, me and my boyfriend, we had an amazing time. The park itself and the bathrooms are super clean. There are a lot of slides, barely any lines, it was quick and so much fun! There were slide that we were able to do together! There are many things to do in the park beside the slides. Everything  was safe, easy, and fun. The staff is always smiling and willing to help. It was a great day and we will definitely be back soon! || Great variety of slides, includin a play area for younger kids, kind helpful staff. || Enjoyed, not much of lines and good facilities. Not too many slides but can fill well the day || Nice for the kids. We went in May so it wasn't crowded. Wouldn't recommend going during summer vacation. The food is barely eatable (bring your own). Overall good experience. || Thank you very much for the response. || The park is ok,  and a family can easily spend a day there. However the working hours are quite short, and at 3:30 pm Al the facilities are closing, and the visitors almost forced out by the guards. Very unpleasant situation... || We had a great time, clean place, great staff || Ty for this trip , I realy like this water land! It’s nice!👌 …

this place is a scam. do not buy tickets! there are only 5 slides. 2 out of those you just get stuck and you have to push with your hands. a complete joke. there are NO swimming pools (they are open only to the hotel guests). there are 3 nice slides but it isnt worth the money. The place is small. If it cost 40ils it would have been ok. it makes sense only if you stay at the hotel. || 1. Get discounted tickets 2. Arrive early, before opening time for parking and rides without lines 3. Arrive with zero to low expectations, and expect 2-3 working slides at most. 4. Find the park pool 5. Ride as many times possible during the first 2 hours 6. Spend as much time possible in the pool to extend the experience 7. Enjoy || Smaller place then the others, still very nice and has everything is needed for a nice half/full day of a water park || Very nice water park with slides for all ages. Lots of shaded sitting places. Very clean restrooms || I don’t know what they were thinking when they decided to make the water at this park FREEZING COLD. For 110 shekels per person we maybe stayed a half hour, it was just too cold. And there is nothing to do here for kids under 3, unless they enjoy running around in freezing water. Wish we had known before or we wouldn’t have wasted our money. || Really bad experience all over, but to top it all off, a new pair of shoes were stolen from our room! The management completely disregarded our complaint, with the excuse that the employees cannot take anything from the room ?! STAY AWAY from this hotel if you value your belongings. || Five slides. 2 of them exclusively with an inflatable wheel. One extreme slide and the other two are kind of meh...  Park management lets too many people into the park (which is not that big) and so around 12:00 the place is packed, and people keep pouring in....  No swimming pool unless you're a guest of the hotel or the kibbutz, which is kind of sad.  The kids' slides are pretty nice. Overall experience: too crowded. But we had fun nonetheless.  We came in at opening (10:00) and left around 13:30 due to this congestion.  When it gets overcrowded, it's really challenging to find a place with shade.  Semi-recommended. || Not a big variety but if you get a discount ticket it is worth the money. No coffee or beer which is a major downside. They could have done a better job with the toilet and the kiosk. The Park is small enough for the kids to climb up and down the slides without getting lost. It was an enjoyable experience. || Great experience and fun with the kids. a little expensive but if you have coupons or some unions associatiin u might find it in almost half price. (110 NIS for an individual is the full price). The team is very service minded. The cafeteria is poor and should be dramaticaly upgraded in both the quality of the food and the variety || Horrible and dangerous . The 2 blue slides hurt so bad and are unsafe. Im 23 years old and the slide hurt my back so badly because of the water that slammed my back. My younger brother left crying bc of pain after the slide ride. My mom's wheel was out of air and it fell during the slide and she hurt her head so badly that she passed out. Do not go!!!!!!!!!!

Fun outdoor mall. Lots of cold drinks available, and you will need them! || Fantastic experience, just miracle of creatings watching the corals! || A great place to walk around, shop, eat, or watch the sunset/sunrise! || Nice park with 4 rides and an ice cave with bar and a slide, expensive || Ticket price of 55 ISL is just meaningless. || Best experience in Israel and specialy Eliot || Like all shops in Eilat. Expensive. || Nice night activities

We LOVED this place !! We had fabulous time at top 94. Our first time --but certainly not the last. A must visit to the whole family. My 8 years was hesitant at first but after watching  his 11 years old sister, he  opened up and did it all. Most importantly the place is super clean and the stuff is AMAZING!! An instructor named Almog, was SO patient and knowledgeable and helped us step by step. As well as the Romanian instructor (I think his name is Dimitri? )  who made me overcome a very intense height fear. Super professional and made the visit so fun !!! We will come again to visit this place with every Eilat's visit. We came on a Sunday so not many people,  and minimal lines. I highly recommend this place . || Dear Carine, thank you for your lovely comment. we are glad to read your review and even more to hear your family had a wonderful time. we do hope to have you again at Top94.  Best regards, Top 94 team || The perfect place to spend an amazing time with family. The staff are very serious about safety and extremely welcoming! More than 7 activities for a very low price and with no time limit. We spent the whole afternoon there without worrying about the heat, since the complex is indoors and air-conditioned. The kids had a blast climbing and doing archery! As for my wife and me, we loved the go-karting! I highly recommend TOP94!! || Enough recreation to spend hours and even better yet, the place is big and roomy and every instructor has a smile on his face. || Hello Yuval, thanks for the response and support On behalf of the park staff and guides, we look forward to seeing you again soon at Top 94 Eilat! || Our 3rd visit(yet!). We return every time we arrive to Eilat with kur children since our first visit. Great place for the kids to de-energize and manage their fear of heights. Seems that local climbing enthiusiasts also like the climbing walls || Thank you very much for the kind words and support, we look forward to seeing you again next time. Top 94 Team || Good rock climbing wall but the staff was negligent when putting on my full body harness when doing the activity where you scale a ladder and jump out to grab a bar. When I jumped, the poorly fixed harness stopped my jump before I could reach the bar by pulling back on my neck. That caused four cuts on each neck. The worker would also go on his phone to the side of the platform when he should have been monitoring us. Poor training when you have people jumping from 8 meters up. || Hello Eli,  We are sorry to hear that the harness was not placed comfortably but we have to consider safety requirements. Also, the harness is placed on the pelvis and hips and not on the neck.  Best regards, Top 94 Team || Amazing. A must for families visiting Eilat. More shade is recommend though! Come early while it is very empty. || the place is in the industrial zone, about 10 minutes from the city, there is everything you need to spend time with children of different ages, I was with my son on Friday, there were almost no people || 1 star for safety. I was badly injured. Of course my day was ruined & nobody even had the decency to offer me at least a refund. Otherwise, it's a nice, fun place with nice staff. || An entire building dedicated to climbing and more. Went with 4y & 1y to the little’s zone, which is a 4 levels Gymboree and they had a lot of fun there. The actual zone is 4 levels of net, ball pool, steps, trampoline, slides and omega.  Everything is safe proof and clean  Highly recommend it || It was worth it... Karting and firing... enjoyed to the fullest, they offer zip line, wall climbing, archery and paint ball... || Hey there Mia,  Thank you for your comment. We appreciate your kind words and we’re looking forward to having you again!

very nice park. waiting to see the full park when it will finish. || We arrived at the place and asked the employee who was present at the place when the place closed and he answered at 22:30. It's not surprising that many times the place is empty. || Hello Amir, we are sorry to hear that this was your experience. The place was neat and spacious. The performances were great. || Thank you very much Kobi! We're glad you enjoyed it and hope you'll come visit again soon! || Super fun experience The kids really enjoyed it even though only the cars collided and the car drive was open Only open in the evening and it's lovely at those times It's not so hot anymore and the lights are a celebration || Thank you very much and we are glad you enjoyed it! In the coming months, additional attractions will open, such as the Aria Mini Park, which opened on Sukkot. We hope you will come visit again soon! || What kind of penguins are they building a so-called open park for in 40-degree heat, and you still have to walk there? || It is recommended to lie on a hammock and enjoy the morning breeze. || Without a doubt an excellent recommendation, the airplane garden in the park is a real gem, it's also worth stopping by the new coffee cart.

Really awesome experience °•○●♡●○•°  I had such a good time with the staff they were amazing and really helpful in English:) I highly recommend this experience! Really crazy, disgusting attitude. || An unforgettable experience for those who want to experience skydiving for the first time. The team of operators at the complex is professional and courteous. || A rare experience for us and the children. Professional, friendly staff, very nice and relaxing when needed. It was really fun. Definitely worth it. || Not to be missed, if you are in Eilat. We were able to fly independently almost immediately thanks to excellent training. Excellent service, excellent price compared to the center, We even got photo prints. || Highly recommend!!! We came two days in a row with the kids and they literally loved the experience!!! || I came with my 6 year old daughter. An amazing experience.. She enjoyed it so much that immediately afterwards she asked for it again (and received it). I would like to mention the wonderful attitude and service we received from the entire team.. and especially Dima, the professional and patient guide towards the girl, thanks to whom the experience was perfect for the girl. Highly recommend. Thank you very much. || It is a 2-minute hovering in a hovering facility (like skydiving) in a facility 8 meters high. The owner and staff are welcoming, very nice. The ascent from the age of 4. || Amazing experience, really fun atmosphere with quality staff and guides from the movies! Many thanks to Lee-Yam, the great guide who made us feel the most comfortable in the world and really made the experience enjoyable and positive. || What an amazing experience!!!!! Worth every moment, excellent instructors, the children were nervous at first, but the instructors calmed them down, lowered the level of fear, professionals, family atmosphere, it's well worth trying

A really nice place suitable for young children. What I liked least was that the park is not fenced. || An interesting park for children, a science park, although not a large area, but nice to spend time in. || Amazing place, great facilities, the only problem is that this is the only park in Eilat that is invested like this, I wish there were more parks and fitness facilities in Eilat || A wonderful park for everyone, especially those with special needs in wheelchairs and more. The park has accessible swings, an accessible ladder, a spinning top, lawns and more. The park is shaded, with benches and water fountains. Free accessible parking, no restrooms on site. || Lovely place, great facilities. Looks clean and well maintained. || Also called "Science Garden". Two adjacent gardens, separated by a small field. The first (eastern) garden has quite a few facilities, but mainly for younger children, 4 and under. The Science Garden has unusual facilities such as a helicopter and a moon jump. We were with children aged 4, 7 and 9 on the day of the Omer - for some reason they woke up at 7 am and we had to wait until things opened. Very nice. The shading in the Science Garden itself is less successful, it is better to arrive early in the morning or late in the afternoon. Overall nice and free, not hysterically exciting but the little customers were satisfied || The accessible park, a special place, a park with facilities that allow everyone to experience, innovative facilities adapted and accessible. Most of the day, families, groups of children come, spending hours in pure enjoyment. An amazing park

A real fun place for kids, but also for the sea animal lovers. We had a guided tour and it was perfect and well explained. I enjoyed every bit of it. I would have enjoyed more if the glasses were a bit cleaner. Nevertheless, it was fun. PS: The 3D movie was cherry on the top || Would spend there all day. An established place, but it keeps renovating all the time. The shark aquarium is so relaxing and exiting at the same time! The underwater observatory facility is a must. Note- a single ticket is good for a couple of days, so if you want to visit more than once (and you should) plan accordingly. || It is very expensive. The tanks are too small for the large number of fish and turtles. In addition, the glass on the tanks is dirty everywhere, making it difficult to see properly. This needs to be cleaned urgently. The grounds are small overall and half of the attractions consist of films. It is not a must-see. || Good for little kids, probably less for older ones.  The place is trying hard to remain relevant. The underwater observetory is a little old and not really that impressive anymore. However you also get an impressive shark pool and some stingray and sea turtles exhibits. The 3d movie was impressive (but short. 18 min total).  I've certainly been to better aquariums, but this is decent and good for kids. || Wonderful. From walking through the lively coral reef to the 3D cinema which is unlike any other I have witnessed. The screen goes above the head so that it can be protected from any point in the room and looks like the whole is above you. This place is a must see for young and old. It is a beautifully maintained park, with a big variety of coral. The underwater observatory is absolutely amazing. The water of the red see is also accommodating the coral beautifully. The aqua dome is also an experience like none other. The whole is turned into a 3D video and it literally feels like you are under the ocean and touching the sea life yourself. Great place to visit, both educational and fun. its really impressive to see all the unique creatures that live in the ocean. dedicate at least several hours to the visit. || This place gets it!  It's all about the service and people.  Incredibly helpful and friendly staff.  Very clean place.  Food was good and fair priced.  The exhibits were all well maintained.  Especially with children, this is a very nice all day activity. || We’ve been to aquariums all over the world and this isn’t the glossiest or the most high tech. But my kids love it and beg to come back every time we are in Eilat. There’s lots of different things to do that keep everyone entertained and you cannot beat seeing fish in their actual habitat. We love this charming little place. The 3-D movie was a huge hit! || What a great chance to sit and watch fish for hours! Between the underwater observatory and the aquarium we were really pleased with the experience.  Go early for quieter viewing without crowds. There was plenty of parking when they first opened. || We spent the whole day, ~7 hours, so there's lots to do there. I won't give it a 5 star since some things definitely need more love. We saw all the exhibits, there's really a good wide variety and selection of sea creatures, most endemic to Eilat. The highlight must be the shark tank, it has multiple viewing windows, plenty of room, probably the nicest tank I've seen. They feed them twice daily - go to the second feeding! (3pm) it far less crowded. There's a tube to walk under the fish and rays, beautiful. There are also turtles and "rare creatures" (which we didn't find very "rare"). The "deep sea creatures" exhibit is only videos. The lowest point must be the "IMAX", the movie is short, although the 3D effect is cool (kids loved it), but the narration (Heb only) is unintelligible, the content is boring, and they play a "generic" 3D flick. The underwater structure is very nice, but many windows are way too high for a 3-4 y/o to see anything without carrying them 💪, still it's very worth the while (climb up to see the overlook). It's a good place to spend a few hours, it doesn't break the bank, and kids will like it. || Great place to visit. Easy to get to by bus from Eilat. You can buy tickets online or at the gate. The exhibits are lovely.. sharks, stingrays, corals, turtles, octopi, fish. Climb the observatory to the top to see great views of the Red Sea.. then go below sea level to view coral and fish. Try and avoid Jewish / school holidays is it gets very busy. The 3D movie was an extra .. it was not so good.

We came 5 mins after 12pm (and tickets are valid also tomorrow from the morning only! - as explained on the cash desk); spent some half day here late March; sea temperature fresh but still acceptable; not so crowded today; beach service collect beach chairs regularly; easy to find place and take chairs, we enjoy hot and cold sweets with coffee and fresh Mint lemonade. Really tasty; recommended; next time I repeat. || Amazing ! Such an incredible experience ! Staff are also amazing ! Estelle was great called me told me best times to come ! Mayaan was so welcoming and beautiful and IRa was amazing guide ! She was brilliant and supported me on my first dive ! Dolphins are everywhere ❤️❤️ || For the standard entrance fee you can swim at the beach and spend some time on the pier to film and shoot the dolphins (pier closes at 5 pm). Then you have a bar restaurant upstairs in a wonderful place (forbidden under 18 years old). From this place you still can see the dolphins, enjoy the sun and even stay until 11 pm! || Great place. We did snorkeling with the dolphins, it was great to see them in their natural habitat. Our instructor was a very nice and professional lady that took care of everyone’s comfort and made sure everyone is safe and have an amazing time. I was really scared of the depth but thanks to her I could overcome my fear and enjoy the moment. I can’t thank her enough. It’s a place one of a kind and people there are very welcoming. I highly recommend, worth every penny. || I had a great expirience to dive with dolphins..its something amazing..also the place its like heaven..its diferent than other places that i saw in Israel. The relaxing pools inside its something special too. I recommand everyone to visit. || Wonderful location, really worth the detour even though it's located on the other side of Eilat. There's also a bar inside where you can order drinks and bites. Service was great and the food was delicious. A big 5! || Very clean beach and not too crowded. Dolphins seem happy and free. Very good diving guides, and great service. They even offered us a refund for  for one who couldn't make it on time, because they had another person who was interested to dive instead. || Very beautiful dolphin reef. Tourist attraction. We saw 3 dolphins. The food here was delicious, totally recommend! There are also student fares for entry. || Dolphin Reef in Eilat is a natural habitat of Dolphins. We can observe the dolphins 🐬 from the floating bridge provided. The dolphins are very playful and you are allowed to touch them if you wish to.  The security staff watches over the dolphins as well as feeds them.Some snorkeling facility is also there. We visited long back. The Dolphin Reef is open from Monday to Saturday.  Timings: 9 am to 5 pm. We spent some time observing the dolphins.  There is an entry fee. || The most wonderful beach in Eilat. It’s like a completely different world everything beautiful and clean and pleasant. The food at the beach restaurant is great. And to watch the dolphins is certainly a bonus 🐬 …

MUSTTTTT !!!!  We had such a great time! Best 25jd you could spend!  The courses and challenges were super fun and gave just the right amount of thrill.  If you fear heights, this is the place to get over you fear  Big thanks to Diar for being amazing — super friendly, helpful, and really made the experience even better.  Definitely a place I’d recommend if you’re looking for some adventure and good vibes!  Big Thanks to everyone who is working here || Captain Sanad is the best, so nice, funny and helpful! We had so muchhh fun! 😍😍 would recommend 10/10 to anyone coming to Aqaba and loved adventure 😍😍 … || The staff are friendly, professional, and make you feel safe the whole time. The atmosphere is fun, energetic, and the views around Ayla make it even better , we had so much fun will definitely try it again . Both Hamzeh and Sanad made the experience even more fun and memorable.  Definitely one of the best adventure spots in Aqaba. Highly recommended! || Rise Up is super fun and addictive! Easy to play, smooth controls, and the levels really keep you hooked. Honestly, such a cool game — totally worth trying!  Rating: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️  A big thank you to *SAND* and *Hamza*! You two made the whole vibe fun, competitive, and full of excitement. Special thanks to captain Sanad and captain Farah! Super helpful! || Amazinggg crazyyy experience!! The games are realllyyy fun and challenging! Captain Sanad was the besttt he definitely leveled up the excitement !! Special thanks to him!! A must go and a nice place to consider while you are in Aqaba || “Coach Sand was amazing! He was very nice, helpful, and made the game so much fun. He explained everything clearly and was very respectful. We really enjoyed the experience. Thank you!” || It was an amazing day! You should absolutely try this adventure. And Sanad made the experience even better 🔥 … || It was one of the most beautiful days❤️. It was a very enjoyable and wonderful adventure🥹. Indeed, it is a very special and elegant place. It contains very special games, including climbing 🧗‍♀️and zip-line. And let us not forget the golf adventure⛳. It is very enjoyable. They have a special place for children🚸 as well. They had a high-quality security system🦸, and what’s best is the very distinguished staff.  Especially Captain🏅 Mo💪❤️ Captain 🏅Abdullah❤️ they are very wonderful

It’s a great hostel and a good price, the staff are very unfriendly is the only drawback. The kitchen is amazing, they have a number of spices, oil, and good pots and pans which is all so rare in a hostel. There is a grocery store within walking distance too. The beds are very thin but comfortable and the towels and blankets are really good quality. There are common spaces both inside and outside that provide for a nice communal feel. Overall you can’t get a it’s a good quiet hostel for the price in Eilat, just minimize contact with the staff maybe. || Amazing place. Rooms are comfortable, very good bed. Toilet/bath is a bit small but also good and clean. Owner is very friendly. We found hot water and tea in the kitchen. Outside there was a wonderful terrace, spacious, plenty of places to sit down. And a pool! Recommended ❤️ || Hotel is located not very far from the beaches in a very calm place. It's very clean and nice place. The living room is big and very spacious. They have well equipped kitchen for all guests. ||We had great room with big bath and glassy … || My friend and I stayed here this past weekend and I was completely let down, especially given all the positive reviews. There was a man there as well and he was nice enough, but the overall vibe of the place was really unsettling. Also, the shower in the bathroom was completely full of black mold and there was a crack in the base that water leaks into every time someone showers- it was really gross! Our room was okay. I'm giving two stars only because the bed was comfortable and the sheets were clean and the other bathroom was clean enough. The pool and outdoor area looked nothing like the photos- they're not pristine at all. For me, the lack of hospitality was the real kicker though. I really can't recommend this place. || I don't know why people write bad reviews. There was a good holiday. Everything was very pleasant. The host is really warm. Room was clean, with air conditioner, tv, fridge, good wi-fi. Yes there are shared bathroom, but it was really ok for me and wasn't problems with it. The hole place really good a big hall and a kitchen with free tea, coffee all equipment and additional fridge. I cooked there and feel like at home.) Good territory with the pool, tables and cozy back yard 😊  And the price was the best. So I Think this is the best place to stay with all this 🙂 || Super kind and friendly staff/host willing to help his customers with any issues. For us Philip made a hard work to find our lost car key, that he found at the end saving us paying a fortune to the car rental company. The plase itself is in … || Great place for people who don't want to be at the hotel all day, IMO. Great location A real bang for your buck.
